anatomy.coat: German Wolfsspitz/Keeshond has a double coat: Long, straight and firm standing off top coat and short, thick, cotton-wool-like undercoat. Head, ears, front side of front and hind legs and the paws are covered by short, thick (velvety) hair. The rest of the body has a long, rich, hairy coat. Not wavy, curly or shaggy, not parted along the back. Neck and shoulders are covered by a thick mane. The backside of the front legs is well feathered, the hind legs have ample feathering from croup to hocks. The tail is bushy. Hair must not look like being modelled. German Giant Spitz, Medium Size Spitz and Miniature Spitz dogs have a double coat: Long, straight and firm standing off top coat and short, thick, cotton-wool-like undercoat. White Spitz: The coat should be pure white. Little trace of yellow, which often occurs, especially on the ears, is tolerated. identity.general_impression: Câine de talie medie, echilibrat, bine construit, de tip Spitz, cu urechi ridicate și manta în diverse culori. Lungimea părului lasă vizibile proporțiile corpului. Osatură medie.

anatomy.head: Craniu echilibrat, nici prea lat, nici prea îngust. De sus și profil, în formă de pană. Nas și craniu paralele.
anatomy.skull: Frunte plată, cu sutură metopică și occiput bine definite.
anatomy.muzzle: Armonios, nici grosolan, nici ascuțit; se subțiază spre trufă. Nas drept. Trufă de mărime medie, pigment negru. Buze cu margini întinse, pigment negru.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Puternice; dentiție largă în maxilarul inferior, completă (42 de dinți), cu mușcătură în foarfece ori în clește. Dinți perpendiculari, aliniați.
anatomy.eyes: Închiși, de mărime medie, nici înfundați, nici ieșiți, ușor oblici. Pleoape cu pigment negru, aderente.
anatomy.ears: Distanțate cât lățimea bazei unei urechi. De mărime medie, triunghiulare, ridicate, cu vârf ușor rotunjit. Vârfurile și centrul stopului formează un triunghi aproape echilateral.
anatomy.neck: De lungime medie, în armonie cu ansamblul, bine musculat. Pielea gâtului aderentă; se îmbină fluid în corp.
anatomy.body: Spate ceva mai lung decât înalt, cu greabăn definit și șale musculoase.
anatomy.chest: Bine dezvoltat, coboară spre cot.
anatomy.tail: Inserată sus, rotunjită și fermă, de bună grosime, se subțiază; vârful ajunge la jaret, acoperită cu păr stufos; purtată pe spate, ușor căzută lateral ori răsucită.
anatomy.forequarters: Anterioare drepte, cu osatură medie.
anatomy.hindquarters: Posteriori bine unghiați și puternici.
anatomy.feet: Rotunzi, cu degete strânse.
anatomy.movement: Acoperă mult teren cu impuls puternic al posteriorului și bună alungire a anteriorului. Posterior solid și echilibrat; membre drepte, converg la viteză. Preferat trapul.
anatomy.coat: Pe tot corpul subpăr des și păr de acoperire de lungime medie, drept, ușor ridicat. Scurt pe bot, față, urechi și fața anterioară a membrelor. Coada, spatele anteriorului (franjuri) și al posteriorului (culotă) cu păr mai lung. Pe gât abia mai lung, fără coamă.
anatomy.color: Toate culorile și combinațiile, cu excepția albului pur și a pătatului.
anatomy.size: Masculi 52–60 cm (22–30 kg); femele 48–56 cm (18–26 kg). Ideal masculi 56 cm/26 kg, femele 52 cm/22 kg.
anatomy.skin: Întinsă, pigmentată.

temperament.behavior: Sigur pe sine, calm, echilibrat, cu mare rezistență la provocări. Atent și treaz, fără a fi gălăgios. Legat strâns de familie, relaxat cu străinii, neinvaziv. Are nevoie de contact strâns cu familia și de un dresaj blând.
temperament.temperament_notes: Masculii trebuie să aibă doi testiculi de aspect normal, complet coborâți în scrot. Doar subiecții sănătoși și tipici pot fi folosiți la reproducere.

identity.historical_function: Sledge dog.
identity.general_impression: A very strong polar spitz, built for endurance and strenuous work as a sledge dog under arctic conditions. Some variation in size is allowed, assuming working ability and harmony are not affected.
identity.important_proportions: The body is short rectangular with the ratio of height at withers to body length as 10 to 11. Females are allowed a slightly longer body.
identity.ideal_type_summary: A very strong polar spitz, built for endurance and strenuous work as a sledge dog under arctic conditions.
identity.historical_summary: The Greenland Dog is one of the world’s oldest breeds and has since ancient times been the Inuits’ only sledge dog. Selection of specimens for breeding has been based mainly upon qualities like sturdy strength, hardiness and endurance, but an attractive appearance has also been kept in view. With its robust nature the Greenland Dog is especially a dog for people enjoying open-air life. He is an excellent companion for people who likes strolling in woods or mountains with their dog pulling or carrying their gear.
identity.classification: Section 1 Nordic Sledge Dogs. With working trial.

anatomy.skull: The skull is broad and slightly arched, broadest between the ears.
anatomy.muzzle: Broad at base and tapering towards the nose, but not pointed. Nose: Big and dark, corresponding to coat colour, always liverbrown in dogs with red or brown coat and always dark in dogs with sable coat. May turn pink during winter (”winter-nose”). Lips: Thin and tight, lying close to the very powerful teeth.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Powerful jaws with regular, sound and strong teeth. Scissors-bite.
anatomy.eyes: Dark eyes are preferred, but colour should be according to coat colour. They are slightly slanted and neither deep set nor protruding. Expression is frank and bold. The eye-rims are closely fitting.
anatomy.ears: Rather small, triangular, with rounded tips, carried firmly erect. The ears are very mobile and expressive.
anatomy.neck: Very powerful and rather short.
anatomy.topline: Level or only slightly sloping.
anatomy.body: Strong and rather compact, just slightly longer than the height at the withers. Topline: Level or only slightly sloping. Back: Straight. Loin: Broad. Croup: Slightly sloping. Chest: Deep and broad, but not barrel-shaped. Underline and belly: Following the line of the brisket. A slight tuck up accepted.
anatomy.chest: Deep and broad, but not barrel-shaped.
anatomy.tail: Set on high, thick and bushy. Carried in a curve or lightly curled over back.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: Seen from the front the forelegs are perfectly straight, with powerful muscles and heavy bone. Shoulder: Moderately laid back. Upper arm: Straight and strong, somewhat longer than the shoulder-blade. Elbow: Fitting close to the body, but able to move freely. Forearm: Straight and strong. Carpus (Wrist): Strong and flexible. Metacarpus (Pastern: Strong and elastic, only slightly sloping. Forefeet: Rather big, powerful and rounded, with strong nails and pads.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: Seen from behind the hindlegs are perfectly straight. Very muscular hindquarters with powerful bone and moderate angulations. Thigh: Powerful and very muscular. Hock joint: Broad and strong, moderately angulated. Hind feet: Rather big, powerful and rounded, with strong nails and pads.
anatomy.feet: Rather big, powerful and rounded, with strong nails and pads. Rather big, powerful and rounded, with strong nails and pads.
anatomy.movement: An efficient, harmonious, fluent and tireless trot is most essential to a sledge dog. In the ring the dog should be shown on a loose lead in a moderate trot to display good reach in front and good drive from behind. Seen from front when walking, a Greenland Dog does not single track, but as the speed increases, the legs will gradually converge inward until the feet follow the center line.
anatomy.coat: Double coat, i.e. a soft, dense undercoat and an outer coat of dense, straight and coarse hair, without curl or wave. On the head and the legs the hair is rather short, on the body it is longer and more pronounced. The coat is longer on the underside of the tail, giving it a bushy appearance. Colour: Any colour - solid or parti-coloured – is permitted, except albinos and dogs with merle-markings which should be disqualified.
anatomy.color: Any colour - solid or parti-coloured – is permitted, except albinos and dogs with merle-markings which should be disqualified.
anatomy.size: Height at the withers: Males 60 cm and upwards, Females 55 cm and upwards.

temperament.behavior: The predominant temperamental qualities of the Greenland Dog are energy, mental strength and boldness. He is a passionate and tireless sledge dog. To people - also strangers - he is friendly, and while acting as sledge dog not closely attached to any particular person and therefore not suitable as a guard dog. On hunting seal and polar bear he will show a strong hunting instinct.

identity.historical_summary: This breed is said to have originated from medium-sized Japanese dogs that accompanied migrants from Honshu (the main island of Japan) to Hokkaido during the Kamakura era (in the 1140s), when exchanges were developing between Hokkaido and the Tohoku District. When the breed was designated as a « natural monument » in 1937, it took an the name of the area. It also came to be known as the « Ainu-ken », since the Ainu-the former inhabitants of Hokkaido-used to breed these dogs for hunting bears and other animals. The physique of the Hokkaido enables it to withstand severe cold and heavy snowfalls.

identity.historical_function: Herding dog.
identity.general_impression: The Icelandic Sheepdog is a Nordic Herding Spitz, slightly under medium size, sturdy, with erect ears and a curled tail. Seen from the side the dog is rectangular. The expression is gentle, intelligent and happy. A confident and lively bearing is typical for the breed. There are two types of coat, short and long, both thick and very weather-resistant. There is a marked difference in appearance between the sexes.
identity.important_proportions: Seen from the side the dog is rectangular, the length of the body from point of shoulder to point of buttock is greater than the height at withers. Depth of the chest is equal to the length of the foreleg. Muzzle slightly shorter than skull.
identity.ideal_type_summary: The Icelandic Sheepdog is a Nordic Herding Spitz, slightly under medium size, sturdy, with erect ears and a curled tail.
identity.historical_summary: The Icelandic Sheepdog is Iceland’s native breed of dog. It is the descendant of the dogs brought to Iceland by the original Viking settlers (AD 870-930). The dogs became indispensable in the rounding up of livestock and in the daily work on the farms. Their method of working adapted to the local terrain, farming methods and the people’s hard struggle for survival over the centuries.
identity.classification: Section 3 Nordic Watchdogs and Herders. Without working trial.

Black, dark brown on chocolate brown and some cream dogs.

anatomy.tail: High set, curled over and touching the back.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: When seen from the front the forelegs are straight, parallel and strong. Normal angulation. Shoulders: Oblique and muscular. Dew claws: May be double. Forefeet: Slightly oval, toes well arched and tight, with well developed pads.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: When seen from behind the hind legs are straight, parallel and strong. Normal angulation. Thigh: Broad and well muscled. Dew claws: Well developed double dew claws are desirable. Hind feet: Slightly oval, toes well arched and tight, with well developed pads.

anatomy.movement: Displays agility and endurance with good driving action, covering the ground effortlessly.
anatomy.coat: There are two variants: Short-haired: The outer coat is fairly coarse, with a thick, soft undercoat. The hair is shorter on the face, top of head, ears and front of legs. It is longer on the neck, chest and back of thighs. The tail is bushy and the hair length is in proportion to the coat. Long-haired: The outer coat is longer and fairly coarse, with a thick, soft undercoat. The hair is shorter on the face, top of head, ears and front of legs. It is longer behind the ears, on the neck, withers, chest and back of thighs and with fringes on the back of the forelegs. The tail is very bushy and the hair length is in proportion to the coat.
anatomy.color: • Fawn and red in various shades, ranging from cream to reddish brown • Grey shaded • Chocolate brown in various shades • Black White markings always accompany the main colour, lighter shading often occurs on the underside of the dog, from throat to tip of tail. On grey shaded dogs and quite often on fawn and red dogs a dark mask, dark tips to the outer hairs and dark hairs in the coat occur (dark overlay/sable). Black and chocolate brown dogs most often have traditional tan markings in any of the various fawn colours on the cheeks, over the eyes (eyebrows), below the tail, on the underside of the tail and on the legs. Pied dogs have patches of colour on the body on a white background, and can also have the accompanying white markings. The patches of colour, which can vary in size, should predominate. The white markings, which are often irregular, are a blaze or a part of the face, collar, chest, socks of varying length and tip of tail. Colour on or near the ears is preferred.

temperament.behavior: The Icelandic Sheepdog is a hardy and agile herding spitz, which barks, making it extremely useful for herding or driving sheep and other livestock. The Icelandic Sheepdog is by nature very alert and will announce the arrival of visitors without being aggressive. The breed is cheerful, friendly, inquisitive, playful and confident with a gentle temperament.

identity.historical_function: Câine de vânătoare, folosit mai ales la elan, dar și la urs și mistreț.

Recunoașterea târzie se datorează faptului că era judecat împreună cu Elghund-ul norvegian mai mic. Trebuie să latre intens și îndelung la pradă, ceea ce cere forță și rezistență.

identity.historical_function: Hunting dog, companion.
identity.general_impression: Medium-sized dog, well balanced, sturdily built, muscles well developed. The dog has the characteristics of a dog living in mountainous districts of Japan. Limbs strong and hocks remarkably developed.
identity.important_proportions: The ratio of height at withers to length of body is 10 : 11, but the body can be slightly longer in bitches.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Medium-sized dog, well balanced, sturdily built, muscles well developed.
identity.historical_summary: This breed originated from medium-sized dogs that existed in Japan in the ancient times. It became established as a breed in the Kai district (Yamanashi Prefecture), which is surrounded by mountains. Another name for this breed is « Kai tora-ken ». A distinguishing feature in this dog is its brindled coat. These dogs are used mainly for hunting wild boar and deer. Their strong inclination to form a pack is thought to contribute towards maintaining the purity of the breed. The breed was designated as a « natural monument » in 1934.
identity.classification: Section 5 Asian Spitz and related breeds. Without working trial.

identity.historical_function: Hunting spitz. A dog mainly for elk and bear hunting, holds the game at bay.
identity.general_impression: Medium sized spitz with dense coat. Robust conformation with strong built.
identity.important_proportions: The length of the body is only slightly longer than the height at the withers. The depth of the body is about the half of the height at the withers. The ratio between muzzle and skull is approximately 2: 3. The length of the skull is about the same as its breadth and depth.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Medium sized spitz with dense coat.
identity.historical_summary: The Komi dog, also called the dog of Zyrians, is considered to be the origin of the breed. However, the basic stock dogs originated from the Lagoda’s Karelia, Olonets and Russian Karelia, where they were used for all different types of game hunting. The breeding was started in 1936 with the goal to create a sturdy dog which barks at big game. Then it was agreed that the name of the breed is Karelian Bear Dog. The first standard was established in 1945. The first dogs were registered in 1946. Today the breed is common in Finland.
identity.classification: Section 2 Nordic hunting dogs. Working trial only in the Nordic countries (Finland, Sweden & Norway).

anatomy.head: Viewed from the front triangular in shape, not very long.
anatomy.skull: Broad; viewed from the front and in profile slightly convex. Broadest between the ears. The frontal furrow is barely visible. The superciliary ridges are only slightly developed.

anatomy.eyes: Rather small, slightly oval. Brown of different shades. The expression is alert and fiery.

Under line and belly: Slightly tucked up.
anatomy.chest: Spacious, not very broad, rather long, reaching approximately to the elbows. The ribs are slightly sprung; the forechest clearly visible, yet not protruding. Under line and belly: Slightly tucked up.
anatomy.tail: High set, of medium length, curved over the back, the tip of the tail touching the body on either side or on the back. A natural bobtail is permitted and is of equal value to a natural long tail.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: Powerful with strong bone. Viewed from the front straight and parallel. The upper arm and the shoulder are equal in length, the forearm is slightly longer. Forearm: Strong and vertical. Metacarpus (pastern): Of medium length, slightly oblique, flexible. Forefeet: Tight, well arched, roundish and pointing forward. Pads springy, the sides covered with dense hair.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: Strong and muscular, viewed from behind straight and parallel. Thigh: Broad and long with strong muscles. Stifle (Knee): Pointing forward, moderate angulation. The front line of the hind leg has smooth angulations. Lower thigh: Long and muscular. Hock joint: Low set; angulation clearly defined. Metatarsus (Rear pastern): Short, strong and vertical. Hind feet: Tight, slightly longer and less arched than the front feet. Pads elastic, the sides covered with dense hair.
anatomy.feet: Tight, well arched, roundish and pointing forward. Pads springy, the sides covered with dense hair. Tight, slightly longer and less arched than the front feet. Pads elastic, the sides covered with dense hair.
anatomy.movement: Light, effortless, covering a lot of ground. Changes easily from trot to gallop, which is the most natural gait. The legs move parallel.
anatomy.coat: Outer coat harsh and straight. On the neck, back and backside of the upper thighs longer than elsewhere. Undercoat soft and dense. Colour: Black, may be dull or with nuances of brown. Most individuals have clearly defined white markings on the head, neck, chest, belly and the legs.
anatomy.color: Black, may be dull or with nuances of brown. Most individuals have clearly defined white markings on the head, neck, chest, belly and the legs.
anatomy.size: Height at the withers: Males: 54–60 cm, females 49–55 cm. Ideal height: males 57 cm and females 52 cm. Weight: Ideal weight males 25– 28 kg and females 17–20 kg.
anatomy.skin: Tight overall without wrinkles.

temperament.behavior: Eager hunter; very independent, yet works co-operatively to game, marking game by barking. The senses, especially of smell, are sharp, thus the breed is suitable for big game hunting. Very good sense of direction. Balanced, courageous and persistent. Highly developed spirit for game. Very self-confident, may be territorial towards other males, never aggressive towards people. Slightly reserved.

identity.historical_function: Hunting dog, companion.
identity.general_impression: Medium-sized dog, well balanced and muscles well developed. The dog has pricked ears and a curled or sickle tail. The conformation is strong, well boned and compact.
identity.important_proportions: The ratio of height at withers to length of body is 10 : 11.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Medium-sized dog, well balanced and muscles well developed.
identity.historical_summary: This breed originated from medium-sized dogs that existed in Japan in ancient times. It became established as a breed in the mountainous districts in Kishu (Wakayama and Mie Prefecture). Initially, these dogs’coats were often marked with conspicuous colours such as red, sesame or brindle. From 1934, however, only solid colours were accepted for this breed; conspicuously marked coats had disappeared by 1945, never to reappear. Currently, white coats may be found in this breed. These dogs are used for hunting, now mainly wild boar, but at one time also deer. The breed took on the name of the region where it was bred. It was designated as a « natural monument » in 1934.
identity.classification: Section 5 Asian Spitz and related breeds. Without working trial.

identity.historical_function: Câine de vânătoare.
identity.general_impression: Câine de talie medie, bine proporționat, folosit la vânătoare și pază. Cu urechi ridicate și coada răsucită ori în seceră, e expresia vie a agilității, forței, vigilenței și demnității.
identity.important_proportions: Raportul înălțime la greabăn : lungimea corpului = 10 : 10,5.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Câine de talie medie, bine proporționat, folosit la vânătoare și pază.
identity.historical_summary: Nu există documente scrise despre originea rasei Korea Jindo, dar mărturii de încredere concordă că există de câteva mii de ani pe insula Jindo, la extremitatea de sud-vest a peninsulei coreene. Dintre teoriile despre originea sa veche, cea mai acceptată e că rasa e nativă a Coreei, bine păstrată pe insulă din cauza dificultăților de transport din acele vremuri. În Coreea e numit Jindo-kae ori Jindo-kyon (kae/kyon = câine în coreeană).

anatomy.head: Văzută de sus, formează un triunghi teșit; nu dă câinelui un aer greoi ori grosolan.
anatomy.skull: De mărime medie față de corp. Partea de sus ușor bombată, se subțiază treptat spre ochi. Lățimea între urechi e moderată față de mărimea capului.
anatomy.stop: Bine definit, dar nu prea pronunțat. O ușoară sutură metopică se întinde spre frunte.
anatomy.muzzle: Nu masiv, nici răsfrânt în sus. Trufă neagră; la câinele alb se admite culoarea cărnie. Buze negre, perfect aderente, subțiri și nependinte; buza superioară o acoperă ușor pe cea inferioară.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Foarte robuste; mușcătură în foarfece.
anatomy.eyes: Maro-închis, mai degrabă mici față de volumul capului, migdalați, foarte vioi. Unghiul extern al fiecărui ochi e înclinat spre ureche.
anatomy.ears: De mărime medie, triunghiulare, groase și perfect ridicate. Inserate nici sus, nici jos. Îndreptate ușor înainte, pe linia profilului superior al gâtului. În interiorul urechilor se dorește păr fin și des.
anatomy.neck: Bine proporționat și gros, fără salbă, bine musculos și puternic. Câinele poartă gâtul mândru și frumos arcuit când e atent.
anatomy.topline: Puternică și dreaptă.
anatomy.body: Spate puternic și drept. Șale bine musculate, întinse, uscate, mai înguste decât cutia toracică. Torace puternic și moderat de adânc, dar nu prea larg, punctul cel mai adânc fiind chiar deasupra cotului (se acceptă și la nivelul cotului). Coaste bine arcuite, piept bine dezvoltat. Ventre retras.
anatomy.tail: Coborâtă, vârful ei ar trebui să atingă jaretul. Inserată destul de sus. Purtată dreaptă, fără să oscileze la mișcare. În seceră ori răsucită, cu vârful atingând spatele ori flancul. Nu prea răsucită pe sine. Abundent franjurată.
anatomy.feet: De pisică. Degete mai degrabă scurte, rotunjite, compacte și strânse. Unghii puternice, de preferat negre. Perinițe dure și bine dezvoltate.
anatomy.movement: Puternic și constant. Linia superioară rămâne fermă și orizontală. La trap capul e purtat sus, dar la viteză mare aproape la nivelul umerilor. Partea de sus a cozii se mișcă ușor la schimbările de direcție.
anatomy.coat: Manta dublă. Subpărul moale, des, de culoare deschisă, suficient să susțină mantaua exterioară. Mantaua exterioară dreaptă, ceva ridicată de pe corp. Pe cap, membre și urechi mai scurtă; pe gât, greabăn, spate și crupă mai lungă. Pe coadă și pe partea din spate a coapselor mai lungă decât pe restul corpului.
anatomy.color: Cele mai obișnuite: roșu-fulvo, alb, negru, negru cu foc, gri-lup și brindat (tigrat).
anatomy.size: Masculi 50–55 cm (ideal 53–54); femele 45–50 cm (ideal 48–49). Masculi 18–23 kg; femele 15–19 kg.

temperament.behavior: Are un instinct puternic de vânătoare; îndrăzneț, curajos, vigilent și atent, impetuos, nu se lasă ușor ademenit. Mai presus de toate, e extrem de fidel stăpânului. În general nu-i place de alte animale, mai ales de masculi. Are bun simț de orientare. Câine al unui singur stăpân, acceptă ușor un proprietar nou, dar nu-și pierde niciodată afecțiunea pentru cel care l-a crescut de pui. Se menține curat și mănâncă cumpătat.

identity.historical_summary: The origin of the Japanese Spitz is said to be the large-sized white German Spitz brought to Japan around 1920 via the continent of Siberia and northeast part of China. Around the year 1921 the breed was first exhibited at a dog show in Tokyo. Subsequently, in 1925, two pairs of white Spitz were imported from Canada, and until around 1936, imports came from Canada, the U.S., Australia and China. Eventually their offspring were crossbred to produce a better breed. After the 2nd World War, the unified breed standard was established by the Japan Kennel Club in 1948 to be valid to the present.

identity.historical_function: Câine de vânătoare.
identity.general_impression: Mic câine spitz ușor dreptunghiular, bine echilibrat, cu musculatură puternică și bine dezvoltată. Atent, cu capul purtat sus, atitudine curajoasă. Extrem de mobil. Dimorfismul sexual trebuie să fie clar evident.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Mic câine spitz ușor dreptunghiular, bine echilibrat, cu musculatură puternică și bine dezvoltată.
identity.historical_summary: Norrbottenspitz (spitz originar din comitatul North Bothnia) își trage probabil originile din micii Laika de tip spitz care, încă din preistorie, trăiau în zona Capului Nord la popoare de vânători. Acești mici spitzi de vânătoare au supraviețuit mii de ani prin selecție naturală. În zonele aspre din nordul Peninsulei Scandinave, vânătoarea pentru hrană și blănuri era o necesitate de supraviețuire; blănurile prețioase (samur, jder, hermină) au fost singura monedă de schimb valabilă secole la rând. Când prețul blănurilor a scăzut drastic după al Doilea Război Mondial, a scăzut și popularitatea rasei; a dispărut și Kennel Clubul Suedez (SKK) a declarat-o dispărută. Circa un deceniu mai târziu s-a aflat că unele exemplare tipice supraviețuiau ca și câini de companie și pază în micile ferme din interiorul North Bothnia. Grație câtorva oameni devotați, acest tip vechi de spitz de vânătoare a fost salvat. În 1967 a fost reintrodus în Registru și s-a redactat un nou standard.

anatomy.head: Puternică și de croială curată. De sus și lateral se subțiază treptat spre trufă.
anatomy.skull: Relativ amplu; frunte ușor arcuită, creștetul mai degrabă plat.
anatomy.muzzle: Lungimea = jumătate din lungimea capului ori ceva mai puțin. Se subțiază clar spre trufă, dar nu e niciodată ascuțit. Trufă neagră. Buze subțiri și strâns aderente.
anatomy.neck: Moderat de lung, proporționat cu corpul, uscat și musculos, ușor arcuit și de bun alungit.
anatomy.body: Greabăn definit. Spate scurt, orizontal, puternic, musculos și elastic. Șale scurte și ample. Crupă moderat de lungă și amplă, ușor descendentă, cu mușchi bine dezvoltați și tonici. Torace moderat de înalt și lung; înălțimea circa jumătate din înălțimea totală la greabăn, cu ultimele coaste bine dezvoltate. Oval din față, de lățime normală. Piept bine dezvoltat și bine definit. Văzut lateral, partea cea mai joasă a cutiei toracice ar trebui să fie la nivelul cotului ori chiar sub, contopindu-se blând cu linia inferioară. Ventre doar ușor retras.
anatomy.tail: Inserată mai degrabă sus, purtată într-o curbă înaltă, dar moale răsucită. Vârful atinge latura coapsei. Întinsă, lungimea nu trebuie să depășească jaretul.
anatomy.forequarters: Din față nici îngust, nici larg, cu picioare drepte și paralele. Omoplat lung și larg, musculos, cu greabăn bine dezvoltat, bine aderent la torace și oblic. Braț lung cât omoplatul, formând un unghi marcat. Coți nedeviați. Antebraț drept, cu osatură puternică, cu mușchi uscați dar elastici. Metacarp puternic, ușor oblic lateral. Picior anterior mic, puternic, îndreptat înainte, cu degete bine arcuite și compacte. Perinițe bine dezvoltate și dure.
anatomy.hindquarters: Din spate paraleli. Coapsă proporțional lungă, formează cel puțin un unghi drept cu bazinul. Mușchi puternici. Genunchi puternic, cu unghiulări bine definite. Gambă formează un unghi marcat cu coapsa. Jaret puternic. Metatars uscat, elastic și mai degrabă lung. Picioare posterioare ca cele anterioare.
anatomy.movement: Fluid, liber, care acoperă mult teren, menținând linia spatelui fermă. Membrele se mișcă pe planuri paralele, văzute din față și din spate.
anatomy.coat: Manta dublă. Subpăr fin și des, păr de gardă dur, scurt și drept. Păr exterior foarte des, cu lungimi variate: cel mai scurt pe nas, creștet, urechi și fața anterioară a membrelor; cel mai lung pe gât, posteriorul coapselor și partea inferioară a cozii.
anatomy.color: Alb pur, mereu cu pete bine definite și bine distribuite, de culoarea ideală (toate nuanțele de roșu și galben). Petele pe corp mai degrabă mari. Culoarea ar trebui să acopere laturile capului și urechile. Se tolerează pete negre, orice nuanță de fulvo ori aguti, dar culorile ideale sunt mereu de preferat.
anatomy.size: Înălțime ideală: masculi 45 cm, femele 42 cm. Toleranță: ± 2 cm.

temperament.behavior: Ca și câine de vânătoare, trebuie să fie atent și curajos. Prompt, vioi, plin de încredere în sine, cu temperament prietenos. Deși e folosit în principal la vânatul de cocoș de munte, poate vâna și animale de blană, precum și elani.
temperament.temperament_notes: Masculii trebuie să aibă doi testiculi de aspect normal, complet coborâți în scrot.

identity.historical_summary: The Norwegian Buhund can be traced far back in Norwegian history. The breed type has probably existed since before the Viking Age, and is thus more than a thousand years old. Remnants have been found in Viking burial mounds giving evidence of a little spitz type dog living with humans. The word buhund means farmstead dog and is mentioned in The Norse King Sagas by Snorri Sturlason. One of the stories there is about when Olav Tryggvason was in Ireland and met a farmer and his very clever Buhund Vige. Olav was so impressed by the dog's herding abilities and wanted him. The farmer gave the dog to Olav, and in exchange he received a gold ring and Olav's friendship. The Buhund is a versatile all-round breed, but for the farmer it has been mostly used as a guard and herding dog. The first standard was approved by the Norwegian Kennel Club in 1926.

identity.historical_summary: The Norwegian Lundehund is an ancient breed used for hunting seabirds on the Norwegian coast. The breed name is a combination of the Norwegian words "lunde" (puffin, i.e. Fratercula arctica) and "hund", dog. Although the age of a breed is difficult to establish, there are descriptions of dogs used for hunting puffins which are more than 400 years old. The Lundehund was important for people in coastal Norway. The dog’s unique anatomy with extra, functional toes, a neck that can bend to touch the back, ears that can close and forelimbs that are ultra flexible, enables the dog to climb near vertical screes and enter the narrow, twisting burrows of the puffins nesting cavities and retrieve the birds alive. Puffin meat was a main part of the diet during winter in costal areas. The down was either used in duvets and pillows or exported. Modern hunting methods and depopulation in northern coastal regions caused a decrease in the Lundehund population. However, at Måstad on the isolated island of Værøy, people kept the hunting traditions alive, using the Lundehunds. Between the World Wars, some dogs were sent to a Mr.& Mrs Christie in southern Norway and bred from. Canine distemper nearly wiped out the entire Lundehund population between the World Wars and immediately after WW II, but the Christie’s in cooperation with people of Værøy and some new breeders, managed to save the breed from extinction. Today the puffin is a protected species and the dogs cannot be used for their original purpose. They are however much treasured and part of the Norwegian cultural heritage.

anatomy.head: Clean-cut, medium width, wedge shaped.
anatomy.skull: Slightly rounded with prominent superciliary arches.
anatomy.muzzle: Wedge shaped of medium length. Nasal bridge slightly convex.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Scissor bite preferred, but a pincer bite or a moderate prognathism of the lower jaw is permitted. The absence of premolars on both sides, in each jaw, is accepted.
anatomy.eyes: Slightly sloping and not protruding; the iris is yellowish brown; the pupil is encircled by a dark halo.
anatomy.ears: Triangular ears of medium size, broad at the base, carried erect and very mobile. The cartilage of the ear lobe has the faculty of being able to retract itself so that the ear folds itself and flops in a specific manner, either backwards or in right angle upwards, so as to close the auditory passage.
anatomy.neck: Clean-cut, of medium length, quite strong with a relatively well furnished collar.
anatomy.topline: Straight.
anatomy.body: Rectangular. Topline: Straight. Back: Strong. Croup: Slightly sloping. Chest: Long, of medium width, relatively well let down and spacious, not barrel shaped. Underline and belly: Belly slightly drawn up.
anatomy.chest: Long, of medium width, relatively well let down and spacious, not barrel shaped.
anatomy.tail: Set medium high, medium length, well covered with hair but without flag. Carried either slightly in a ring over the back, or hanging. The tip must not be too much over nor falling to one side.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: Moderately angulated. Forearm: Straight. Forefeet: Oval shaped, turning slightly outwards, with at least six toes – of which five must rest on the ground. Eight pads on each foot. The two inner toes, formed respectively by 3 and 2 phalanges and endowed with a ligamentary and muscular system, make the foot look solid.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: The position of the hindquarters is somewhat close. Thigh: Strong and muscular. Stifle (Knee): Moderately angulated. Lower thigh: Strong and muscular. Hind feet: Oval shaped, turned slightly outwards, with at least six toes - four of which must rest on the ground. Seven pads on each foot, the one in the middle, the most important by its size, being attached to the inner pads corresponding to the two inner toes. When the dog is standing on a flat surface, the weight of the body must be evenly distributed on the pads.
anatomy.feet: Oval shaped, turning slightly outwards, with at least six toes – of which five must rest on the ground. Eight pads on each foot. The two inner toes, formed respectively by 3 and 2 phalanges and endowed with a ligamentary and muscular system, make the foot look solid. Oval shaped, turned slightly outwards, with at least six toes - four of which must rest on the ground. Seven pads on each foot, the one in the middle, the most important by its size, being attached to the inner pads corresponding to the two inner toes. When the dog is standing on a flat surface, the weight of the body must be evenly distributed on the pads.
anatomy.movement: Light and elastic. An external rotary action of the forelegs and somewhat close action behind is characteristic of the breed.
anatomy.coat: Dense and rough, soft undercoat. Short on the head and the front of the legs, more abundant at the level of the neck, rear of the buttocks (thighs) and on the tail, but without flag. Colour: Always combined with white: from red to fawn, coat more or less sprinkled with hairs with black tips; white with dark patches. The adult usually has more marked black tips in the coat than the younger dog.
anatomy.color: Always combined with white: from red to fawn, coat more or less sprinkled with hairs with black tips; white with dark patches. The adult usually has more marked black tips in the coat than the younger dog.
anatomy.size: Height at the withers: Males: 35 - 38 cms. Females: 32 - 35 cms. Weight: Males: about 7 kgs. Females: about 6 kgs.

temperament.behavior: Alert, energetic, lively.
temperament.temperament_notes: • Male animals should have two apparently normal testicles fully descended into the scrotum. • Only functionally and clinically healthy dogs, with breed typical conformation should be used for breeding. The latest correction is in bold characters.

identity.official_name: Peruvian Hairless Dog (Perro sin pelo del Perú)
identity.historical_function: Câine de companie. Varietatea nudă a fost recunoscută ca rasă peruană în 1985 (FCI, Amsterdam), pe standardul lui Ermanno Maniero. Două varietăți — fără păr și cu păr; cea cu păr trebuie să provină din doi părinți fără păr.
identity.general_impression: Câine zvelt și elegant, al cărui aspect exprimă viteză, forță și armonie fără a fi grosolan. Două varietăți: fără păr (lipsa părului pe tot corpul) și cu păr (acoperit complet). La varietatea nudă, dentiția e aproape mereu incompletă, legată de alopecia congenitală.
identity.important_proportions: Înălțime : lungime = 1:1 (femelele ceva mai lungi).
identity.ideal_type_summary: Câine zvelt și elegant, al cărui aspect exprimă viteză, forță și armonie fără a fi grosolan.
identity.historical_summary: Câinele nud peruan a stârnit curiozitate în epoci diverse. Civilizații pre-incase (Vicus, Mochica, Chancay, Chimú) i-au atribuit proprietăți și l-au reprezentat pe ceramică, uneori în locul pumei, șarpelui ori șoimului. Apare între cca 300 î.Hr. și 1460 d.Hr.

anatomy.head: De conformație lupoidă.
anatomy.skull: Mezocefal, ortoid (axe cranio-faciale paralele; se admite o ușoară divergență). De sus, amplu, se îngustează spre trufă. Arcade sprâncenare moderate; creastă occipitală abia marcată.
anatomy.muzzle: Din profil, nas drept. Trufă bine pigmentată, în armonie cu pielea (nud) ori mantaua (cu păr). Buze cât mai întinse și aderente.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Mușcătură în foarfece. La varietatea nudă, lipsa unuia ori mai multor dinți e acceptată. La cu păr, dentiție completă. Mandibulă nu foarte dezvoltată.
anatomy.eyes: Expresie trează și inteligentă. De mărime medie, ușor migdalați, nici înfundați, nici ieșiți; normal distanțați. Culoare de la negru la galben, în armonie cu pielea/mantaua; ambii de aceeași culoare. Pleoape de la negru la roz la subiecții deschiși.
anatomy.ears: Ridicate la atenție, spre spate în repaus. De lungime medie, late la bază, se îngustează spre vârf aproape ascuțit. La atenție, unghi 50–90°.
anatomy.neck: Linie superioară convexă; cca de lungimea capului; în formă de trunchi de con sinuos, bine musculat.
anatomy.topline: Dreaptă (unii au o convexitate dorso-lombară care dispare la crupă).
anatomy.body: Mezomorf.
anatomy.chest: Din față de bună amplitudine fără exces; coboară cel puțin la cot. Coaste ușor arcuite, niciodată plate. Perimetrul toracic (în spatele coților) depășește cu cca 18% înălțimea.
anatomy.tail: Inserată jos. Groasă la rădăcină, se subțiază spre vârf. Agitat, o poate purta ridicată rotunjit peste linia dorsală, dar niciodată răsucită; în repaus pendulă, cu o ușoară curbură în sus. Ajunge aproape la jaret. Trebuie să fie întreagă.
anatomy.forequarters: Bine unite la corp; din față verticale, coți nedeviați. Unghi umăr 100–120°; din profil 15–20°.
anatomy.hindquarters: Mușchi rotunjiți și elastici; curba fesei bine marcată. Unghi coxo-femural 120–130°, femuro-tibial 140°. Din spate verticali.
anatomy.feet: Semi-lungi, de iepure. Perinițe puternice, rezistente la căldură. Membrane interdigitale dezvoltate. Unghii negre la închiși, mai deschise la deschiși.
anatomy.movement: Pas mai degrabă scurt dar rapid, cu totul elastic. Din față și spate, membrele pe o singură linie (single tracking).
anatomy.coat: Fără păr: manta inexistentă; se admit resturi de păr pe cap, extremitățile membrelor și coadă, uneori fire rare pe spate. Toate culorile. Cu păr: neted, scurt și aderent; toate culorile.
anatomy.color: La varietatea nudă, pielea în toată gama de negru (ardezie, elefant, albăstrui), gri (negru diluat), albastru genetic, maro-închis până la blond deschis; uniforme ori cu pete albe/rozalii (sub 1/3 din suprafață). Unicolorul preferat.
anatomy.size: Trei talii: Mică 25–40 cm (4–8 kg); Medie 41–50 cm (8–12 kg); Mare 51–65 cm (12–30 kg).
anatomy.skin: Fină, netedă și elastică, aderentă. Fără salbă.

temperament.behavior: Nobil și afectuos în casă, cu familia; totodată vioi și atent; precaut și bun paznic față de străini.
temperament.temperament_notes: Masculii trebuie să aibă doi testiculi de aspect normal, complet coborâți în scrot. Doar subiecții sănătoși și tipici pot fi folosiți la reproducere.

minor: Lipsa PM1 la varietatea cu păr
Pete albe ori roz peste 1/3 din suprafață la varietatea nudă
disqualifying: Subiect agresiv ori excesiv de timid
Peste un dinte lipsă la varietatea cu păr
Lipsa cozii, coadă scurtă ori amputată

identity.historical_function: Câine de vânătoare vigilent și pasionat, care vânează la miros și la vedere. Pe distanțe scurte folosește foarte bine și auzul.
identity.general_impression: De talie medie, cu port nobil și linii net desenate. Elegant, dar puternic. Foarte rapid, cu mișcare foarte fluidă și expresie trează.
identity.ideal_type_summary: De talie medie, cu port nobil și linii net desenate.

anatomy.head: Botul ceva mai lung decât craniul. Axele cranio-faciale paralele; din profil și de sus, ansamblul capului are formă de pană teșită.
anatomy.skull: Lung, uscat și bine cizelat.
anatomy.muzzle: Trufă doar culoarea ficatului, în armonie cu mantaua.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Fălci puternice cu dinți puternici. Mușcătură în foarfece, cu dinții implantați perpendicular pe fălci.
anatomy.eyes: Culoarea chihlimbarului, se asortează cu mantaua. Ovali, moderat înfundați în orbite, cu expresie acută și inteligentă.
anatomy.ears: Inserate la înălțime medie. Purtate ridicate când câinele e atent, rămânând foarte mobile. Largi la bază, fine și lungi.
anatomy.neck: Lung, uscat, musculos și ușor arcuit. Linia gâtului curată.
anatomy.body: Agil, cu linie superioară aproape dreaptă. Lungimea corpului (de la vârful umărului la vârful șoldului) ceva peste înălțimea la greabăn. Crupă ușor coborâtă spre inserția cozii. Torace adânc; coboară până la vârful coților; coaste bine arcuite. Ventre moderat retras.
anatomy.tail: Inserată la înălțime medie, destul de groasă la bază, se subțiază spre vârf (de bici); în repaus depășește puțin vârful jaretului. În acțiune e purtată sus și curbată. Nu se poartă strânsă între picioare. Coada în tirbușon nu e de dorit.
anatomy.forequarters: Drepți și paraleli. Omoplat puternic, lung și bine înclinat spre spate. Coți bine aderenți. Metacarpi puternici.
anatomy.hindquarters: Puternici și musculoși. Membre paralele din spate. Genunchi moderat unghiat. Gambă bine dezvoltată.
anatomy.feet: Puternici, bine arcuiți și fermi, nedeviați. Perinițe bine căptușite. Pintenii pot fi îndepărtați.
anatomy.movement: Fluidă și curgătoare; capul purtat mai degrabă sus, câinele acoperă mult teren fără efort aparent. Picioarele se mișcă în linie cu axul median al corpului. Foarte nedorită orice tendință de a arunca picioarele lateral ori un mers de cocostârc.
anatomy.coat: Scurt și lucios, variind de la fin și des la un păr ușor aspru. Fără franjuri.
anatomy.color: Maro-roșcat până la maro-roșcat intens, cu pete albe permise: pe vârful cozii (foarte căutată), pe piept (numită stea), pe degete; se admite o dungă subțire pe linia centrală a feței. Muscături ori alb în alte zone nu sunt de dorit.
anatomy.size: Masculi ideal 56 cm (56–63,5 cm); femele ideal 53 cm (53–61 cm).

temperament.behavior: Treaz, inteligent, prietenos, afectuos și jucăuș.
temperament.temperament_notes: Masculii trebuie să aibă doi testiculi de aspect normal, complet coborâți în scrot.

identity.historical_function: Is used for rabbit hunting, and to that end, adapts perfectly to the many irregularities of the terrain by using his prodigious nose, his sight and hearing. He endures easily high temperatures and is capable of hunting from dawn to nightfall. Thanks to his nose and his hearing, he can also detect the presence of rabbits at the bottom of natural crevices of the terrain, in cracks in walls, in the heaps of stones at the edges of ploughed fields, in the volcanic tubes and in the thorny bushes. His extraordinary survival is no doubt due to his gifts as a hunter which have made him irreplaceable during the centuries. He is mainly a tracker dog who must neither bark nor catch the game during his scenting work. Is also used in hunting, combined with the ferret, method of hunting authorised on the islands. He usually takes the rabbits in his mouth.
identity.general_impression: It is a dog of medium size, built on longish lines, slender, light and extremely resistant. The skeleton is well developed. The absence of layers of fat make it possible to see the rib cage as well as the spinal column and the hip bones. The musculature is developed to the highest degree, lean, the contractions of the muscles are visible through the skin.
identity.important_proportions: Slightly longer than high. Chest well developed without coming down to the elbow. Muzzle slightly longer than the skull.
identity.ideal_type_summary: It is a dog of medium size, built on longish lines, slender, light and extremely resistant.
identity.historical_summary: On the Canary Islands, from where he originates, he is known under the name of Podenco Canario. We meet him frequently on all the islands, especially on the biggest, on the Gran Canary Island and the Isle of Teneriffe. The Podenco Canario is a dog of Egyptian origin which was probably imported to the Canary Islands by the Phoenicians, the Greeks, the Carthaginians and the Egyptians themselves. It is one of the most ancient breeds in existence, because we find numerous vestiges (engravings, statues, bas-reliefs) in the tombs of the Pharaohs and in the museums of the Louvre or the British Museum. This breed dates back about seven thousand years.
identity.classification: Section 7 Primitive type-Hunting Dogs. Without working trial.

anatomy.head: Elongated, truncated cone shape, well in proportion with the body, of medium length of 21 to 22 cm. The cranial-facial axes are parallel.
anatomy.skull: Longer than wide, flat, with the occipital crest prominent.
anatomy.muzzle: Large and prominent, in shape of a blunt cone, more or less dark flesh colour in harmony with the coat. Nose: Large, flesh-coloured in harmony with the colour of the coat. Nostrils moderately open. Lips: Fine and tight, of a colour in harmony with the nose.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Scissor bite, teeth adapting perfectly, well developed.
anatomy.eyes: Oblique, small, almond-shaped. More or less dark amber in colour; the intensity depends on the colour of the coat. The expression is intelligent and full of nobleness.
anatomy.ears: Quite big, they rise up when the dog is in a state of excitation and are pricked in a slightly divergent position. At rest, they tip backwards. They are broad at their set on, ending in a point.
anatomy.neck: Well muscled, straight, with smooth skin and without dewlap, flexible and rounded.
anatomy.topline: Strong, musculature well developed, fit for the racing and the demands of the hunt.
anatomy.body: Back: Strong, musculature well developed, fit for the racing and the demands of the hunt. Loin: A little elongated. Croup: Bones of the rump quite solid, more visible in the thin subjects or in full hunting season. Chest: The sternum is not protruding. Chest well developed, yet does not come down to the elbow. Ribs oval. The thoracic perimeter exceeds the height at the withers by 5 to 8 cm. Underline and belly : Drawn up, without being as whippety as the Galgo. Flanks well marked.
anatomy.chest: The sternum is not protruding. Chest well developed, yet does not come down to the elbow. Ribs oval. The thoracic perimeter exceeds the height at the withers by 5 to 8 cm.
anatomy.tail: Rather low set, appears as an extension of the rump. Round, reaches only a little lower than the hock. Hanging, or raised in sickle shape. A little tapered at the tip, which is usually white. Is never rolled up. It is not desirable it be carried too high when moving.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: Perfectly vertical, straight and parallel; bone structure fine but solid; feet in shape of cat-feet, generally slightly turned outwards. Pads firm, slightly oval. Angulations: Scapula-humeral angle : about 110°. Humeral-radial angle : about 140°.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: Well vertical, straight, robust; musculature well developed; hock quite high (about 18 cm from the ground); cat-feet really straight, pads firm and oval shaped. No dewclaws. Angulations: Coxal-femoral angle : about 110°. Femoral-tibial angle : about 120°. Angle of the hock : about 130°.
anatomy.movement: The trot must be agile, extended and very light.
anatomy.coat: Smooth, short and dense. Colour: Preferably red and white, the red may be more or less intense, going from orange to dark red (mahogany). All combinations of these colours.
anatomy.color: Preferably red and white, the red may be more or less intense, going from orange to dark red (mahogany). All combinations of these colours.
anatomy.size: Height at withers: For males: from 55 to 64 cm, for females: from 53 to 60 cm. Because of the differences of configuration of the terrains where the dog lives and hunts, these average sizes may vary; so one may accept deviations of 2 cm above the maximum size and 2 cm below the minimal size, as long as the subjects in question correspond to the archetype of the breed.
anatomy.skin: Firm, adheres without folds to the body.

temperament.behavior: Courageous, nervy, agitated, and of an enthusiastic dynamism. Imposing but not at all aggressive. Attached with abnegation to his master, he stoically puts up with the most rigorous days without the least sign of fatigue.
temperament.temperament_notes: • Male animals should have two apparently normal testicles fully descended into the scrotum. • Only functionally and clinically healthy dogs, with breed typical conformation should be used for breeding.

serious: Crossing of the fore and hindlegs at the walk
disqualifying: Any dog clearly showing physical of behavioural abnormalities

identity.historical_function: The Podenco Ibicenco is mainly used for hunting rabbits without guns, by day and at night. Thanks to his particularly good scenting ability, which, coupled with hearing, he uses more than sight, he scents and hunts out rabbits with ease, even in dense cover. Nimble and bright, he catches his prey quickly, specially when hunting together with other dogs. When one dog indicates game, he is surrounded by all the others, which keep a certain distance and stand in wait. They bark only when they see or hear the game and when they have surrounded it. Both when indicating and catching game, all dogs wag their tail fast, but are easily put off their waiting attitude. The Podenco Ibicenco is also used for hunting hare and large game. He is a good retriever. With certain exceptions only bitches are used for the formation of a pack or, at most, with one male only, as the latter do not work together during a hunt and are quarrelsome. When a pack has caught several thousand rabbits, it can happen with this breed, that some dogs from the same pack no longer want to hunt until they have had a considerable rest. The Spanish expression « enconillarse » (go to rest) refers to this peculiarity.
identity.important_proportions: The distance from the tip of the muzzle to the eyes is equal to that from the eyes to the occiput.
identity.ideal_type_summary: This breed originates in the Balearic Islands of Majorca, Ibiza, Minorca and Formentera, where it is known by the original name of « Ca Eivissec ».
identity.historical_summary: This breed originates in the Balearic Islands of Majorca, Ibiza, Minorca and Formentera, where it is known by the original name of « Ca Eivissec ». It is also widely found in Catalonia, round Valencia, in the Roussillon and in the Provence, where it is known by the names Mallorquí, Xarnelo, Mayorquais, Charnegue, Charnegui and Balearic Dog. Probably these dogs were brought to the islands by the Phoenecians, Carthaginians and eventually also the Romans. This dog is a typical primitive and robust representative of one of the oldest still existing breeds. Illustrations of these dogs are found in the graves of the Pharaohs and on objects in museums, so that the existence of the breed can already be proved in the year 3400 BC.
identity.classification: Section 7 Primitive type-Hunting dogs. Without working trial.

anatomy.head: Seen as a whole, the long, fine head has the appearance of a cone cut off near its base; completely dry, rather small in relation to body.
anatomy.skull: Long and flat (dolichocephalic). Occipital bone protruding. Forehead fine and flat.
anatomy.muzzle: Nasal bridge and nose protrude over lower jaw; fine, long and according to colour of coat, flesh colour. Nose: Nose leather flesh colour. Nostrils open. Nasal bridge slightly arched. Lips: Thin,close fitting, flesh colour.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Perfect fitting bite, scissor bite, white and regular.
anatomy.eyes: Slanting, small, light amber colour, reminiscent of caramel colour. The amber colour can be more or less intensive according to coat colour. Without seeming very noble, the expression shows intelligence but also fear and mistrust.
anatomy.ears: Always stiff, very mobile. Pointing forward or sideways in a horizontal plane or held backwards. Upright when dog is animated. The center of the ear set on is level with the eyes. The shape is that of an elongated rhomboid, which has been cut off by a third of its long diagonal. They are fine without hair on the inside of the ear opening; of medium, not exaggerated size.
anatomy.neck: Very dry, both in its upper and lower part. Its length is a quarter the length of the body, slightly arched and muscular. Skin is taut, smooth, without dewlap. Normally, the coat is longer and denser in the region of the set on to the body, especially in the smooth variety.
anatomy.topline: Long, straight and pliable. Muscles strong, yet flat. Loins: Arched, of medium breadth, strong and firm.
anatomy.body: Regarded as a whole, the body is symmetric, slightly convex and of medium, even proportions, compact and slightly longer than heigh, without the differences being laid down exactly. Withers: Well defined, high, dry and long. Back: Long, straight and pliable. Muscles strong, yet flat. Loins: Arched, of medium breadth, strong and firm. Croup: Strongly sloping with bone structure visible; it shows very strong, hard muscles. Chest: Deep, narrow and long, but not reaching to the elbows. Forechest pointed and strongly protruding. Ribs flat. Underline and belly : Tucked up, but not too much.
anatomy.chest: Deep, narrow and long, but not reaching to the elbows. Forechest pointed and strongly protruding. Ribs flat.
anatomy.tail: Set on low; there should be some longer and coarser, slightly offstanding hairs (like ears of grain) towards the tip; long. When the tail is pulled through between the legs, it should reach the spine. Slightly thicker at set on, gradually tapering towards the tip. Hanging naturally in repose; in movement carried in sickle shape more or less tightly curved. Preferably not carried upright or too much curled over back.
anatomy.forequarters: Vertical, symmetric. Seen from front, the position of the front legs is very close together; altogether sturdy, with long limbs which give the impression of a slim, fast, yet strong animal. Shoulder: Shoulder blades slanting, strong and freely mobile. Upper arm: Very long, straight, strong and very close in position. Elbow: Broad, set well apart from the body, parallel to the median plane of the body, but never loose. Forearm: Broadening towards front pastern. Pastern: Strong, firm, broad and well upright. Forefeet: Almost harefoot. Toes long and close together. Profuse hair in space between toes; nails very strong and normally white, occasionally according to coat colour. Pads very hard.
anatomy.hindquarters: Vertical with long, strong, flat muscles. Hock: Well angulated, broad, set low, vertical, turning neither out nor in. Hind feet: Almost harefoot. Toes long and close together. Profuse hair in space between toes; nails very strong and normally white, occasionally according to coat colour. Pads very hard.
anatomy.feet: Almost harefoot. Toes long and close together. Profuse hair in space between toes; nails very strong and normally white, occasionally according to coat colour. Pads very hard. Almost harefoot. Toes long and close together. Profuse hair in space between toes; nails very strong and normally white, occasionally according to coat colour. Pads very hard.
anatomy.movement: The preferred movement is a suspended trot. Gallop is very fast and gives the impression of great agility.
anatomy.coat: Smooth rough or long hair. • The smooth should not be silky, but strong and shiny. • The rough should be hard and very dense, somewhat shorter on head and ears and somewhat longer on rear of thighs and underside of tail. A beard is highly valued. The longhair is softer and should have at least a length of 5 cm. The head is very densely coated. Colour: Preferred are white and red, or entirely white or red. Fawn dogs are permitted, provided it is an exceptionally good specimen ; in smooth coats, however, this colour is not permitted.
anatomy.color: Preferred are white and red, or entirely white or red. Fawn dogs are permitted, provided it is an exceptionally good specimen ; in smooth coats, however, this colour is not permitted.
anatomy.size: Dogs: 66 to 72 cm. Bitches: 60 to 67 cm. Without undue strictness, dogs which are close to the required measurements can be accepted, provided they are well proportioned and aesthetic.
anatomy.skin: Taut, close fitting to body; reddish pigment, but may be a different colour where coat colour differs.

anatomy.head: Uscată, în formă de piramidă cu patru laturi și bază largă, care se îngustează sensibil spre un vârf ascuțit. Axele longitudinale ale craniului și botului divergente.

anatomy.jaws_teeth: Fălci regulate, cu dinți albi și solizi; închidere normală.
anatomy.eyes: Cu expresie foarte vioaie; abia ieșiți; de la culoarea mierii la castaniu, în armonie cu mantaua; mici și dispuși oblic; pleoape mai închise decât mantaua.
anatomy.ears: Inserate la înălțime medie și oblic; ridicate și foarte mobile, purtate verticale spre înainte când câinele e atent; triunghiulare, largi la bază, terminate în vârf; pavilion subțire; lungimea urechii apreciabil peste lățimea la inserție.
anatomy.neck: Trecere armonioasă de la cap la trunchi; gât drept, adecvat de lung, puternic și foarte musculos; fără salbă.

anatomy.tail: Inserată mai degrabă sus decât jos; puternică, groasă, de lungime medie, se subțiază spre vârf. În repaus cade între posteriori, cu vârful desenând o ușoară curbă în sus. În acțiune purtată orizontal cu o ușoară curbă ori ridicată vertical în seceră; niciodată răsucită în inel.

anatomy.movement: Rapidă și ușoară.
anatomy.coat: Neted și scurt ori aspru și lung, în funcție de varietate.
anatomy.color: Predomină galbenul, fulvo (în toate tonurile, de la deschis la foarte închis) și negru (opac ori decolorat); manta unicolor cu ori fără pete albe, ori alb ca fond cu pete de culorile de mai sus.

anatomy.skin: Mucoase de preferat negre, oricum mai închise decât mantaua. Piele fină, bine aderentă la corp.

temperament.behavior: Foarte vioi și inteligent, cu puține pretenții și robust.

identity.historical_function: Hunting dog for all-round purposes.
identity.general_impression: Medium sized dog; of medium to strong built. The overall impression is that of a square built dog, the length of the body (point of shoulders to point of buttocks) being equal to the height at the withers; however, the length of the body may be slightly superior to the height at the withers. The muscles are lean and well developed. Strong bone structure. Sexual dimorphism is clearly pronounced.
identity.important_proportions: Males square to almost square and females slightly longer. Index of format (height/length): males: 100/100-103 females: 100/100-105. The height at the withers exceeds the height at the croup by 1-2 cm in males and it is equal to or exceeds the height at the croup by 1 cm in females. The length of the muzzle is a little less than half the length of the head. The distance from ground to elbow is slightly more than the distance from withers to elbow.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Medium sized dog; of medium to strong built.
identity.historical_summary: This is a Russian breed of hunting dogs from the European forest areas of Russia. The first record about northern ear-pointed dogs was published by A. A. Shirinsky-Shikhmatov in the “Album of northern sledge dogs-laikas” in 1895. The dogs mentioned therein were named Cheremis and Zyrianskiy Laikas. The breed was limited to the regions of Komi, Udmurtia, Arkhangelsk, Yaroslavl, Tver, Moscow and some other areas of Russia. In 1947 the off-spring of Arkhangelsk, Komi, Karelia, Votiatsk and other Laikas were united into one breed under the modern name of: – Russian-European Laika. The breed standard for Russian-European Laika as a purebred dog was approved in 1952. The correct modern type of Russian-European Laika, as a recognized purebred dog, was not achieved by breeding different Laikas off-spring; it is the result of selective breeding over a long period of time
identity.classification: Section 2 Nordic hunting dogs. With working trial.

The height of the forelegs from the elbow to the ground is slightly superior to half the height at the withers. Shoulder: Shoulder blades are long and well laid back. Upper arm: Long, well placed back, muscular. The angulations between the shoulder blade and the upper arm is well pronounced. Elbow: Fitting close to the body; elbows are well developed and placed backwards, parallel to the body axis. Forearm: Straight, lean, muscular, of oval-cross section, viewed from the front moderately wide and parallel. Metacarpus (Pastern): Short, slightly sloping when viewed from the side. Seen from the side, a perpendicular line, from the buttocks to ground, should fall close to the front of the rear pastern. The presence of dewclaws is not desirable. Hind feet: Oval, arched with tight toes.
anatomy.feet: Oval, arched with tight toes. Oval, arched with tight toes. Oval, arched with tight toes.

The coat on the shoulders and the neck is longer than on the body and forms a collar; on the cheekbones it forms side-whiskers. The coat on the withers is also slightly longer, especially in males. Limbs are covered with short, harsh, dense coat, which is a little longer on the back side of limbs. The coat on the rear legs forms trousers without feathering. There is a protective growth of hair between the toes. The tail is profusely covered with straight and harsh hair which is a little bit longer on the underside but without feathering. identity.historical_function: Sledge- and companion dog.
identity.general_impression: Medium in size, elegant, a white Arctic Spitz. In appearance gives the impression of power, endurance, charm, suppleness, dignity and self-confidence. The expression, the so called « Samoyed Smile », is made up of a combination of eye shape and position, and the slightly curved up corners of the mouth. The sex should be clearly stamped.
identity.important_proportions: The length of the body is approximately 5% more than the height at the withers. The depth of the body is slightly less than the half of the height at the withers. The muzzle is approximately as long as the skull.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Medium in size, elegant, a white Arctic Spitz.
identity.historical_summary: The name Samoyed derives from the Samoyed Tribes in Northern Russia and Siberia. In Southern parts of the area they used white, black and brown parti-coloured dogs as reindeer herders; in the northern parts the dogs were pure white, had a mild temperament and were used as hunting-and sledge dogs. The Samoyed dogs lived close to their owners, they even slept within the shelters and were used as heaters. The British zoologist Ernest Kilburn Scott spent three months among Samoyed Tribes in 1889. Returning to England he brought with him a brown male puppy called « Sabarka ». Later he imported a cream coloured bitch called « Whitey Petchora » from the western side of the Urals and a snow white male called « Musti » from Siberia. These few dogs and those brought by the explorers are the base for the western Samoyed. The first standard was written in England in 1909.
identity.classification: Section 1 Nordic sledge dogs. Without working trial.

anatomy.tail: Set rather high. When the dog is alert and in motion the tail is carried bent from the root forward over the back or side, but may be hanging at rest, then reaching to the hocks.

anatomy.feet: Oval with long toes, flexible and pointing straight forward. Toes arched and not too tightly knit. Elastics pads. As front feet. The dewclaws should be removed (except in countries where it is forbidden by law).
anatomy.movement: Powerful, free and tireless in appearance with long stride. Good reach in the forequarters and good driving power in the hindquarters.
anatomy.coat: Profuse, thick, flexible and dense polar coat. The Samoyed is a double coated dog with short, soft and dense undercoat and longer, harsher and straight outer coat. The coat should form a ruff around the neck and shoulders framing the head, especially in males. On head and on front of legs, hair is short and smooth; on outside of ears short, standing off and smooth. Inside the ears should be well furred. On back of the thighs the hair forms trousers. There should be a protective growth of hair between the toes. The tail should be profusely covered with hair. The coat of the female is often shorter and softer in texture than that of the male. The correct coat texture should always have a special glistening sheen. Colour: Pure white, cream or white with biscuit. (The basic colour to be white with a few biscuit markings.) Should never give the impression of being pale brown.

identity.historical_summary: The Shiba has been a native breed to Japan since the primitive ages. The word « Shiba » originally refers to something « small », a « small dog ». The Shiba’s habitat was in the mountainous area facing the Sea of Japan and was used as a hunting dog for small animals and birds. There were slight differences in the breeds according to the areas where they were raised. As dogs like English Setters and English Pointers were imported from England during the period of 1868-1912, hunting became a sport in Japan and crossbreeding of the Shiba with those English dogs became prevalent and a pure Shiba became rare so that by 1912-1926 pure Shibas confined to these areas became exceedingly scarce. Hunters and other educated persons became concerned with the preservation of the pure Shibas from around 1928 and the preservation of the limited number of pure strains began seriously, and the breed standard was finally unified in 1934. In 1937 the Shiba was designated as a « natural monument » after which the breed was bred and improved to become the breed known today.

identity.historical_summary: Rasa provine din câini de talie medie existenți în Japonia din vremuri îndepărtate. Shikoku era crescut ca și câine de vânătoare, mai ales pentru mistreț, în regiunile muntoase ale prefecturii Kochi (numit uneori „Kochi Ken”). Avea trei varietăți — Awa, Hongawa și Hata — după zona de creștere. Hongawa a păstrat cel mai înalt grad de puritate, zona fiind greu accesibilă. Câini tenaci și agili pentru munte, cu manta caracteristică sesam. A luat numele regiunii și a fost declarat „monument natural” în 1937.

identity.historical_function: Câine de sanie.
identity.general_impression: Câine de lucru de talie medie, sprinten și ușor pe picioare, fluid și grațios în mișcare. Corpul moderat de compact și bogat în păr, urechile ridicate și coada în perie îi trădează originea nordică. Pasul caracteristic e regulat și fără efort evident. Își îndeplinește optim funcția originară de câine de tracțiune ușoară, la viteză moderată, pe distanțe lungi. Formele și proporțiile reflectă echilibrul de forță, viteză și rezistență. Masculii sunt masculini fără a fi grosolani; femelele feminine fără slăbiciuni de structură. Nu e niciodată excesiv de greu.
identity.important_proportions: Din profil, lungimea corpului (de la vârful umărului la vârful posterior al crupei) ceva peste înălțime. Distanța de la vârful trufei la stop egală cu cea de la stop la occiput.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Câine de lucru de talie medie, sprinten și ușor pe picioare, fluid și grațios în mișcare.

anatomy.skull: De mărime medie, proporționat cu corpul; ușor rotunjit la creștet, se îngustează de la punctul cel mai lat spre ochi.
anatomy.muzzle: De lungime și lățime medie, se subțiază treptat spre trufă; vârful nici ascuțit, nici pătrat. Nasul drept de la stop la vârf. Trufă neagră la câinii negri, gri, zibelină ori agouti; culoarea ficatului la cei roșii; neagră, ficat ori culoarea cărnii la cei complet albi. Se acceptă și „trufa de zăpadă” cu dungă mai deschisă. Buze bine pigmentate și foarte aderente.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Mușcătură în foarfece.
anatomy.eyes: Migdalați, moderat distanțați și ceva oblici. Pot fi maro ori albaștri; se admite heterocromia. Expresie pătrunzătoare, dar prietenoasă, interesată și niciodată rea.
anatomy.ears: De mărime medie, triunghiulari, apropiați și inserați sus pe cap. Groși, bine acoperiți cu păr, ușor arcuiți la spate și bine ridicați, cu vârfuri ușor rotunjite îndreptate în sus.
anatomy.neck: De lungime medie, arcuit și purtat mândru ridicat în stațiune. În mișcare, la trap, gâtul e extins, capul purtat ușor înainte.
anatomy.topline: Dreaptă și puternică, orizontală de la greabăn la crupă. De lungime medie, nici „cobby”, nici relaxat prin lungime excesivă.
anatomy.body: Spate drept și puternic, linie superioară orizontală de la greabăn la crupă. Șale întinse și uscate, mai înguste decât toracele și ușor retrase. Crupă înclinată, dar niciodată atât de căzută încât să limiteze impulsul posterior. Torace coborât și puternic, dar nu prea amplu, cu punctul cel mai jos la nivelul cotului. Coaste bine arcuite lângă coloană, dar aplatizate pe flancuri pentru o mișcare fluidă.
anatomy.chest: Coborât și puternic, dar nu prea amplu, cu punctul cel mai jos la nivelul cotului. Coaste bine arcuite lângă coloană, aplatizate pe flancuri.
anatomy.tail: Bine acoperită cu păr, în perie ca a vulpii, inserată chiar sub linia spatelui și purtată deasupra ei într-o curbă grațioasă în seceră când câinele e atent. Purtată sus, nu se răsucește pe flancuri, nici nu se aplatizează pe spate. În repaus atârnă normal. Părul e de lungime medie, aproximativ egal deasupra, lateral și dedesubt, dând aspectul unei perii rotunde.
anatomy.forequarters: Din față, moderat distanțați, paraleli și drepți. Osatura de substanță, dar niciodată grea. Lungimea membrelor (cot–sol) ceva peste distanța cot–greabăn. Pintenii anteriori pot fi îndepărtați.
anatomy.hindquarters: Din spate, moderat distanțați și paraleli. Pintenii, dacă există, se îndepărtează.
anatomy.feet: Ovali, dar nu lungi. De mărime medie, compacți, cu mult păr între degete și perinițe dure și groase. În poziție naturală, nedeviați.
anatomy.movement: Caracteristic regulat și aparent fără efort. Rapid și ușor pe picioare, condus cu lesa slăbită la un trap moderat de rapid, cu bun alungit al anteriorilor și bun impuls al posteriorilor. Din față, la pas nu merge pe single-track, dar la viteză membrele se înclină treptat spre interior până picioarele cad pe linia axului longitudinal. Linia spatelui rămâne fermă și orizontală.
anatomy.coat: Dublu și de lungime medie, cu aspect bogat, dar niciodată atât de lung încât să mascheze profilul net. Subpăr moale și des, de lungime suficientă să susțină mantaua de acoperire. Părul de gardă drept și mai degrabă culcat pe corp, niciodată aspru ori zbârlit. Absența subpărului în perioada năpârlirii e normală. Se admite ajustarea mustăților și a părului dintre degete; tunderea altor părți e sever penalizată.
anatomy.color: Toate gamele permise: negru, gri, agouti, zibelină, roșu și alb. Poate fi unicolor, cu mai multe nuanțe ori cu pete albe. Variate desene simetrice ori asimetrice, inclusiv pestriț. Nicio preferință pentru vreo culoare ori desen permis. Desenele merle și brindat nu sunt admise și se descalifică.
anatomy.size: Masculi 53,5–60 cm; femele 50,5–56 cm. Masculi 20,5–28 kg; femele 15,5–23 kg. Greutatea proporțională cu înălțimea. Osatura ori greutatea excesivă se penalizează.

temperament.behavior: Prietenos și blând, dar și treaz și extrovertit. Nu are atitudinea posesivă a câinelui de pază, nici nu e prea suspicios cu străinii ori agresiv cu alți câini. La adulți se poate aștepta oarecare rezervă și demnitate. Inteligența, docilitatea și dispoziția pasionată fac din el un companion plăcut și un lucrător voluntar.
temperament.temperament_notes: Masculii trebuie să aibă doi testiculi de aspect normal, complet coborâți în scrot. Doar subiecții sănătoși și tipici pot fi folosiți la reproducere.

minor: Cap greoi ori prea fin cizelat
Bot prea ascuțit ori grosolan, prea scurt ori prea lung
Orice altă mușcătură în afara foarfecelui
Ochi prea oblici ori prea apropiați

Genunchi drept, jarete de vacă, posterior prea închis ori deschis

identity.historical_function: Originally a herder and watch dog used in work of keeping reindeer. Today also popular as a companion dog.
identity.general_impression: Smaller than medium sized. Strongly built for his size, slightly longer than the height at the withers. The coat is long and dense.
identity.important_proportions: The depth of chest is approximately half of the height at the withers. The muzzle is slightly shorter than the skull. The skull is slightly longer than its width, the depth is the same as the width.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Smaller than medium sized.
identity.historical_summary: For hundreds of years the Sami people have used dogs of the same type as Finnish Lapponian Dog as reindeer herders and watchdogs in the northern parts of Fennoscandia and Russia. The first standard of the Lapponian Herder was established by the Finnish Kennel Club in 1945. The breed´s name was changed into Lapponian Dog in 1967. In the 1970:s the type and the characteristics of the breed became stabilized, the standard has been revised several times. The breed name was again changed into Finnish Lapponian Dog in 1993. The breed type has become homogeneous in a short time and today the breed is very popular mainly as a companion and utility dog in the whole of Finland.
identity.classification: Section 3.4 Nordic Watchdogs and Herders. Without working trial.

anatomy.head: Strong in outline, rather broad.
anatomy.skull: Broad, the skull is slightly convex. The forehead is rather domed. The frontal furrow is clearly defined.
anatomy.muzzle: Strong, broad and straight; viewed from above and in profile evenly, but only slightly tapering. Nose: Black or brown, according to coat colour. Lips: Tight.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: The jaws are strong. Scissors bite.
anatomy.eyes: Oval shaped, dark brown, according to coat colour. The expression is soft and friendly.
anatomy.neck: Medium in length, strong and covered with profuse hair.
anatomy.topline: Strong and straight.
anatomy.body: Withers: Muscular and broad, only slightly pronounced. Back: Strong and straight. Loin: Short and muscular. Croup: Of medium length, well developed, only very slightly sloping. Chest: Deep, rather long, reaching almost to the elbows, not very broad. The ribs are slightly arched; the fore chest clearly visible, not very strong. Underline and belly: Only slightly tucked up.
anatomy.chest: Deep, rather long, reaching almost to the elbows, not very broad. The ribs are slightly arched; the fore chest clearly visible, not very strong.
anatomy.tail: Set rather high, medium in length, covered with profuse and long hair. The tip of the tail may have a J-formed hook. When moving the tail is curved over the back or side, in rest it may hang.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: Powerful with strong bones. Viewed from the front straight and parallel. Shoulders: Slightly oblique. Upper arms: As long as the shoulder blades. The angle between shoulder and upper arm is rather open. Elbows: Approximately at the level of the lower edge of the ribcage, pointing straight backwards. Forearms: Rather strong, vertical. Carpus: Flexible. Pasterns: Of medium length, slightly oblique. Forefeet: Well arched, oval rather than round, covered with dense hair. The pads are elastic. Dense hair between the pads.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: Strong boned, powerful, viewed from behind straight and parallel. The angulation is clearly marked with no exaggeration. Upper thigh: Of medium length, rather broad with well-developed muscles. Stifle: Parallel, rather well angulated. Second thigh: Relatively long and sinewy. Hocks: Moderately low, rather well angulated but not excessively. Metatarsus: Rather short, strong and vertical. Hind feet: As front feet.
anatomy.feet: Well arched, oval rather than round, covered with dense hair. The pads are elastic. Dense hair between the pads. As front feet.
anatomy.movement: Effortless. Changes easily from trot to gallop. The legs move parallel. When working agile and fast.
anatomy.coat: Profuse, especially the males have an abundant mane. The outer coat is long and harsh. On the head and on the front side of the legs the coat is shorter. There has to be an undercoat that is soft and dense. Colour: All colours are permitted. The basic colour must be dominant. Colours other than the basic colour can occur on head, neck, chest, underside of the body, on legs and tail.
anatomy.color: All colours are permitted. The basic colour must be dominant. Colours other than the basic colour can occur on head, neck, chest, underside of the body, on legs and tail.
anatomy.size: Height at the withers: Ideal height: males 49 cm and females 44 cm with a tolerance of 3 cm. The type is more important than the size.
anatomy.skin: Tight, without wrinkles.

temperament.behavior: Intelligent, courageous, calm and docile. Friendly and faithful.
temperament.temperament_notes: • Male animals should have two apparently normal testicles fully descended into the scrotum. • Only functionally and clinically healthy dogs, with breed typical conformation, should be used for breeding. The latest amendments are in bold characters.

minor: Over angulated or too straight rear angulation
Tail carriage continuously lower than the topline
disqualifying: Any dog clearly showing physical or behavioural abnormalities
