identity.historical_function: Copoi.
identity.general_impression: Copoi cu picioare scurte, de substanță considerabilă, bine echilibrat, cu mari calități. E un copoi de lucru — trebuie să fie puternic, activ și rezistent pe teren.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Copoi cu picioare scurte, de substanță considerabilă, bine echilibrat, cu mari calități.
identity.historical_summary: Se crede că Bassetul a fost crescut de călugări în Franța în Evul Mediu, pentru a vâna în subarboretul des cu trufa aproape de sol. Deși legat de întreaga familie a bassetilor francezi, rasa s-a dezvoltat și perfecționat în Marea Britanie. Vânează prada naturală — iepurele — cu tenacitate, în ritm relativ lent, pe distanțe mari.

anatomy.head: Poate avea puține riduri pe frunte și lângă ochi; pielea capului destul de elastică ca să formeze riduri ușoare când e trasă înainte ori când capul e coborât. Axe cranio-faciale aproape paralele; botul nu mult mai lung decât craniul.
anatomy.skull: În cupolă, cu creastă occipitală proeminentă; de lățime medie la frunte, se îngustează ușor spre bot.
anatomy.muzzle: Uscat în ansamblu, neascuțit. Trufă complet neagră (maro/ficat la mantale deschise), cu nări mari și deschise; poate depăși puțin buzele.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Fălci puternice, cu mușcătură în foarfece perfectă și completă.
anatomy.eyes: În formă de romb, nici ieșiți, nici înfundați, închiși (pot fi maro mediu la mantale deschise). Expresie calmă și serioasă. Ochii deschiși sau galbeni foarte nedoriți.
anatomy.ears: Inserate jos, chiar sub linia ochiului. Lungi, depășesc abia vârful unui bot corect. Înguste pe toată lungimea, bine răsucite în interior; foarte moi, fine și catifelate.
anatomy.neck: Musculos, bine arcuit și destul de lung, cu salbă pronunțată dar nu exagerată.
anatomy.body: Lung și bine coborât pe toată lungimea; greabăn și șale cam la aceeași înălțime. Spate destul de lat și orizontal, nu excesiv de lung. Șale pot fi ușor arcuite. Torace: din față, pieptul se potrivește perfect membrelor curbate; manubriul sternal proeminent, dar toracele nici îngust, nici excesiv de coborât; coaste bine arcuite, extinse spre spate.
anatomy.chest: Manubriu sternal proeminent; coaste bine arcuite și extinse spre spate; nici îngust, nici excesiv de coborât.
anatomy.tail: Bine inserată, destul de lungă; puternică la bază, se subțiază, cu păr aspru moderat pe partea inferioară. În mișcare purtată sus și curbată în sabie, niciodată răsucită.

identity.historical_function: In accordance with the hunting requirements as a specialist for the search of hoofed game, the Bavarian Mountain Scent Hound has to show all the of him required abilities to be useful for the more difficult search. This usefulness must be confirmed by the relevant working trials.
identity.general_impression: An altogether balanced, somewhat light, very mobile and muscular, medium size dog. The body is slightly longer than high, slightly higher at rear, standing on not too long legs. Head carried level or slightly upwards, tail level or slanting downwards.
identity.important_proportions: Height at withers should be in the proportion to length of back from 1: 1.15 to 1: 1,25; the chest should reach down to the elbow.
identity.ideal_type_summary: An altogether balanced, somewhat light, very mobile and muscular, medium size dog.
identity.historical_summary: All Liam Hounds (Leithunde) and Leashhounds (Schweisshunde) are descended from the original hunting dogs, the “Bracken”. All pure “Bracken” have the finest nose for following ground scent and trail; they are firm on scent, have a strongly developed will to follow a trail and are readily giving tongue on scent. Only the most reliable and perseverant Bracken were chosen from the pack to be used on the leash to search for the lost trail of the hunted game. From those most calm and biddable Bracken, the Liam Hounds (Leithunde, working only on natural, cold scent) and the “Scent Hounds” (Schweisshunde, the so called “spoilt Liam Hounds”, working the trial of wounded game) were later bred. Through crossing of genetically fairly close breeds at the end of the 18th and beginning of the 19th century, the present day Hanoverian Scenthound evolved. After the Revolution in 1848, in fact, after the break-up of the large hunting estates and the replacement of the previous hunting methods by stalking and hiding (waiting for the game) and at the same time with the improvement of the firearms, the dog was needed “after the shot”. Specialized in firmly working on the leash, one could not dispense with the loud chase, perseverance and keenness, especially in mountain regions. There the Hanovarian Scenthound proved too heavy. To achieve the desired accomplishments, even in difficult mountain territory, Baron Karg-Bebenburg, Reichenhall, bred the racy and ennobled lighter Mountain Scenthound after 1870, by crossing Hanovarian Scenthounds and red Mountain Scenthounds. More and more these dogs ousted other breeds from the mountain regions so that the Bavarian Mountain Scenthound is, today, the classical companion for the professional hunter and gamekeeper. In 1912 the Club for Bavarian Mountain Scenthounds was founded with its seat in Munich. It is the only recognized Club for Bavarian Mountain Scenthounds in Germany.
identity.classification: Section 2 Leash (Scent) hounds. With working trial, which take note of the relevant hunting requirements.

identity.historical_function: A pack scenthound bred to hunt hare by scent over long distances, working in company with great stamina and voice.
identity.general_impression: A sturdy, compact scenthound of quality, merry and active, conveying determination and stamina without coarseness.
identity.important_proportions: Compact and balanced; body slightly longer than tall, with strength appropriate to a working pack hound.
identity.sexual_dimorphism: Moderate; males somewhat stronger, females finer, both compact and workmanlike.
identity.ideal_type_summary: A compact, sound, merry pack scenthound built for stamina, with a good nose and clear hound character.
identity.historical_summary: The Beagle, said to have been bred down from the larger Foxhound to hunt with men on foot, preferably after the hare. He is still used in packs, very often organised by institutions, including colleges and schools. A bustling, eager little dog, full of enthusiasm and vigour, ever ready for any activity which involves him. Everything about the breed gives the impression of athleticism and there is no better sight than a Beagle pack in full pursuit, their heads down to the scent, their sterns up in rigid order as they concentrate on the chase. During the reigns of King Henry VIII and Queen Elizabeth I there were wirehaired Beagles, some of which were small enough to be carried in the pocket of a hunting jacket. Size has increased over the years but smaller versions of the breed, called ‘pocket Beagles’, are sometimes born.
identity.classification: Section 1.3 Small-sized Hounds. With working trial.

anatomy.head: Fairly long, powerful without coarseness, finer in the bitch, free from frown.
anatomy.skull: Slightly domed, moderately wide, with a slight peak.

anatomy.muzzle: Not snipey; lips reasonably well flewed.

anatomy.chest: Let down to below the elbow.

anatomy.hindquarters: Muscular thighs, well-bent stifles, low-set hocks, giving strong propulsion.
anatomy.feet: Tight and firm, well knuckled up, with strong pads.
anatomy.movement: Free, true and level; forward reach without high action, straight coming and going, with plenty of drive from behind.
anatomy.coat: Short, dense and weatherproof.

anatomy.muzzle: Lung cât craniul. Niciodată pătrat, cu profil fusiform fără a fi ascuțit. Nas destul de drept, niciodată berbecat. Trufă dezvoltată și neagră. Buze care acoperă maxilarul inferior.
anatomy.eyes: Bine deschiși, închiși; expresie sinceră, vie și inteligentă.
anatomy.ears: Destul de scurte și de mărime medie. Inserate pe linia ochiului, ușor rotunjite la mijloc, cad plate pe craniu, terminate într-un oval ușor.

identity.historical_function: Copoi care urmărește vânatul după miros și îl silește să se refugieze în copac; rezistă gerului și căldurii. Folosit mai ales la raton, dar și la căprior, urs, pumă și alt vânat mare.
identity.general_impression: Câine de lucru puternic, cu osatură moderat de grea și musculatură tonică; masculii mai dezvoltați decât femelele.
identity.important_proportions: Lungimea corpului egală sau puțin peste înălțimea la greabăn. Nici înalt, nici jos pe picioare.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Câine de lucru puternic, cu osatură moderat de grea și musculatură tonică; masculii mai dezvoltați decât femelele.
identity.historical_summary: Impresionează prin putere, agilitate și vivacitate; acoperă terenul cu pași puternici și ritmici. Cluburile cer arbitrilor să țină cont de aceste aptitudini de lucru la judecare.

anatomy.head: Net modelată; occiput–trufă 23–25,5 cm la masculi, 20–23 cm la femele. Expresie trează, prietenoasă și pasionată. Pielea fără cute. Trufă neagră, cu nări deschise. Buze bine dezvoltate, tipice copoilor.
anatomy.skull: Tinde spre oval; din profil, liniile craniului și botului aproape paralele.
anatomy.stop: Mediu pronunțat, la mijloc între trufă și occiput.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Dinți regulați, cu mușcătură în foarfece.
anatomy.eyes: De la alună la maro-închis, aproape rotunzi, neînfundați.
anatomy.ears: Inserate jos și spre spate, cad în cute grațioase, dând aspect maiestuos; depășesc vârful trufei; inserate la nivelul ochiului sau puțin mai jos.
anatomy.neck: Musculos, oblic, de lungime medie. Fără salbă excesivă.
anatomy.body: Spate orizontal, puternic și bine susținut. Torace ajunge cel puțin la coți; coaste bine dezvoltate, rotunde și arcuite.
anatomy.chest: Ajunge cel puțin la coți; coaste bine arcuite.
anatomy.tail: Inserată puțin sub linia dorsală, puternică, purtată liber; în acțiune formează un unghi aproape drept cu linia spatelui.
anatomy.forequarters: Drepte. Omoplați puternici. Coți nedeviați. Metacarpi puternici și verticali.
anatomy.hindquarters: Osatură bună, foarte musculoși; lungi și nervoși de la fesă la jaret, scurți și puternici de la jaret la perinițe. Genunchi și jarete bine unghiate, nedeviate.
anatomy.feet: Compacți, cu degete noduroase și arcuite, perinițe groase și puternice.
anatomy.movement: Din lateral, suplu și elegant, cu bună alungire și impuls. Din față și din spate, membrele merg drept, fără a încrucișa; la trap rapid tind spre linia mediană („single track”). Port mândru al capului și cozii; spate orizontal.
anatomy.coat: Scurt dar destul de des pentru intemperii.
anatomy.color: Negru cărbune cu focuri vii la ochi, pe laturile botului, piept, membre și culotă; mici semne pe degete.
anatomy.size: Masculi 63–68 cm; femele 58–63 cm. Depășirea limitei nu se penalizează dacă ansamblul e echilibrat și sănătos.

temperament.behavior: Echilibrat, sociabil și pașnic. Ca și copoi, trebuie să lucreze cu alți câini. Unii sunt rezervați, dar niciodată fricoși ori răi. Agresivitatea față de om ori câini e hotărât nedorită.

identity.historical_function: Well working scenthound, resistant and persistant, with a sonorous high sounding voice, sometimes deep-voiced.
identity.general_impression: Robust dog; its coat is long and shaggy; head long and moderately broad, eyebrows pronounced and bushy. The expression serious, severe but playful. The basic colour is reddish-yellow or earthy grey with white markings on the lower parts.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Robust dog; its coat is long and shaggy; head long and moderately broad, eyebrows pronounced and bushy.
identity.historical_summary: This breed was registered on the 19th June 1965, under Standard n° 155 and under the name of Illyrian Hound. In the present standard, apart from a few complements and corrections, the name of the breed is changed to « Bosnian Broken-Haired Hound - called Barak ».
identity.classification: Section 1.2 Medium sized Hounds. With working trial.

anatomy.head: General appearance: Seen in profile the occipital protuberance well pronounced, the forehead slightly convex, moderate stop, nasal bridge straight. Muzzle in rectangle shape, covered with a bushy moustache and beard. Seen from above the head is of medium width narrowing towards the nose. The muzzle is a little longer than the skull. The total length of the head is about 20 to 25 cm.
anatomy.skull: Superciliary arches very pronounced. Frontal furrow reveals itself to the touch as moderately developed.
anatomy.muzzle: Strong, long, deep, wider at the base, narrowing towards the nose. Nose: Large, nostrils well developed, black or dark brown. Lips: Tight and somewhat thick.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Teeth strong; scissor bite, dentition complete.
anatomy.eyes: Large, oval, chestnut brown, intelligent and playful expression.
anatomy.ears: Leathers moderately high set, medium long and broad. Pendulous, quite thick, getting finer and rounded at their tip.
anatomy.neck: Profile: The insertion with the head shows a pronounced demarcation. The neck is oblique from top to bottom. Shape: Medium width, increases in depth towards the chest. Muscular. Skin: Tight fitting, supple and covered with dense hair.
anatomy.topline: Runs in a gentle slope towards the croup.
anatomy.body: Topline: Runs in a gentle slope towards the croup. Withers: Moderately pronounced. Back: Broad and muscular. Lumbar region: Short and muscular. Croup: Slightly oblique and broad (especially in the female). Hipbones hardly apparent. Chest: Long, medium width; ribs slightly rounded, in depth reaching; at least to the elbows. Brisket fairly broad. Underline and belly: Belly slightly tucked up.
anatomy.chest: Long, medium width; ribs slightly rounded, in depth reaching; at least to the elbows. Brisket fairly broad.
anatomy.tail: Well set on, thicker at its base, finer towards the tip and reaching the hock or slightly beyond. Carried slightly curved upwards scimitar like. Very hairy.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: Forelegs vertical, straight and parallel, seen in profile and from the front. Shoulder: Long, oblique and muscular. Scapular-humeral angle: Must be of 90°. Upper arm: Long and muscular. The elbows are fairly close to the body. Forearm: Vertical, straight, muscular and strong. Pastern-joint: Hardly apparent. Pastern: Short, vertical or slightly oblique forming an angle up to 10° with the vertical. Forefeet: Cat feet, toes well-knit, pads hard, nails strong and well pigmented.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: Hindlegs vertical and parallel seen in profile and from behind. Upper thigh: Of medium length, broad and muscular. Lower thigh: Strong, long, oblique and muscular. Hock joint: Strong and well positioned. Hock: Perpendicular to the ground, short and strong. Hind feet: As the front feet but a little longer.
anatomy.feet: Cat feet, toes well-knit, pads hard, nails strong and well pigmented. As the front feet but a little longer.
anatomy.movement: Long and energetic strides.
anatomy.coat: Long, hard, shaggy, tousled, with a dense undercoat. Colour: Basic colour can be wheaten yellow, reddish yellow, earthy grey or blackish. White markings are often found on the head (star, blaze on head), under the throat, below the neck, on and under the chest, the lower parts of the legs and on the tip of the tail. The colour can be combined in bicolour or tricolour.
anatomy.color: Basic colour can be wheaten yellow, reddish yellow, earthy grey or blackish. White markings are often found on the head (star, blaze on head), under the throat, below the neck, on and under the chest, the lower parts of the legs and on the tip of the tail. The colour can be combined in bicolour or tricolour.
anatomy.size: Height at the withers: From 46 to 56 cm, ideal height 52 cm. The females are little smaller. Weight: From 16 to 24 kg, ideal weight 20 kg.
anatomy.skin: Of medium thickness, elastic, tight fitting, well pigmented and covered with a dense coat.

temperament.behavior: Lively temperament, courageous and persistant dog.
temperament.temperament_notes: • Male animals should have two apparently normal testicles fully descended into the scrotum. • Only functionally and clinically healthy dogs, with breed typical conformation should be used for breeding.

serious: Insufficient proportions of the different parts
Head too long and too heavy
Insufficient pigmentation of eye-rims and lips
Slight saddle back or arched back

disqualifying: Any dog clearly showing physical or behavioural abnormalities
Marked disproportion among the different parts of the body and especially between the height at the withers and the length of the body
Depigmentation of the nose, the eye-rims and the lips

identity.historical_function: The Black and Tan Austrian Hound is an universally popular hunting dog on account of its special suitability for heavy work on high mountains as well as on flat country for hunting by giving tongue and for the tracking of wounded game.

identity.ideal_type_summary: Medium size. Strong, long cast, supple body.
identity.historical_summary: The Black and Tan Austrian Hound (Brandlbracke) counts as a true descendant of the "Keltenb racke" (Celtic Hound). The reason for this is that until that date nocontrolled breeding took place.

anatomy.muzzle: Strong. Straight nasal bridge. Nose: Leather black. Lips: Well developed, close fitting, pigmented throughout.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Strong scissor bite. A complete set with 42 teeth is sought after; the absence of totally two PM1 or PM2 (premolar 1 or 2) is tolerated; the M3 (molar 3) are not taken into account.
anatomy.eyes: Clear, dark brown, not showing any red in corner of eye.
anatomy.ears: Leathers of medium length, not too broad, set on high, rounded at tips, hanging flatly.
anatomy.neck: Medium length. Very strong. Dewlap not desired.
anatomy.topline: Long. Loi : Slightly arched.
anatomy.body: Withers: Well defined. Back: Long. Loi : Slightly arched. Croup: Falling away in slight slope. Chest: Broad and deep.
anatomy.chest: Broad and deep.
anatomy.tail: Long, tapering gradually, slightly bent. Pendant in repose. Coarse hair on underside, but without an obvious brush.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: Well developed. Legs straight and strong. Shoulder: Well laid back, well muscled. Forefeet: Strong, round, arched; toes fitting close together. Nails strong and black. Pads large and strong.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: Well angulated. Upper thigh: Slim, moderately developed, long. Hind feet: Strong, round, arched; toes fitting close together. Nails strong and black. Pads large and strong.
anatomy.feet: Strong, round, arched; toes fitting close together. Nails strong and black. Pads large and strong. Strong, round, arched; toes fitting close together. Nails strong and black. Pads large and strong.
anatomy.movement: Ground covering, elegant.
anatomy.coat: Smooth hair, close fitting, dense, full, resilient with silky sheen. Length approximately 2 cm. Colour: Black with small, clearly defined light to dark fawn markings. The two fawn markings above the eyes (Vieräugl) must be present.
anatomy.color: Black with small, clearly defined light to dark fawn markings. The two fawn markings above the eyes (Vieräugl) must be present.

identity.historical_function: Copoi folosit la vânat mare cu pușca, dar și la iepure și vulpe.
identity.general_impression: Griffon de talie medie, receptiv și foarte hotărât. Mai degrabă strâns și bine proporționat.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Griffon de talie medie, receptiv și foarte hotărât.
identity.historical_summary: Singura rasă care a păstrat numele „Briquet” (câine de talie medie). Selecția e anterioară Primului Război Mondial, opera contelui d’Elva. E o reducere armonioasă și ameliorată a Marelui Vandeean. Tipul a reapărut la Fontenay-le-Comte în 1946.

anatomy.skull: Ușor bombat, mai degrabă scurt, nu foarte amplu. Linii cranio-faciale paralele.
anatomy.muzzle: Drept, mai degrabă scurt, cca de lungimea craniului, nu prea lat la vârf. Trufă puternică, neagră (tolerat maro la alb-portocaliu), cu nări deschise. Buze puțin dezvoltate, dar acoperă bine maxilarul inferior; cu mustăți abundente.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Mușcătură în foarfece; incisivi perpendiculari.
anatomy.eyes: Închiși, mari și vioi, cu sprâncene stufoase care nu ascund ochiul. Conjunctiva nevizibilă.
anatomy.ears: Moi, înguste și fine, cu păr lung, ascuțite la vârf, bine răsucite în interior; nu ajung la vârful trufei. Inserate jos, sub linia ochiului.
anatomy.neck: Lung și elegant, fără salbă.
anatomy.body: Spate solid și scurt, drept sau ușor rimontant. Șale drepte, musculoase și compacte. Torace nu prea amplu, mai degrabă adânc, coboară la cot; coaste moderat arcuite. Flancuri pline. Linia inferioară foarte ușor ridicată spre posterior.
anatomy.tail: Groasă la bază, se subțiază treptat; inserată sus, purtată în sabie, niciodată în seceră; destul de scurtă.
anatomy.forequarters: Destul de puternice dar nu grele, verticale și paralele. Omoplați lungi, uscați și oblici. Coți jos și aderenți. Antebraț cu osatură puternică, drept.
anatomy.hindquarters: Verticali și paraleli, bine dezvoltați. Coapsă lungă și musculoasă. Jaret larg și bine coborât, niciodată de vacă ori de câine; din lateral, unghi moderat.
anatomy.feet: Nu prea puternici, cu perinițe dure, degete arcuite și strânse, unghii solide. Mers activ și elastic.
anatomy.coat: Aspru, nu prea lung și plat, niciodată mătăsos ori lânos.
anatomy.color: Negru pătat cu alb; negru cu focuri; negru cu marcaje nisip; fulvo cu alb; fulvo cu șa neagră și alb (tricolor); fulvo cărbonat; nisip cărbonat cu/fără alb. Culori numite tradițional „păr de iepure”, „de lup”, „de bursuc”, „de mistreț”.
anatomy.size: Masculi 50–55 cm; femele 48–53 cm (toleranță ±1 cm).
anatomy.skin: Destul de groasă dar moale, adesea marmorată la tricolori. Fără salbă.

temperament.behavior: Cu miros fin; câine rapid cu voce plăcută, nu refuză mărăcinișul; abil pe teren accidentat, vânează mai ales cu nasul în vânt. Plin de inițiativă, rezistent și robust. Trebuie să știe deopotrivă să urmărească, să scotocească și să gonească vânatul. Vânător pasionat; conducătorul trebuie să știe să se facă ascultat.
temperament.temperament_notes: Masculii trebuie să aibă doi testiculi de aspect normal, complet coborâți în scrot.

disqualifying: Regiune sternală insuficient de amplă; coaste închise în jos

identity.historical_function: Copoi folosit azi mai ales la vânătoare cu pușca. Regăsește inteligent pista pierdută; viteză medie dar susținută. Rustic, cu voce puternică ce se aude de departe. Șase-opt exemplare tricolore formează o mică haită omogenă.
identity.general_impression: Câine bine construit, musculos și nu prea lung, care dă impresie de forță și energie.
identity.important_proportions: Talie : lungimea corpului între 10:10 și 10:11. Torace : talie ≈ 1:2. Lățime craniu : lungime cap ≈ 5:9. Lungime nas : craniu ≈ 8:10.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Câine bine construit, musculos și nu prea lung, care dă impresie de forță și energie.
identity.historical_summary: Rasă numită odinioară „Picard”, apreciată la vânătoare pe vremea lui Henric al IV-lea și Ludovic al XIII-lea. După al Doilea Război Mondial a fost crezută pierdută; a fost refăcută în anii ’70 datorită lui M. Audréchy și doamnei Pilat.

anatomy.skull: Puternic, larg, destul de scurt, rotunjit și turtit superior, cu creastă occipitală puțin pronunțată.
anatomy.muzzle: Nas drept, moderat de alungit din profil. Trufă neagră și puternică, cu nări deschise. Buza superioară o acoperă larg pe cea inferioară, dând un profil pătrat botului. Obraji uscați.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Mușcătură în foarfece; incisivi perpendiculari.
anatomy.eyes: Nu prea apropiați față de lățimea frunții; rotunzi, ușor ieșiți, cu aer melancolic și blând, maro-închis. Conjunctiva nevizibilă.
anatomy.ears: Inserate la nivelul liniei ochiului, ceva groase, late, cu vârf rotund, aproape plate și destul de lungi. Ajung la vârful trufei.
anatomy.neck: Mediu de lung, puternic. Salbă foarte redusă.
anatomy.body: Spate lat și bine susținut. Șale ușor arcuite. Crupă ușor înclinată, foarte musculoasă. Torace lat și lung, coborât la nivelul coților; coaste bine arcuite. Flancuri pline.
anatomy.tail: Puternică, destul de lungă, spicată și purtată în seceră. Nu cade niciodată înainte.
anatomy.forequarters: Puternice și în aplomb. Metacarpi ușor oblici. Omoplați oblici și musculoși. Coți bine în axul corpului.
anatomy.hindquarters: Din spate, fesa, mijlocul gambei, jaretul, metatarsul și piciorul pe aceeași verticală. Coapse coborâte și bine musculate. Jarete puternice și mediu unghiate. Metatarsi scurți și puternici.
anatomy.feet: Ușor alungiți, puternici dar destul de strânși; perinițe negre, rezistente și compacte.
anatomy.movement: Regulat și ușor.
anatomy.coat: Scurt, gros și destul de plat.
anatomy.color: Tricolor fulvo-închis, spre „păr de iepure” ori „de bursuc”, cu șa sau pete mari; capul de obicei fulvo, uneori cărbonat.
anatomy.size: Înălțime la greabăn: masculi și femele 53–58 cm.
anatomy.skin: Destul de groasă.

temperament.behavior: Câine viguros și rustic, cu miros foarte fin, se unește bine în haită, echilibrat și afectuos.
temperament.temperament_notes: Masculii trebuie să aibă doi testiculi de aspect normal, complet coborâți în scrot.

identity.historical_function: Scent hound for large game venery, service dog, tracking dog and family dog. It was and it must always remain a hound which due to its remarkable sense of smell is foremost a leash hound, often used not only to follow the trail of wounded game as in the blood scenting trials but also to seek out missing people in police operations. Due to its functional construction, the Bloodhound is endowed with great endurance and also an exceptional nose which allows it to follow a trail over a long distance and difficult terrain without problems.
identity.general_impression: Large-sized hound and massive leash hound, the most powerful of all the scent hounds. It is harmonious in its lines, endowed with strong bone, good muscle and a lot of substance, but without ever appearing heavy. It is long in structure, fitting into a rectangle. The overall appearance is imposing and full of nobility. Its attitude is solemn. The head and neck attract attention because of their abundant, supple and thin skin, hanging in deep folds. Its movement is impressive, rather slow and with a certain rolling gait but lithe, elastic and free. No characteristic should be so exaggerated as to destroy the harmony of the whole, to give an over-done appearance or even less to harm the health or well-being of the dog. Among possible exaggerations should be mentioned eyes which are too deep set or too small; distended eyelids; too much and too loose skin with too many and too deep folds; too much dewlap; too narrow a head. Dogs which are too big, with bodies too heavy or too massive, are equally undesirable because this impedes their function.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Large-sized hound and massive leash hound, the most powerful of all the scent hounds.
identity.historical_summary: Large scent hound and excellent leash hound, with very ancient antecedents. For centuries it has been known and appreciated for its exceptional nose and its great talent for the hunt. It was bred in the Ardennes by the monks of the Abbaye de Saint-Hubert. It is presumed to descend from black or black and tan hounds hunting in packs which were used in the 7th century by the monk Hubert, who was later made a bishop and who when canonised became the patron saint of hunters. These big scent hounds spread throughout the Ardennes, due to the presence of large game, sheltering in the widespread forests of the region. These Saint-Hubert hounds were famed for their robustness and their endurance, especially when hunting wild boar. The first Saint-Hubert hounds were black but later black and tan was also to be found. In the 11th century these dogs were imported into England by William the Conqueror. At the same time, dogs of the same type but with an all-white coat, called Talbots, were also introduced there. In England the imported dogs provided the basic root stock. The progeny of these Bloodhounds received their name as a derivation of " blooded hound " which means a dog of pure blood, therefore a pure-bred. Subsequently the breed was also developed in the United States of America. In the Southern States especially, these dogs were used for hunting runaway slaves.
identity.classification: Section 1 Scent hounds. 1.1 Large sized hounds. With working trial.

anatomy.head: The most characteristic point of the breed is the imposing and majestic head, full of nobility. It is deep but narrow in relation to its length and long in relation to the length of the body. The bone structure is clearly visible. The lateral sides are flattened and the profile is square. The topline of the muzzle is near1y on the same plane as the upper outline of the skull. On the forehead and cheeks, the abundant thin skin forms wrinkles and deep folds, falling when the head is carried low and continuing into the strongly developed folds of the dewlap. The skin is less abundant in the female.
anatomy.skull: Deep, long, rather narrow with flattened sides. The brows are not prominent although they may appear so. The occipital peak is very developed and distinctly pronounced.
anatomy.muzzle: As long as the skull, deep, broad near the nostrils and of equal width throughout its length. The topline of the muzzle is muzzle is either straight or slightly convex (slight ram's nose). Nose: Black or brown, always black on black and tan dogs. The nose is broad, well-developed, with wide open nostrils. Lips: Very long and limp; the upper lips fall over the lower lips and at the front form a right angle with the upper line of the foreface, which gives a square profile to the muzzle. Towards the corners of the mouth they become fleshy flews (less pronounced in the female) which blend imperceptibly into the abundant dewlap. The edge of the upper lips comes down about 5 cm below the lower jaw. The edge of the lips is well-pigmented, black or brown, depending on the nose colour.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Complete dentition, in correct scissor bite; strong white teeth, set regularly in well-developed jaws. A pincer bite is tolerated.
anatomy.eyes: Dark brown or hazel, of a lighter hue (amber) in dogs without black saddle or mantle. Eyes of moderate size, oval, not weeping, neither protruding nor sunk into the socket, leaving the iris totally visible. Lids with no irregularity in their contour, normally fitting around the eyeball; lower lids a little slack so that a little haw is visible are nevertheless tolerated. At no time should the eye-lashes touch or interfere with the eyes. The expression is gentle, kind and dignified, with a rather melancholy air.
anatomy.ears: Thin and supple, covered in short hair, delicate and velvety to the touch ; very long lobes, reaching at least beyond the end of the nose when they are laid on the upper line of the foreface; ears set very low, level with the eyes or even lower, on the side of the head, falling in graceful folds curling inwards and backwards (curling ears).
anatomy.neck: Long so that the dog can follow the trail with its nose on the ground; strongly muscled ; the skin of the throat is loose and extremely developed, presenting a double dewlap, but this is less pronounced in the female.
anatomy.topline: Straight, broad, long and solid.
anatomy.body: The topline and underline are almost parallel. Withers: Slightly pronounced. Back: Straight, broad, long and solid. Loin: Broad, strong, short, very slightly arched. Croup: Well-muscled, almost horizontal, never falling away, very broad and quite long. Chest: Oval in shape, broad, well let down, clearly forming a keel between the forelegs; thoracic cage long enough; forechest and point of shoulder standing out, ribs well-sprung, neither flat nor barrel. Underline and belly: Underline almost horizontal; underside of chest well let down; flanks well filled, broad and let down ; belly only very slightly tucked up.
anatomy.chest: Oval in shape, broad, well let down, clearly forming a keel between the forelegs; thoracic cage long enough; forechest and point of shoulder standing out, ribs well-sprung, neither flat nor barrel.
anatomy.tail: Long, strong, thick, set high, in continuation of the dorsal line ,tapering gradually towards the tip; carried sabre fashion ; on the move the tail curves gracefully above the line of the back, never curled or twisting sideways .The underside of the tail is furnished with harsher hair, about 5 cm long, which becomes progressively shorter towards the tip.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: Well-muscled, powerful forequarters, straight and perfectly parallel. Shoulder: Long, well-sloping, well-muscled but not over-loaded. Upper arm: Long, sloping and forming good angulation with the shoulder. Elbow: Well set, neither turning out nor in. Forearm: Straight, strong round bone. Wrist: Firm. Metacarpus (Pastern): Sturdy, upright seen from the front, slightly forward sloping seen from the side. Forefeet: Compact, very solid, neither toeing in nor out; toes well-arched, well knuckled up and tight (cat feet) ; thick solid pads ; short strong nails.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: Solid, powerfully muscled, well-balanced with the forequarters; seen from behind perfectly parallel, neither close nor open. Upper thigh: Good length and strongly muscled. Stifle (Knee): Well-angulated, neither turning in nor out. Lower thigh: Sufficiently long and strongly muscled. Hock: Solid, close to the ground and well-angulated. Metatarsus (Rear Pastern): Strong and short. Hind feet: Like front foot.
anatomy.feet: Compact, very solid, neither toeing in nor out; toes well-arched, well knuckled up and tight (cat feet) ; thick solid pads ; short strong nails. Like front foot.
anatomy.movement: The assessment of the very typical movement of the Bloodhound is extremely important. At its normal gait, the trot, the movement is even, with measured steps, springy and free, covering more ground than any other scent hound and very characteristic of the breed, rolling but without crabbing. The hind legs move well at the back, there is good drive from the hindquarters, the reach of the fore and hindquarter movements is equal and the topline remains horizontal. The limbs move parallel but at greater speed the feet single-track. The tail is carried high like a sabre without the curve becoming too pronounced. The Bloodhound must be capable of maintaining a trot for a long period of time without showing signs of tiredness.
anatomy.coat: On the body, the close-lying hair is short, dense, quite harsh and weatherproof. On the head and ears the hair is very short and soft to the touch. The underside of the tail is furnished with hair a little longer and coarser. Colour: There are three distinct coat colours: the bicolours black and tan and liver and tan and the unicolour red. Among black and tan dogs, the amount of black varies, according to whether it is a mantle or a saddle. In a dog with a mantle, black is predominant: the tan (fawn) is only found on the muzzle, the cheeks, above the eyes, on the forechest, on the limbs and the anal region. A dog with a saddle has a greater expanse of tan because the black is more or less limited to the dorsal region. The same positioning of coloured zones is to be found in the bicoloured liver and tan. The colours are not always clearly stated nor distinctly defined. In the darker areas, it is possible to find them interspersed with lighter or badger hairs. Such a mixture of different coloured hairs is allowed. For the unicoloured red, the red can vary from light red to dark red. A washed-out tan for bicolours or red for unicolours is not sought after. A little white on the forechest, on the toes and at the tip of the tail is tolerated without being sought after.
anatomy.color: There are three distinct coat colours: the bicolours black and tan and liver and tan and the unicolour red. Among black and tan dogs, the amount of black varies, according to whether it is a mantle or a saddle. In a dog with a mantle, black is predominant: the tan (fawn) is only found on the muzzle, the cheeks, above the eyes, on the forechest, on the limbs and the anal region. A dog with a saddle has a greater expanse of tan because the black is more or less limited to the dorsal region. The same positioning of coloured zones is to be found in the bicoloured liver and tan. The colours are not always clearly stated nor distinctly defined. In the darker areas, it is possible to find them interspersed with lighter or badger hairs. Such a mixture of different coloured hairs is allowed. For the unicoloured red, the red can vary from light red to dark red. A washed-out tan for bicolours or red for unicolours is not sought after. A little white on the forechest, on the toes and at the tip of the tail is tolerated without being sought after.
anatomy.size: Height at withers: The ideal height is 68 cm for males. 62 cm for females. Tolerance of 4 cm more or less. Weight: Males about 46 - 54 kg. Females about 40 – 48 kg. Height and weight must be balanced.
anatomy.skin: Supple over all the body, loose and elastic. The thin skin, very loose and abundant over the head, is very characteristic. On the forehead and the lateral sides of the foreface, the skin forms folds which hang down and which are even more noticeable when the head is carried low .However over-done wrinkles and folds on the forehead and brows must never harm the eyes. Folds of skin on the body due to too much skin are not desirable.

temperament.behavior: Gentle, placid, kind and sociable with people. Particularly attached to its owner. Tolerant of kennel companions and other domestic animals. Somewhat reserved and stubborn. Just as sensitive to compliments as to corrections. Never aggressive. Its voice is deep but it rarely barks.
temperament.temperament_notes: • Male animals should have two apparently normal testicles fully descended into the scrotum. • Only functionally and clinically healthy dogs, with breed typical conformation should be used for breeding.

minor: General appearance: Cloddy; lacking in substance; light bone; too high or too low on leg, square construction rather than rectangular; lack of nobility

Head : Skull broad and voluminous or excessively narrow ; receding forehead ; skin on forehead falling too far forward; occipital peak not sufficiently pronounced; too marked a stop; bridge of nose concave; muzzle short or not deep enough; top lips not pendulous enough
Nose and lips: Loss of pigment
Eyes: Too small, too sunken in sockets; lower lid too pendulous, too much haw visible
Ears: Too short, too thick, set above the eyeline, too close to the head, too flat
Neck: Short, slender, very little dewlap
Body: Short or too long; chest not well let down, forechest not protruding enough in profile; slab-sided or barrel-chested ; weak or arched back, croup overbuilt or falling away; belly too tucked up
Tail: Low set; squirrel tail, ring tail, curled tail; knotty or kinked tail; hook or deviated tail

Limbs : Under or over angulated ; short upper arm ; not upright seen in profile ( front pasterns too sloping or wrists weak ), nor from the front ( feet turning out or in, forearm curved, elbows out etc. ) or from behind ( hind legs too close together, wide apart or barrelled ; hocks closed or open etc); spreading, hare or flat feet
Gait / Movement: Close movement or open; weaving, crabbing, restricted or stilted gait; mincing gait; poor transmission by the back
Coat colour: Light or washed-out colours
Temperament: Lacking in confidence or shy
disqualifying: Any dog clearly showing physical or behavioural abnormalities shall be disqualified
General appearance: Lack of breed type
Dentition: Over or under shot; wry jaw; crooked mouth
Nose and lips: Very lacking in pigment or pink; anything other than black in black and tan dogs; anything other than brown or black in dogs without black saddle or mantle

Coat colour : Any colours which do not correspond to those described ; too widespread white markings, such as white going up as far as wrists or hocks, or too much white on the forechest ; white patches anywhere other than the forechest, toes and tip of tail, like a white muzzle or a white blaze etc

identity.historical_function: Hound.
identity.general_impression: Medium size, solid, agile.
identity.important_proportions: The length of the body (measured from the point of the shoulder to the point of the buttocks) and the perimeter of the chest go beyond by about 10% the height at the withers. The length of the head corresponds to 45% of the height at the withers.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Medium size, solid, agile.
identity.historical_summary: We can say with certainty that this breed is of the same origin as the other Balkan hounds. In the past this dog has sometimes been called « black hound ». The first standard dates 1924. This breed was officially recognized (standard N° 279) on the 8th May 1969 during the meeting in Warsaw.
identity.classification: Section 1.2 Medium-sized Hounds. With working trial.

anatomy.head: Dolichocephalic; the upper lines of the skull and the muzzle are divergent.
anatomy.skull: Longer than the muzzle; in the occipital region, its width is inferior to the distance between the stop and the occipital protuberance. Seen from the front and in profile flat or slightly arched. Its width decreases from the top of the skull down to the stop. The frontal furrow is accentuated, whereas the occipital protuberance is less obvious; the superciliary arches are well developed.
anatomy.muzzle: Thick and broad at its base, is shorter than the skull. The desirable relation is of 7,5 : 10. The lateral lines of the muzzle are convergent. The nasal bridge is straight. Nose: Always black, well developed. Lips: Moderately developed, tight, upper lip slightly overlapping the bottom lip; the corner of the lips is firm; the edge of the lips is pigmented black.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: The jaws are strong and show a regular and complete scissor bite; a pincer bite is admitted. The teeth are well developed and regularly implanted.
anatomy.eyes: Oval shape, placed slightly obliquely, of light to dark brown in colour; the rims of the eyelids are black.
anatomy.ears: High set, moderately long, thin to medium thick, pendant without folds and close to the head; their extremity is of a more or less pronounced oval shape.
anatomy.neck: Powerful, oblique, forming an angle of 45° to 50° with the horizontal. Its length is approximately equal to that of the head. It is thin, muscled and without dewlap.
anatomy.topline: Muscled, broad, moderately long.
anatomy.body: Rectangular, its length going beyond by about 10% the height at the withers. Withers: Very pronounced. Back: Muscled, broad, moderately long. Loin: Muscled, solid, medium length, short coupled. Croup: Slightly slanting (20-25° in relation to the horizontal), powerful, well muscled, broad. Chest: Strong, deep; its depth corresponds to 45 to 50% of the height at the withers and its perimeter going beyond by about 10% the height at the withers. Underline and belly: The xyphoid appendix is prominent; the belly is only slightly tucked up.
anatomy.chest: Strong, deep; its depth corresponds to 45 to 50% of the height at the withers and its perimeter going beyond by about 10% the height at the withers.
anatomy.tail: It prolongs the line of the croup and goes on, thinning gradually from its set on to the extremity which reaches the hock; carried sabre fashion below the line of the back; is covered with abundant hair.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: Strong, solid, muscled, parallel. Shoulder: Shoulder-blade muscled, well attached to the thoracic wall; its length is approximately equal to that of the head; it forms an angle of 40 to 45° with the horizontal. Elbow: Solid, close to the body; the distance from the ground up to the elbow corresponds to 50% of the height at the withers. Forearm: Straight, strong, muscled. Pastern joint: Solid. Pastern: Strong, thin, slightly slanting (up to 15° in relation to the vertical). Forefeet: Cat feet; solid toes, tight, well arched; the pads are resistant, elastic and black; the nails are always black.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: Strong, muscled, parallel, of strong bone structure. Upper thigh: Strong, muscled, not prominent. Stifle: Solid, parallel to the median plane of the body; the angle of the stifle is of about 120°. Lower thigh: Its length corresponds approximately to that of the upper thigh. Muscled. Hock joint: Solid, pronounced; its angulation is of about 135°-140°. Hock: Powerful, almost vertical. Hind feet: As the front feet.
anatomy.feet: Cat feet; solid toes, tight, well arched; the pads are resistant, elastic and black; the nails are always black. As the front feet.
anatomy.movement: Regular and elastic stride, with good thrust from the hindquarters; the preferred gait is a lively and even trot.
anatomy.coat: Short, dense, rough, not very thick, glossy, flat, smooth. The undercoat is quite well developed. Colour: The basic colour is black with tan markings above the eyes, on the muzzle and on the lower parts of the legs. The tan markings above the eyes are the size of a hazelnut, whereas the ones on the lateral parts of the muzzle extend at maximum to the corner of the lips. The colour of the tan markings goes from a light red through a brownish red to a bright red. A white spot on the chest is admitted but not sought after; its diameter must not be more than 3 cm.
anatomy.color: The basic colour is black with tan markings above the eyes, on the muzzle and on the lower parts of the legs. The tan markings above the eyes are the size of a hazelnut, whereas the ones on the lateral parts of the muzzle extend at maximum to the corner of the lips. The colour of the tan markings goes from a light red through a brownish red to a bright red. A white spot on the chest is admitted but not sought after; its diameter must not be more than 3 cm.
anatomy.size: The height at the withers is from 44-54 cm; the ideal size for the males varies between 49-50 cm, and for the females between 48-49 cm.
anatomy.skin: Elastic, really tight to the body; shows a dark pigmentation.

temperament.behavior: Well balanced, attached to his master, docile, trustworthy.
temperament.temperament_notes: • Male animals should have two apparently normal testicles fully descended into the scrotum. • Only functionally and clinically healthy dogs, with breed typical conformation should be used for breeding. The latest amendments are in bold characters.

disqualifying: Any dog clearly showing physical or behavioural abnormalities
Over- or undershot mouth; deviated incisor arch
Absence of one tooth (except PM1 and M3)
Eyes of a very light colour, wall-eyes, eyes of different colour; entropion, ectropion
Rolled up tail, carried above the back line or deviated laterally
Any other white marking than that which is tolerated
Superior or inferior size than that prescribed in the standard

identity.historical_function: Câine de vânătoare, deasupra și sub pământ.
identity.general_impression: Jos, cu membre scurte, alungit dar de figură compactă, foarte musculos, cu port mândru al capului și expresie atentă. Construcția îi permite un lucru agil și rapid deasupra și sub pământ. Dimorfismul sexual e evident.
identity.important_proportions: Distanța sternului de la sol e cca o treime din înălțimea la greabăn; lungimea corpului (de la manubriul sternal la vârful fesei) e în raport armonic cu înălțimea la greabăn, cca 1:1,7 până la 1:1,8.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Jos, cu membre scurte, alungit dar de figură compactă, foarte musculos, cu port mândru al capului și expresie atentă.
identity.historical_summary: Teckelul (Dackel/Dachshund) e cunoscut din Evul Mediu. Din copoi (Bracken) au fost selectați treptat câini potriviți vânătorii în vizuină; din aceștia, cu membre scurte, s-a fixat Teckelul, una dintre cele mai versatile rase de vânătoare. Excelează și la suprafață — gonind vânatul cu glas, scotocind și pe pistă de sânge. Cea mai veche asociație de creștere e „Deutscher Teckelklub e.V.” (1888). Se crește în trei talii (Standard, Nano/Miniatură și Kaninchen/de iepure) și trei tipuri de păr (scurt, dur, lung) — nouă varietăți.

anatomy.head: Alungit, văzut de sus. Din profil se îngustează uniform până la trufă, fără a se termina ascuțit. Arcade sprâncenare bine definite. Cartilaje nazale și nas lungi și înguste.
anatomy.skull: Mai degrabă plat, nu prea lat, se unește armonios cu nasul ușor arcuit. Occiput nu foarte pronunțat.
anatomy.muzzle: Lung, suficient de lat și robust. Gura se poate deschide adânc, până la verticala ochilor. Trufă bine dezvoltată. Buze aderente, care acoperă bine maxilarul inferior.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Fălci bine dezvoltate. Mușcătură în foarfece, regulată și fermă. Ideal dentiție completă (42 de dinți), cu canini robuști care se îmbină perfect.
anatomy.eyes: De mărime medie, migdalați, bine distanțați, cu expresie sinceră, energică dar prietenoasă, nu pătrunzătoare.
anatomy.ears: Inserate sus, nu prea în față, suficient de lungi (ajung la marginea buzelor, nu mult mai mult), rotunjite. Mobile, cu marginea anterioară aderentă la obraz.
anatomy.neck: Suficient de lung, musculos. Pielea gâtului aderentă; ceafă ușor arcuită, purtat liber și sus.
anatomy.topline: Coboară armonios de la ceafă la crupa ușor înclinată.
anatomy.body: Greabăn pronunțat. Spate (după greabănul înalt) orizontal sau ușor descendent, solid și bine musculat. Șale puternice, late și bine musculate. Crupă largă și suficient de lungă, nici orizontală, nici prea înclinată. Abdomen ușor retras.
anatomy.chest: Stern bine pronunțat și proeminent, cu ușoare adâncituri de o parte și de alta. Cutie toracică ovală din față; de sus și din lateral amplă, pentru dezvoltarea inimii și plămânilor. Coaste bine extinse spre spate. Cu lungimea și unghiularea corectă a omoplatului, membrul anterior acoperă din profil punctul cel mai jos al pieptului.
anatomy.tail: Purtată armonios în prelungirea liniei dorsale, ușor coborâtă, nu peste linia superioară. În ultima treime se admite o ușoară curbură.
anatomy.forequarters: Puternic musculate, bine unghiate. Din față, membre drepte cu osatură bună; picioare îndreptate înainte. Coți nedeviați.
anatomy.hindquarters: Puternic musculate, în bună proporție cu anteriorul. Unghiulări puternice la genunchi și jaret. Din spate, membre paralele, nici apropiate, nici depărtate.
anatomy.feet: Degete strânse, bine arcuite, cu perinițe puternice și unghii scurte. Al cincilea deget nu are funcție.
anatomy.movement: Mers amplu, suplu și energic, cu bună alungire razantă, impuls puternic și o ușoară elasticitate transmisă liniei dorsale. Anterior și posterior se mișcă paralel; coada în prelungirea liniei dorsale, ușor coborâtă.
anatomy.coat: Scurt, des, lucios, neted și dur, bine aderent, fără porțiuni golașe. Coada acoperită fin și complet.
anatomy.color: Unicolor: roșu, roșu-gălbui sau galben, cu sau fără fire negre (nuanța curată preferată); trufă și unghii negre. Bicolor: negru sau maro, fiecare cu focuri ruginii/galbene deasupra ochilor, pe laturile botului, pe buza inferioară, marginea urechilor, piept, membre, picioare, în jurul anusului și pe partea inferioară a cozii. Merle (arlechin/tigrat): pe fond roșu, galben ori negru-cu-focuri, pete gri sau negre neregulate — niciuna să nu domine.
anatomy.size: Se crește în trei talii, definite prin circumferința toracică (la min. 15 luni): Standard peste 35 cm; Nano (Miniatură) 30–35 cm; Kaninchen (de iepure) sub 30 cm.
anatomy.skin: Aderentă, bine pigmentată.

temperament.behavior: De fire prietenoasă, nici fricos, nici agresiv, cu temperament echilibrat. Câine de vânătoare pasionat, perseverent, sprinten și cu miros fin.
temperament.temperament_notes: Masculii trebuie să aibă doi testiculi de aspect normal, complet coborâți în scrot. Doar subiecții sănătoși și tipici pot fi folosiți la reproducere.

minor: Orice abatere de la standard, penalizată după gravitate
M3 nu se ia în calcul la judecare
Lipsa a doi PM1 nu se penalizează
Lipsa unui PM2 e defect, chiar dacă nu lipsesc alți dinți (în afară de M3)
Mușcătură abătută de la foarfece, de exemplu în clește
serious: Constituție firavă, prea înalt de la sol sau prea razant
Alte defecte de dinți nedescrise la „Defecte” și „Defecte eliminatorii”
Flancuri scobite în liră; abdomen retras
disqualifying: Câine cu anomalii evidente fizice ori comportamentale
Enognatism, prognatism, arcade de incisivi deviate (mușcătură încrucișată)
Lipsa unuia sau mai multor canini ori incisivi
Lipsa altor premolari sau molari (excepții: cei doi PM1 ori un PM2, fără M3)
Culoare neagră sau maro fără focuri; alb cu sau fără focuri

identity.historical_function: Hunting dog. Companion dog, family dog, suitable to be trained for various purposes.
identity.general_impression: Mesocephalic. Head prismatic form with hanging ears. The body is rectangular, strong, muscled and distinctively spotted. The movement must be elegant. The sexual difference must be visible.
identity.important_proportions: Length of the body: height at the withers = 10 : 9. The height at the elbow joint: 50% of the height at the withers. The height the hocks: 20-25% of the height at the withers. Length of head: around 40% of the height at the withers. Length of skull : length of muzzle = 1 : 1.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Mesocephalic. Head prismatic form with hanging ears.
identity.historical_summary: The origin of the Dalmatian dog can be recognized in paintings and in church chronicles from the 16th to the 18th century. Dalmatians can be found on the altar painting “Madonna with Jesus and Angels” in the church “Gospa od andjela” in the town Veli Losinj, island Losinj in Croatia dating back to 1600 – 1630 and also in a fresco in Zaostrog, Dalmatia, Croatia. It suggests that the Dalmatian originates from the eastern Mediterranean region, in particular the historic province Dalmatia. The first descriptions of the Dalmatian were found in the diocese Djakovo, in the Croatia, namely in the church chronicles of the Bishop Petar Bakic from the year 1719 and the church chronicles of Andreas Keczkemety from the year 1737. The dog was named with the Latin name “Canis Dalmaticus” and the height of the dog described with 4-5 “Spithamus”. Thomas Pennant described this breed in his work “Synopsis of Quadrupeds” in the year 1771 as very independent, named it “Dalmatian” and wrote the origin of this breed to be Dalmatia. A work by Thomas Bewick, published in 1790, refers to this breed as “Dalmatian or Coach Dog”. The first unofficial Dalmatian Standard was written by an Englishman named Vero Shaw in the year 1882. After the formation of the Dalmatian Club in England in the year 1890 this standard was transferred to the first official breed standard. The first Dalmatian standard was published on the 7th of April 1955 under the name of “Dalmatian Huntingdog”.
identity.classification: Section 3 Related breeds. Without working trials.

anatomy.head: The head must be in proportion and harmony with the rest of the body and not too wide in the skull area. The length from the occipital protuberance to the stop and from the stop to the tip of the nose equals 1:1, or the muzzle is slightly shorter. The upper line of the skull and the upper line of the muzzle are slightly divergent. The masseter muscle and the cheek bone must not be too developed. The head must be entirely free from wrinkle.
anatomy.skull: Flat, with a slight lateral rounding. Broadest between the ears and well defined temples. Slight frontal furrow.
anatomy.muzzle: Well developed & strong jawbone, nasal bridge straight. Nose: Large with wide open nostrils, it must be completely pigmented. The colour must be in accordance to the colour of the spotting. Lips: Strong, must fit the jaw rather closely and not be pendulous, or too thick; without the corner of the mouth too defined. A complete pigmentation is desired.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Scissor bite, i.e. the upper 6 incisors closely overlapping the lower teeth, with all teeth set square to the jaw. A complete set of teeth (42 teeth) is desired (in accordance with the teeth formula). The teeth are evenly formed and white. A pincer bite is tolerated in older dogs.
anatomy.eyes: Oval, in a sub-frontal position placed at an angle of 10-15˚. The eye colour is in accordance with the spotting. Eyelids are close to the eyeball and not loose. Eye rims are completely pigmented in accordance with the coat colour.
anatomy.ears: Set on rather high, carried close to the lateral part of the head. The length reaches to the inner corner of the eye or to the stop. The tip is slightly rounded. The ears have the shape of an isosceles triangle. They are fine in texture and soft to the touch. It is very important that the ears are spotted, i.e. the ears must not be completely black or brown but black or brown spotted etc. with the spotting in accordance with the colour variety on the white base.
anatomy.neck: The neck should be strong and fairly long, tapering towards the head and free from throatiness.
anatomy.topline: Powerful, level.
anatomy.body: Rectangular, proportions of length of body to the height at the withers is 10: 9. Withers: Well defined. Back: Powerful, level. Loin: Short and muscular. Croup: Muscular, inclined less than 30°. Chest: Deep and capacious, not too broad or barrel-shaped. The depth of the chest should be 45-50% of the height to the withers. The height of the elbow is 50% of the height to the withers. The ribs are well sprung. Underline and belly: The belly is moderately tucked up but not drawn in.
anatomy.chest: Deep and capacious, not too broad or barrel-shaped. The depth of the chest should be 45-50% of the height to the withers. The height of the elbow is 50% of the height to the withers. The ribs are well sprung.
anatomy.tail: Set on at the extension of the croup. Reaching approximately to the hock or slightly longer. Strong at the base evenly tapering towards the tip, not too thick but in proportion to the body. Carried sabre-shaped. Preferably spotted.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: The forelegs must be in proportion to the rectangular body. Shoulder: The shoulder angle is around 115-120˚ Elbow: Close to the body. Forearm: The bones are developed in proportion to the body and strong (round), forequarters placed straight and legs standing vertical. Metacarpus (Pastern): Strong, slightly sloping with a spring. Forefeet: The toes are compact, so called cat feet are typical. Pads are tough and elastic. The nails should preferably be pigmented.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: In proportion to the body. With strong well developed muscles. Hindlegs are parallel. Thigh: Muscular and strong. Stifle (Knee): Strong and well developed. The stifle has an angle of 40 degree to the horizontal line. Hock joint: Strong. Metatarsus (Rear pasterns): The length of the hocks is around 20-25% of the height to the withers. The angle of the hock is around 130˚. Hind feet: The toes are compact, so called cat feet are typical. Pads are tough and elastic. The nails should preferably be pigmented.
anatomy.feet: The toes are compact, so called cat feet are typical. Pads are tough and elastic. The nails should preferably be pigmented. The toes are compact, so called cat feet are typical. Pads are tough and elastic. The nails should preferably be pigmented.
anatomy.movement: Rhythmic action, elegant and smooth movement. Stride and trot long with good reach and strong drive. Viewed from the front the legs are parallel.
anatomy.coat: Short, shiny, hard and dense all over the body. Colour: The ground colour is pure white. Black spotted variety with black spots, liver spotted variety with brown spots. The spots should be symmetrically placed all over the body, clearly defined and without intermingling into the white ground colour. The size of the spots should preferably be even, with a size of 2 – 3 cm in diameter. In the brown variety the spots are a little smaller, around 2 cm. The spots on the head and on the legs should be proportional smaller than on the rest of the body. It is desirable the tail is spotted too, with spots also proportional smaller that those on the body. Splashes on the body are not desirable and should be penalised. The spots must not intermingle, i.e. forming large patches. Patches and coloured areas are not desirable. The spots on the ears should be especially noted.
anatomy.color: The ground colour is pure white. Black spotted variety with black spots, liver spotted variety with brown spots. The spots should be symmetrically placed all over the body, clearly defined and without intermingling into the white ground colour. The size of the spots should preferably be even, with a size of 2 – 3 cm in diameter. In the brown variety the spots are a little smaller, around 2 cm. The spots on the head and on the legs should be proportional smaller than on the rest of the body. It is desirable the tail is spotted too, with spots also proportional smaller that those on the body. Splashes on the body are not desirable and should be penalised. The spots must not intermingle, i.e. forming large patches. Patches and coloured areas are not desirable. The spots on the ears should be especially noted.
anatomy.size: Height at the withers: Males 56 – 62 cms. Females 54 – 60 cms. Dogs with excellent type and balance should not be penalised if above the upper limit.

temperament.behavior: Pleasant temperament, friendly, not shy or hesitant, free from nervousness and aggression. Lively kind, loyal, independent and easy to train. The Dalmatian likes water and outdoor activities. It has a marked hound instinct.
temperament.temperament_notes: • Male animals should have two apparently normal testicles fully descended into the scrotum. • Only functionally and clinically healthy dogs, with breed typical conformation should be used for breeding.

disqualifying: Any dog clearly showing physical or behavioural abnormalities
The lack of more than 6 premolars, the lack of M3 is not noted and will not be considered as a fault
Entropion, ectropion, wall eye, eyes of different colours (heterochromia), blue
Monocle (patching around one or both eyes) or patching elsewhere
Tricolour (black and brown spots on the same dog), brindle coloured spots, lemon coloured spots, orange coloured spots, blue spots and pure white colour without spots

identity.historical_function: Hound.
identity.general_impression: That of a light, high stationed, elegant, yet strongly made hunting dog with a noble, comparatively fine head, good leathers and a well carried but in respect of the noble general appearance, remarkably thick tail. Slightly tucked up abdomen.
identity.important_proportions: Length of head in dogs of medium size approximately 21 cm, from muzzle to beween eyes about 9 cm.
identity.ideal_type_summary: That of a light, high stationed, elegant, yet strongly made hunting dog with a noble, comparatively fine head, good leathers and a well carried but in respect of the noble general appearance, remarkably thick tail.
identity.historical_summary: From the formerly numerically strong varieties of the Bracken, the only one surviving in Germany is the Westphalian Bracke. Its most significant local variety was the tricolour Sauerländer Holzbracke. Through melting this type with local Steinbracken, one certain type has evolved, which since 1900 has been designated as the Deutsche Bracke (German Bracke / Hound).
identity.classification: Section 1.3 Small sized hounds. With working trial.

anatomy.head: Fine, clean, elongated. Seen from the front, the head appears narrow and long, the skull only little broader than the not sharply protruding cheeks which merge very gradually with the muzzle.
anatomy.skull: Slightly domed, occiput protrudes but only slightly.
anatomy.muzzle: Nose: Has a light, almost flesh coloured strip in its middle, while the wings of the nose have more or less dark pigment. Bridge of nose: Very slightly convex. Lips: Moderately pendant, corner of mouth small. Teeth / Bite: Extremely strong and even. Incisors meet either on top of each other or the inside of the upper incisors touches the outside of the lower incisors. Canines particularly strongly developed.
anatomy.eyes: Dark, clear with friendly expression.
anatomy.ears: Leathers: Long, about 14 cm and broad, about 9 cm, close fitting and rounded at ends.
anatomy.neck: Moderate length and rather strong in relation to the head.
anatomy.topline: Slightly arched.
anatomy.body: Back: Slightly arched. Croup: Falling away slightly. Chest: Deep, reaching to below elbows. Flatly rounded with long ribcage.
anatomy.chest: Deep, reaching to below elbows. Flatly rounded with long ribcage.
anatomy.tail: Long, not noticeably strong at the root. As a protection against knocking against tree trunks and branches, it has bushy long hair and is therefore comparatively thick, yet tapering to a point and somewhat brush-like. Tail is carried hanging down or upwards in a gentle curve.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: High, very well made, lean, fine boned and sinewy. Shoulder: Clean. Elbow: Close fitting. Forefeet: Longer than cat-feet, coarse, very tight toes.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: Thighs broad and full in profile, lower thigh long and not very broad, well angulated. Hind feet: Longer than cat-feet, coarse, very tight toes.
anatomy.feet: Longer than cat-feet, coarse, very tight toes. Longer than cat-feet, coarse, very tight toes.
anatomy.coat: Long for a short haired dog. Very dense, hard, almost bristly. Well coated and dense on belly. Generally, a little longer on underside of tail forming a moderate brush. Buttocks (thighs) well breeched. Colour: Red to yellow with black saddle or blanket and the white "Bracken" markings: blaze running through, white muzzle with neck ring (closed neck ring should be aimed for), white chest, legs and tip of tail.
anatomy.color: Red to yellow with black saddle or blanket and the white "Bracken" markings: blaze running through, white muzzle with neck ring (closed neck ring should be aimed for), white chest, legs and tip of tail.
anatomy.size: Height at withers: 40 to 53 cm. Moderate departure from these measurements permitted.

disqualifying: Any dog clearly showing physical of behavioural abnormalities

identity.historical_function: Copoi.
identity.general_impression: Mai degrabă lung în corp și destul de jos pe picioare. Aspect de câine robust și puternic, mai mult decât elegant și rapid. Port mândru, musculatură bună, impresie de agilitate. Masculii și femelele net diferiți.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Mai degrabă lung în corp și destul de jos pe picioare.
identity.historical_summary: Westphalian Dachsbracke, copoiul german de talie mică, a fost importat în Suedia în 1910; primii câini înregistrați în 1913. Din 1930 și-a câștigat reputație la căutarea și urmărirea cerbului. În 1947, varietatea suedeză (cu 2 cm mai înaltă decât rasa de origine) a primit numele Drever, recunoscut ca rasă suedeză în 1953. Copoi de primă calitate la cerb, dar și de încredere la iepure și vulpe. Ținut aproape exclusiv ca și câine de vânătoare.

anatomy.head: Destul de lat față de corp. Alungit, se subțiază spre trufă.
anatomy.skull: Doar ușor bombat.
anatomy.muzzle: Bine dezvoltat, niciodată ascuțit; nas drept sau foarte ușor convex. Trufă neagră, cu nări deschise. Buze ferme, aderente, acoperă perfect dinții; comisura nevizibilă.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Fălci puternice, cu mușcătură în foarfece perfectă. Se admite cleștele.
anatomy.eyes: Strălucitori și expresivi, neieșiți; maro-închis. Pleoape aderente.
anatomy.ears: Inserate destul de jos, de lungime și lățime medie, pendulante fără cute, lipite de obraji; vârfuri rotunjite.
anatomy.neck: Adecvat de lung și puternic, se contopește armonios în umeri; piele elastică, fără salbă.
anatomy.body: Spate puternic și musculos, ușor descendent spre crupă. Șale puternice și relativ scurte, ușor arcuite din lateral. Crupă ușor înclinată, lungă și amplă. Torace lung, bine dezvoltat, oval, net coborât sub cot; coaste bine dezvoltate. Abdomen ușor ridicat.
anatomy.tail: Lungă și groasă la bază. De preferat pendulă, dar poate fi purtată mai sus, niciodată peste spate.
anatomy.forequarters: Din față drepte, cu osatură puternică. Omoplat lung, amplu și musculos (cca 50° din orizontală). Braț proporțional lung (unghi cu omoplatul cca 100°). Coți nedeviați. Metacarp elastic, ușor unghiat. Picioare ferme, cu degete strânse.

identity.historical_function: Scenthound.

identity.historical_summary: The Norwegian Hound is named after the Norwegian captain Wilhelm Conrad Dunker, who created the breed by crossing several scent hound breeds in the first half of the 19th century. The county’s hound group was large and included local hare hounds from all over the country. A characteristic trait of the Norwegian Hound has always been the blue-marbled (merle) coat colour and walleyes, although the breed standard also allows other colours. During the Second World War numbers declined but interest increased significally after the war and up to the 1970s, after which the popularity again dwindled. In the 1980s, the breed was very homogenous with excellent hunting abilities. However, due to inbreeding, most dogs were too closely related hence application were made at several stages and eventually granted was given for some crossbreeding which resulted in breed much better genetic variation and health, still maintaining the typical and positive characteristics. Unfortunately, the population figure is still low.
identity.classification: Section 1.2 Medium-sized Hounds. With working trial.

anatomy.skull: Slightly arched, prominent occiput. Provided the muzzle is long and well developed, a somewhat powerful skull is permissible, in males in particular, as long as the head does not lose its parallel planes.
anatomy.stop: Defined, but not deep or abrupt.
anatomy.muzzle: Rather longer than short, squarely cut. Straight and evenly broad nasal bridge. Nose: Black. Wide nostrils.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Scissor bite. Complete dentition.
anatomy.eyes: Dark. Round in appearance. Rather large, but not protruding. Bright and expressive with a calm and earnest expression. Eyelids close fitting. Wall eyes are permitted in blue marbled (merle) dogs.
anatomy.ears: Medium high set, rather lower than high. Smooth, moderately wide, tapering, rounded at the end. Hanging flat without folds. close to head. Long enough to extend halfway along the muzzle when pulled forward.
anatomy.neck: Fairly long, without noticeable throatiness.
anatomy.topline: Straight and firm. Of sufficient length to give length to rib cage.
anatomy.body: Top line: Level. Back: Straight and firm. Of sufficient length to give length to rib cage. Loin: Broad and muscular, not roached. Croup: Slightly sloping, muscular, not too short. Chest: Capacious chest with well sprung ribs; the back ribs should be particularly well developed, making the ribcage appear long. Underline and belly: Slightly tucked up belly.
anatomy.chest: Capacious chest with well sprung ribs; the back ribs should be particularly well developed, making the ribcage appear long.
anatomy.tail: Set on level with the topline. Thick at the root, tapering towards the end. The tail should be straight and carried in a slight upward curve, reaching down to the hock or slightly below.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: Strong, dry and sinewy forelegs. Shoulder: Muscular, long and sloping shoulder blades, lying close to the chest, closely set at the top. Upper arm: Well angulated to shoulder. Elbow: Well angulated at joint. Forearm: Straight. Metacarpus (Pastern): Slightly sloping. Forefeet: Arched and well-knit feet, well covered with hair between the toes. Firm pads. The feet should point straight forward.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: Well angulated. Stand parallel, not crouched nor cow-hocked. Thigh: Broad. Stifle (Knee): Well angulated. Lower thigh: Broad. Hock joint: Dry and low set, broad seen from the side. Hind feet: Arched and well-knit, well covered with hair between the toes. Firm pads. The feet should point straight forward.
anatomy.feet: Arched and well-knit feet, well covered with hair between the toes. Firm pads. The feet should point straight forward. Arched and well-knit, well covered with hair between the toes. Firm pads. The feet should point straight forward.
anatomy.movement: Free movement, covering ground. Parallel from behind, not crouched nor cow-hocked.
anatomy.coat: Straight, hard, dense and not too short. The back of the thighs and the tail may be somewhat more profusely coated, provided the coat is otherwise particularly good. Colour: Diluted black with tan-markings or blue marbled (merle) with pale tan-markings and white markings. Jet black with warm tan-markings is less desirable. 50% or more white is undesirable. White markings that reach out on the shoulders, on the underside of the belly and on legs (socks) is accepted as a correct marking.
anatomy.color: Diluted black with tan-markings or blue marbled (merle) with pale tan-markings and white markings. Jet black with warm tan-markings is less desirable. 50% or more white is undesirable. White markings that reach out on the shoulders, on the underside of the belly and on legs (socks) is accepted as a correct marking.
anatomy.size: Height at the withers: Males: 50–58 cm, ideally 52–54 cm Females: 47–54 cm, ideally 49–51 cm.

temperament.behavior: The Norwegian Hound is considered to be the hardy and robust scent hound of old times, a dog with an excellent temperament. The breed is characterized by strong nerves and by being especially sociable and trusting. They are known to have done well in hunting trials. They can thus be characterized as an excellent combination of a hunting and companion dog. Due to its good temperament and open nature, the breed is also easy to train.
temperament.temperament_notes: • Male animals should have two apparently normal testicles fully descended into the scrotum. • Only functionally and clinically healthy dogs, with breed typical conformation, should be used for breeding. The latest amendments are in bold characters.

minor: White colour reaching the saddle on diluted black/pale tanmarked, or white spots in the merle colour
disqualifying: Any dog clearly showing physical or behavioural abnormalities
