identity.historical_function: Hunting Dog (Hound) which is able to hunt independently, also at a great distance from his handler. Excellently suited to the finding and pursuit of a trail. When he finds a fresh scent, he yaps with a whining sound; during the hunt giving tongue to the scent, his barking is resounding, high pitched and ringing. He drives and points game in an excellent manner. He works smoothly alone or being part of a brace.
identity.general_impression: The shape and the carriage of the head, the body proportions, the strong muscular limbs and the tail set of the Hungarian Hound correspond to the characteristics of the Mid-European type of Hounds. It is medium sized. The body formation of the Hungarian Hound has adapted to the work over long distances. He is athletically built, neither coarse nor fine boned.
identity.ideal_type_summary: The shape and the carriage of the head, the body proportions, the strong muscular limbs and the tail set of the Hungarian Hound correspond to the characteristics of the Mid-European type of Hounds.
identity.historical_summary: The Erdelyi Kopó is an ancient Hungarian breed, which has been determined by the peculiarities of the climate, the territory and the hunting conditions. The breed reached its climax in the Middle Ages, at a time when it was the favourite hunting dog of the aristocracy. Regarding its original use, it was pushed back into the path-less woods of the Carpathian mountains, due to the developments in agriculture and forestry. As a result of the influence of the various conditions of the terrain, two varieties of the Erdelyi Kopó evolved: the long legged and the short legged variety. These two varieties were always kept together. Originally the long legged Hungarian Hound was used for hunting big game like buffaloes and later bears, wild boars and lynxes, while the short legged Hound was used for hunting small game like foxes or hares in overgrown terrain and chamois in rocky areas. At the beginning of the 20th century, the Hungarian Hound was nearly extinct. The determined breeding was resumed in 1968. Nowadays a significant number of dogs of the long legged variety exists in Hungary and in the neighbouring Romania; the short legged variety disappeared.
identity.classification: Section 1.2. Medium sized Hounds. With working trial.

anatomy.head: It is a longish but not pointed Hound head; the difference between the sexes is distinct.
anatomy.skull: Slightly domed. The occiput is not pronounced. The superciliary ridges are slightly developed.
anatomy.muzzle: Bridge of nose straight. Nose: The nose is not too bluntly cut off, the colour is black. The nostrils are mobile and wide. Lips: Dry and tight fitting. The colour of the mucous membrane is black.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: The jaws are strong. The teeth are strong and well developed. Complete scissor bite, according to the dentition formula.
anatomy.eyes: Of medium size, almond shaped, slightly oblique. The colour is dark brown. The lids are close-fitting to the eyeball.
anatomy.ears: Set medium high, not too heavy, hanging closely to the cheeks without being folded. They widen from the base and then taper towards the rounded tip. Pulled forwards, the leathers cover the eyes but normally do not reach further.
anatomy.neck: Very muscular, of medium length. The skin forms slight folds on the throat. A slight dewlap is permitted but not desirable.
anatomy.topline: Straight.
anatomy.body: The body has the shape of a prone rectangle. Topline: Straight. Withers: Pronounced. Back: Straight behind the withers with well developed muscles. Loin: In bitches a slightly longer loin is permitted. Croup: Slightly sloping. Chest: The sternum does not protrude. The brisket is broad, long and not too deep. In cross section, it is oval, nearly rounded, to ensure easy breathing. Underline and belly: Belly only slightly tucked up.
anatomy.chest: The sternum does not protrude. The brisket is broad, long and not too deep. In cross section, it is oval, nearly rounded, to ensure easy breathing.
anatomy.tail: Set on at medium height, strong. In repose, the lower third of the tail is curved slightly upwards. It reaches, preferably, one to two cm beyond the hocks. When excited, the dog carries his tail curved, yet not curled, over the back. The tail is not docked.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: Seen from the front, the front legs are parallel and, as a result of the broad chest, adequately far apart. Shoulders: Shoulder blade well muscled, adequately long and moderately sloping. Elbows: Close-fitting to the ribcage. Forearm: Straight and symmetric. Forefeet: Large with well knit, strong, arched toes. The pads are large, firm and well cushioned. Nails strong and as black as possible.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: When standing, the hind legs are slightly overstretched beyond the rear; well muscled. Upper thigh: Long. Hocks: Low set. Metatarsus: Straight and parallel. Hind feet: Toes well knit and strong. Pads large, firm and well cushioned. Nails strong and as black as possible. Dewclaws should be removed.
anatomy.feet: Large with well knit, strong, arched toes. The pads are large, firm and well cushioned. Nails strong and as black as possible. Toes well knit and strong. Pads large, firm and well cushioned. Nails strong and as black as possible. Dewclaws should be removed.
anatomy.movement: The stride is long and ground covering, never mincing. The trot is ground covering. When at work, his gallop is extremely enduring.
anatomy.coat: The whole body, even the underside of the belly, is covered by short, straight, dense, flat coat. On the neck, the withers, the back of the upper thighs and the underside of the tail, the coat is longer than on the other parts of the body. Cow-licks and ridges may occur. The coat is coarse to the touch and shiny. Undercoat under the topcoat. Colour: The primary colour of the Hungarian Hound is black. There is always a not too dark tan point on each eyebrow. Tan markings on muzzle and legs. The tan is distinctly demarcated from the black. On the nose, a white marking may occur, possibly extending to a blaze on the forehead, to a collar around the neck, to the chest, under the chest and to the lower parts of the legs and the feet. A white marking may also occur on the tip of the tail. White on more than one fifth of the whole body is undesirable.
anatomy.color: The primary colour of the Hungarian Hound is black. There is always a not too dark tan point on each eyebrow. Tan markings on muzzle and legs. The tan is distinctly demarcated from the black. On the nose, a white marking may occur, possibly extending to a blaze on the forehead, to a collar around the neck, to the chest, under the chest and to the lower parts of the legs and the feet. A white marking may also occur on the tip of the tail. White on more than one fifth of the whole body is undesirable.
anatomy.size: Ideal height at withers: 55 to 65 cm The decisive criterion is the overall balance rather than the mere measure in cm. Weight: Minimum 25 kg.
anatomy.skin: The skin of the Hungarian Hound is medium thick. Especially in the throat region it is a little loose but never folded. It has a dark pigment. Bare areas of skin are black.

temperament.behavior: Good-natured, courageous, enduring. The basic character of the Hungarian Hound is quiet, even, but also determined and lively. He even stands extreme weather conditions.

identity.historical_function: Great Gascon Saintongeois: Dog used for shooting and sometimes hunting big game but also hare; generally with the pack or alone as a sleuth. Small Gascon Saintongeois: Versatile dog used for shooting. Its origins make it a hare specialist but also a good hunter of big game.
identity.general_impression: Great G.S.: Very well constructed dog, giving at the same time an impression of strength and elegance. Very French in type with regards to the head, coat, and expression. Small G.S.: Medium sized dog, well proportioned and distinguished.
identity.important_proportions: Height at the withers/scapular-ischial length, ratio 10/10.5 Length of muzzle equal to that of the skull.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Great G.S.: Very well constructed dog, giving at the same time an impression of strength and elegance.
identity.historical_summary: Great G.S.: In the middle of the 19th century the Count Joseph de Carayon-Latour, wanting to regenerate the declining breed of the Hound of Saintonge, crossed the last descendants with the Bleu de Gascogne of Baron Ruble, thus creating the Gascon Saintongeois but causing the extinction of the Hound of Saintonge. Small G.S.: In the middle of the 20th century some hunters from the South West of France selected the smallest subjects from their litters of Great Gascon Saintongeois and thus created this variety, intended originally for hare hunting.
identity.classification: Groupe 6 Scenthounds. Great G.S.: Section 1.1 Large sized scenthounds With working trial. Small G.S.: Section 1.2 Medium sized scenthounds. With working trial.

anatomy.head: The lines of the skull and the muzzle are divergent.
anatomy.skull: Seen from the front, domed and rather narrow; the occipital protuberance is well defined. Seen from above, the back of the skull is of a pronounced ogival shape.
anatomy.muzzle: Strong; slightly convex. Nose: Black, well developed; nostrils well opened. Lips: Covering the lower jaw; corners discreet. The edges of the lips are black.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Scissor bite. Incisors are set well square to the jaws.
anatomy.eyes: Oval shape; brown. Edges of eyelids are black. Gentle and trusting expression.
anatomy.ears: Fine and curled, they should reach at least the tip of the nose. Set on below the level of the eye and placed rather backwards, freeing the skull.
anatomy.neck: Of medium length and thickness. Slightly arched with little dewlap.
anatomy.topline: Very taut, without excess in length.
anatomy.body: Back: Very taut, without excess in length. Loin: Well attached, slightly arched, quite muscular and not too long. Croup: Of good length, slightly sloping. Chest: Broad and long, reaching the elbow. Forechest rather broad. Ribs: Slightly rounded and long. Flank: Slightly tucked up.
anatomy.chest: Broad and long, reaching the elbow. Forechest rather broad. Ribs: Slightly rounded and long. Flank: Slightly tucked up.
anatomy.tail: Strong set on; tapering well to the tip, reaching the point of the hock. Carried elegantly like a sabre.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: Powerful forehand. Shoulder: Quite long, muscled; moderately oblique. Elbow: Close to the body. Forearm: Strong bone. Forefeet: Slightly elongated oval; toes lean and tight-fitting. Pads and nails black.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: Well proportioned. Upper thigh: Long and well muscled. Hock: Broad, well angulated and well let down in line with the body. Hind feet: Slightly elongated oval; toes lean and tight-fitting. Pads and nails black.
anatomy.feet: Slightly elongated oval; toes lean and tight-fitting. Pads and nails black. Slightly elongated oval; toes lean and tight-fitting. Pads and nails black.
anatomy.movement: Regular and effortless.
anatomy.coat: Short and tight. Colour: The ground colour is white with black patches and sometimes speckled but not excessively. Two black patches are generally placed at either side of the head, covering the ears, surrounding the eyes and stopping at the cheeks. The cheeks are tan, preferably pale. Two tan markings placed above the superciliary arches give the eyes a “quatroeillé” (four-eyed) appearance. Traces of tan are also found on the inner side of the ears and in speckles along the legs. Some fawn hairs may appear on the upper part of the ear but without giving the head a tricolour appearance. Sometimes at the base of the upper thigh there is a typical dead-leaf marking called “roe buck mark”.

anatomy.size: Grand G.S.: Males: 65 to 72 cm Females: 62 to 68 cm Small G.S.: Males: 56 to 62 cm Females: 54 to 59 cm With tolerance of +/- 1 cm.
anatomy.skin: Supple and not too thick. White with black patches.

temperament.behavior: Pack hound par excellence, fine-nosed, wide-casting and endowed with a very sonorous voice. Joins the pack instinctively. Calm, affectionate and amenable to orders.
temperament.temperament_notes: • Male animals should have two apparently normal testicles fully descended into the scrotum. • Only functionally and clinically healthy dogs, with breed typical conformation should be used for breeding.

minor: Shoulder too oblique or too straight
disqualifying: Any dog clearly showing physical or behavioural abnormalities
Lack of type and, in particular, broad and round skull
Any other coat than that stipulated in the standard

identity.historical_function: Copoi.
identity.general_impression: Câine mare destul de puternic, rezistent și robust, cu osatură puternică ce amintește originea gascon-saintongeoise.
identity.important_proportions: Bot ceva mai scurt decât craniul. Lungimea corpului (umăr–fesă) egală cu înălțimea la greabăn.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Câine mare destul de puternic, rezistent și robust, cu osatură puternică ce amintește originea gascon-saintongeoise.
identity.historical_summary: Provine din „Bâtard Anglo-Saintongeois”, tip apărut la mijlocul secolului XIX din încrucișarea câinelui de Saintonge cu Foxhound-ul. Rasa numără cca 2000 de câini; formează haitele a vreo douăzeci de echipaje pentru vânatul de căprior. Text din 2007.

anatomy.head: Puternic, mai degrabă scurt, cu linii cranio-faciale paralele.
anatomy.skull: Mai degrabă plat și lat, cu creastă occipitală abia marcată. Arcade sprâncenare proeminente.
anatomy.muzzle: Drept și ceva mai scurt decât craniul. Trufă neagră, dezvoltată și proeminentă, cu nări deschise. Buze cu cadratură accentuată; cea superioară o acoperă bine pe cea inferioară.
anatomy.eyes: Maro, destul de înfundați, fără exagerare.
anatomy.ears: Inserate destul de late la nivelul liniei ochilor; destul de plate la bază, se răsucesc spre vârf. De lungime medie; trase înainte ajung cel mult la două degete de baza trufei; se termină mai degrabă ascuțite.
anatomy.neck: Puternic, mai degrabă scurt; se tolerează o salbă ușoară.
anatomy.body: Spate drept și bine susținut. Șale destul de late și scurte. Crupă ușor oblică; șolduri destul de late. Flanc plin. Torace lat, coborât la cot. Coaste mediu arcuite.
anatomy.tail: Puternică la rădăcină, cu vârf fin, lungă și dreaptă; în mișcare purtată peste linia dorsală, dar nu vertical.
anatomy.hindquarters: Din spate paralele. Coapse bine coborâte, musculoase, nu prea rotunde. Jarete puternice, bine coborâte și ușor unghiate.
anatomy.feet: Groși și mari, mai degrabă rotunzi.
anatomy.movement: Suplă. Preferat: galop agil și alungit.
anatomy.coat: Ras dar destul de puternic și des.
anatomy.color: Obligatoriu alb și negru, cu șa mare și pete negre; poate avea moscături negre ori albăstrui, ori mici focuri (doar pe membre). Focuri palide deasupra ochilor, pe obraji, sub ochi, sub urechi și la inserția cozii. Frecvent „marca de căprior” la coapsă.
anatomy.size: Masculi 65–72 cm; femele 62–68 cm (toleranță ±1 cm).
anatomy.skin: Albă sub părul alb, neagră sub cel negru, uneori cu pete albăstrui pe abdomen și interiorul coapselor.

temperament.behavior: Excelează la vânatul de cerb și căprior în vegetație deasă ori umedă. Prietenos, atașat de om, ușor de gestionat.
temperament.temperament_notes: Masculii trebuie să aibă doi testiculi de aspect normal, complet coborâți în scrot.

serious: Negru pe obraji prelungit până la buze

identity.ideal_type_summary: Câine destul de puternic, cu un cap care trădează originea engleză mai mult decât la Grand Anglo-Français tricolor.

anatomy.head: Destul de scurt și lat.

anatomy.muzzle: Nas mai degrabă scurt. Trufă neagră ori brun-portocaliu. Buze care depășesc maxilarul inferior, dând o oarecare cadratură.
anatomy.eyes: Mari, maro-închis.
anatomy.ears: Inserate destul de late la nivelul liniei ochiului ori puțin peste, destul de groase, ușor răsucite și mai degrabă scurte.
anatomy.neck: Drept; salbă ușoară.
anatomy.body: Spate lat și musculos. Șale late și mai degrabă scurte. Crupă mai degrabă rotunjită. Torace destul de înalt și coborât. Coaste lungi, ușor arcuite. Flancuri pline.
anatomy.tail: Destul de lungă, uneori ușor spicată.
anatomy.forequarters: Puternice, late și în aplomb. Omoplați aderenți dar bine musculoși.
anatomy.hindquarters: Coapse musculoase și bine rotunjite. Jarete ușor unghiate și aproape de sol.
anatomy.feet: Mai degrabă rotunzi.
anatomy.movement: Ușor.
anatomy.coat: Ras și nu prea gros.
anatomy.color: Alb-lămâie ori alb-portocaliu, cu condiția ca portocaliul să nu fie prea închis spre roșu.
anatomy.skin: Albă, cu pete portocalii ori galbene.

identity.general_impression: Câine solid la care predomină tipul francez, cu o oarecare distincție, care poate trăda în grade diferite originea Foxhound.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Câine solid la care predomină tipul francez, cu o oarecare distincție, care poate trăda în grade diferite originea Foxhound.

anatomy.skull: Moderat de lat, mai degrabă plat, cu protuberanță occipitală ușor aparentă și arcade sprâncenare ușor proeminente.
anatomy.muzzle: Nas de lungime medie, cca de lungimea craniului, în general drept; bine cizelat sub ochi. Buze destul de dezvoltate, cu o oarecare cadratură, niciodată ascuțite.
anatomy.eyes: Mari, maro, cu margini negre.
anatomy.ears: De lungime medie, inserate destul de late la nivelul liniei ochiului, plate, apoi ușor răsucite.
anatomy.neck: Destul de lung și puternic, fără salbă pronunțată.
anatomy.topline: Drept și susținut.
anatomy.body: Spate drept și susținut. Șale late, musculoase, rectilinii, mai degrabă scurte. Crupă oblică și de bună lungime. Flanc foarte ușor ridicat și destul de plin. Torace bine coborât și destul de lat; coaste lungi și arcuite, niciodată plate.
anatomy.tail: De bună lungime, purtată elegant, cu păr des.
anatomy.forequarters: Perfect drepte și puternice. Omoplați lungi și plați.
anatomy.hindquarters: Coapse musculoase, coborâte și mai degrabă rotunjite. Jarete late, aproape de sol, ușor unghiate.
anatomy.feet: Uscate și mai degrabă rotunde.
anatomy.movement: Ușor, cu impresie de soliditate.
anatomy.coat: Scurt, mai mult ori mai puțin puternic.
anatomy.color: Tricolor, cel mai adesea cu șa neagră ori pete mai mult sau mai puțin întinse. Focuri vii ori arămii, nu cărbonate. Nu se exclude părul amestecat „de lup”. Excesul de moscături nu se caută.

breeds.source_standard_title: WDF breed standard — GRAND BASSET GRIFFON VENDEEN

identity.historical_function: It is the perfect assistant for the hunter with a gun in territories of moderate size. Fastest of all the scenthound bassets, tenacious, courageous, and a little stubborn. It must, from an early age, be accustomed to obeying; its training implies will and punishment, for which he will bear no grudge.
identity.general_impression: Slightly elongated overall, it has straight forelegs, the structure of a basset, and must not resemble a small Briquet. It is balanced and elegant.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Slightly elongated overall, it has straight forelegs, the structure of a basset, and must not resemble a small Briquet.
identity.historical_summary: The Grand Basset Griffon Vendéen is derived, like all bassets, from hounds of superior size, in this case the Grand Griffon. The first selections were made at the end of the 19th century by the Comte d’Elva who was looking for subjects with « straight legs ». But it was Paul Dezamy who was especially responsible for fixing the type. He understood that in order to catch a hare, dogs of a certain size were needed. He fixed that size at about 43 cm. Today used primarily when hunting with a gun, it is capable of hunting all furry game, from the rabbit to wild boar. A team of Grand Bassets won the 5th edition of the European Cup for hare.
identity.classification: Section 1.3 Small-sized Hounds. With working trial.

anatomy.skull: Without heaviness, convex, elongated and not too wide, well chiselled below the eyes. Occipital bone well developed.
anatomy.muzzle: Square at its extremity, noticeably longer than the skull, very slightly convex. Nose: Prominent. Nostrils well open. Black and developed, except for white and orange coats where a brown nose is tolerated. Lips: Quite pendulous, covering well the lower jaw and giving the front of the muzzle a square profile. They are well covered with moustaches.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Jaws strongly developed, scissor bite.
anatomy.eyes: Of oval shape, large, dark, not showing white; friendly and intelligent expression. The conjunctiva must not be apparent.
anatomy.ears: Leathers supple, narrow and fine, covered with long hair and ending in an elongated oval, well turned inwards. Low set, below the eye. They must be able to reach beyond the end of the nose.
anatomy.neck: Long, robust and well muscled. Strong at set-on. Without dewlap.
anatomy.topline: Long, broad and really straight, never saddle-backed, and starting to arch its junction with the loin; withers very slightly protruding.
anatomy.body: Really that of a basset but avoiding an exaggerated length. Back: Long, broad and really straight, never saddle-backed, and starting to arch its junction with the loin; withers very slightly protruding. Loin: Solid, well muscled, slightly arched. Chest: Quite broad and well let down to elbow level. Ribs: Rounded, never flat nor cylindrical. Thorax slightly less broad at elbow level to facilitate the movement. Underline and belly: Flank rather full, belly never tucked up.
anatomy.chest: Quite broad and well let down to elbow level. Ribs: Rounded, never flat nor cylindrical. Thorax slightly less broad at elbow level to facilitate the movement.
anatomy.tail: Thick at the base, tapering progressively, set quite high, carried saber fashion or slightly curved but never on the back or bent at the tip. Rather long.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: They must be straight with a thick forearm and a very slightly defined but very solid carpal joint (wrist). Shoulder: Long, clean and oblique. Elbow: Should be neither too close to body nor loose. Forearm: Thick, wrists (carpus) should never touch. Forefeet: Strong and tight with hard pads and solid nails; good pigmentation of pads and nails is desirable.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: Solid and well directed in the axis of the body. Hip (Iliac crest) : Apparent. Thigh: Strongly muscled but not too rounded, bone structure and articulations very solid. Hock: Wide and angulated, must never be straight. Seen from the rear, it should not appear turned outwards or inwards. Hind feet: Strong and tight with hard pads and solid nails; good pigmentation of pads and nails is desirable.
anatomy.feet: Strong and tight with hard pads and solid nails; good pigmentation of pads and nails is desirable. Strong and tight with hard pads and solid nails; good pigmentation of pads and nails is desirable.
anatomy.movement: The dog in action must give an impression of resistance and ease; the movement must be free and harmonious.
anatomy.coat: Hard, not too long and flat, never silky or woolly. The fringes should not be too abundant; the belly and inside of the thighs must not be bare; eyebrows well pronounced but not covering the eye. Colour: Black with white spotting (white and black). Black with tan markings (black and tan). Black with light tan markings. Fawn with white spotting (white and orange). Fawn with black mantle and white spotting (tricolour). Fawn with black overlay. Pale fawn with black overlay and white spotting. Pale fawn with black overlay. Traditional names: hare colour, wolf colour, badger colour or wild boar colour.
anatomy.color: Black with white spotting (white and black). Black with tan markings (black and tan). Black with light tan markings. Fawn with white spotting (white and orange). Fawn with black mantle and white spotting (tricolour). Fawn with black overlay. Pale fawn with black overlay and white spotting. Pale fawn with black overlay. Traditional names: hare colour, wolf colour, badger colour or wild boar colour.
anatomy.size: Height at withers: Males from 40 to 44 cm. Females from 39 to 43 cm. With a tolerance of 1cm more or less.
anatomy.skin: Quite thick, often marbled in the tricoloured subjects. No dewlap.

temperament.behavior: Behaviour: Fast, well voiced, a passionate hunter; courageous, loves bramble and scrub. Temperament: A little stubborn but nevertheless well behaved. It is up to the master to take command.
temperament.temperament_notes: • Male animals should have two apparently normal testicles fully descended into the scrotum. • Only functionally and clinically healthy dogs, with breed typical conformation should be used for breeding.

minor: Depigmentation of the nose, lips or eyelids
disqualifying: Any dog clearly showing physical or behavioural abnormalities
Wall eye. Eyes of different colours (Heterochromia)
Lack of room in the sternal region; ribs narrow towards the lower part

identity.historical_function: Câine folosit la vânătoare cu pușca și uneori ca și copoi, la vânat mare dar și la iepure, în haită ori ca limier.
identity.general_impression: Câine de rasă veche, eminamente de tip francez la cap, manta și expresie. Impunător, dă impresie de forță liniștită și mare noblețe.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Câine de rasă veche, eminamente de tip francez la cap, manta și expresie.
identity.historical_summary: Foarte vechi; contemporan cu Saint-Hubert, forma în secolul XIV haitele lui Gaston Fébus, conte de Foix, folosit la lup, urs și mistreț. Răspândit în sudul Franței, mai ales în Gasconia, e strămoșul tuturor copoilor „du Midi”.

anatomy.skull: Din față ușor bombat, nu prea lat; occiput marcat. De sus, partea posterioară e ovală. Frunte plină.
anatomy.muzzle: Nas de lungimea craniului, puternic, ușor berbecat. Trufă neagră, bine dezvoltată, cu nări deschise. Buze destul de căzute, care acoperă bine maxilarul inferior, dând un profil pătrat; comisura bine marcată, nu laxă.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Mușcătură în foarfece; incisivi perpendiculari. Obraji uscați, cu una-două cute.
anatomy.eyes: Ovali, par ușor înfundați între pleoape groase, maro. Pleoapa inferioară uneori puțin lăsată. Expresie blândă și puțin tristă.
anatomy.ears: Caracteristice câinelui albastru; fine, răsucite, ascuțite la vârf, depășesc trufa. Înguste la inserție, bine sub linia ochiului.
anatomy.neck: Mediu de lung, ușor arcuit superior; salbă dezvoltată.
anatomy.body: Spate mai degrabă lung dar bine susținut. Șale bine inserate. Crupă ușor oblică, face să iasă șoldurile. Torace lung și lat, coboară la coți.
anatomy.tail: Mai degrabă groasă, uneori ușor spicată; ajunge la vârful jaretului; inserție puternică; purtată în sabie.
anatomy.forequarters: Anterior puternic. Omoplat destul de lung și musculos, bine oblic. Coți aderenți. Antebraț cu osatură puternică, tendoane proeminente.
anatomy.hindquarters: Posterior solid. Coapsă lungă și musculoasă. Jaret larg, ușor unghiat, bine coborât.
anatomy.feet: De oval puțin alungit; degete uscate și strânse. Perinițe și unghii negre.
anatomy.movement: Regulat și dezinvolt.
anatomy.coat: Scurt, destul de gros, bine des.
anatomy.color: Integral moscat (negru și alb), dând reflexe albastru-ardezie, cu sau fără pete negre. De obicei două pete negre pe fiecare parte a capului, acoperind urechile și încercuind ochii; nu se ating pe creștet, lăsând un interval alb în mijlocul căruia se află adesea o mică pată neagră ovală, tipică rasei. Două focuri deasupra sprâncenelor (patru ochi); focuri și pe obraji, buze, interiorul urechilor, membre și sub coadă.
anatomy.size: Masculi 65–72 cm; femele 62–68 cm.
anatomy.skin: Destul de groasă, elastică. Neagră ori mult marmorată cu negru, niciodată complet albă. Mucoase negre.

temperament.behavior: Cu miros foarte fin; voce de urlător cu tonuri grave. Foarte diligent la vânătoare. Se adună instinctiv în haită. Calm; ascultă ușor.
temperament.temperament_notes: Masculii trebuie să aibă doi testiculi de aspect normal, complet coborâți în scrot.

identity.historical_function: Copoi folosit la vânătoare cu pușca, uneori la forțarea vânatului mare (cerb, căprior, mistreț, vulpe); de obicei în haită ori singur ca limier.
identity.general_impression: Câine de rasă veche, de tip francez, receptiv și hotărât, distins în forme și mers. Construcție bine proporționată, robustă, fără greutate.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Câine de rasă veche, de tip francez, receptiv și hotărât, distins în forme și mers.
identity.historical_summary: Inițial exista doar Marele Vandeean, o varietate cu păr ras descendentă din „greffiers” ori câinii albi ai regelui. La origine au contribuit și griffonii fulvo de Bretania, câinii gri ai Sf. Ludovic și griffonii de Bresse.

anatomy.skull: Din față destul de bombat, dar nu prea lat între urechi.
anatomy.muzzle: De lungimea craniului. Nas drept sau ușor berbecat. Trufă puternică, neagră (tolerat maro la alb-portocaliu), cu nări deschise. Buze destul de pendulante, care acoperă bine maxilarul inferior, dând un profil pătrat; cu mustăți bune.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Mușcătură în foarfece; incisivi perpendiculari.
anatomy.eyes: Închiși, mari și vioi, cu sprâncene dese care nu ascund ochiul. Conjunctiva nevizibilă.
anatomy.ears: Tipice copoilor francezi; moi, înguste și fine, cu păr lung, oval alungit, bine răsucite în interior; inserate jos, sub linia ochiului, depășesc trufa.
anatomy.neck: Elegant, fără salbă.
anatomy.body: Spate solid, drept ori abia rimontant. Șale bine musculate. Torace nu prea lat, destul de înalt, coboară la cot; coaste mediu arcuite și lungi. Flanc ușor ridicat, dar plin.
anatomy.tail: Groasă la rădăcină, se subțiază treptat. Inserată sus, purtată în sabie, niciodată în seceră. Mai degrabă lungă.
anatomy.forequarters: Anterior puternic. Omoplat lung, uscat și oblic. Cot aderent. Antebraț cu osatură puternică, drept.
anatomy.hindquarters: Posterior solid. Șold evident. Coapsă lungă și musculoasă. Jaret larg și bine coborât; din spate nici închis, nici deschis; din lateral, unghiulare medie.
anatomy.feet: Nu prea puternici, cu perinițe dure, degete arcuite și strânse, unghii solide. Mers elastic, regulat și activ.
anatomy.coat: Lung fără exagerare, uneori stufos și aspru (gros și dur), cu subpăr des. Abdomenul și interiorul coapselor nu golașe. Sprâncene evidente, care nu ascund ochiul.
anatomy.color: Negru pătat cu alb; negru cu focuri; negru cu marcaje nisip; fulvo cu alb; fulvo cu șa neagră și alb (tricolor); fulvo cărbonat; nisip cărbonat cu/fără alb. Culori numite tradițional „păr de iepure”, „de lup”, „de bursuc”, „de mistreț”.
anatomy.size: Masculi 62–68 cm; femele 60–65 cm (toleranță ±1 cm).
anatomy.skin: Nu prea fină, elastică. Adesea marmorată la tricolori. Fără salbă.

temperament.behavior: Cu miros fin, voce frumoasă; diligent pe urmă (nu refuză mărăcinișul), are nevoie de spații mari. Docil dar voluntar și pasionat, trebuie bine condus.
temperament.temperament_notes: Masculii trebuie să aibă doi testiculi de aspect normal, complet coborâți în scrot.

disqualifying: Regiune sternală insuficient de amplă; coaste închise în jos

identity.historical_function: Câine foarte polivalent, folosit la vânătoare cu pușca la iepure. Pasiunea și mirosul fin îl fac prețios și pe urma mistrețului.
identity.general_impression: Griffon cu aspect rustic, solid construit; stă la mijloc între cele două rase din care provine.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Griffon cu aspect rustic, solid construit; stă la mijloc între cele două rase din care provine.
identity.historical_summary: Originar din Pirinei, rezultat din încrucișarea unui Bleu de Gascogne de talie medie cu un griffon. Aproape dispărut din chinologia oficială, rasa cunoaște acum o reînnoire importantă.

anatomy.skull: Din față ușor bombat, nu prea lat. Occiput ușor pronunțat. De sus, partea posterioară e ogivală. Frunte plină.
anatomy.muzzle: Nas drept sau ușor berbecat, cca de lungimea craniului. Trufă neagră și largă, cu nări deschise. Buze puțin dezvoltate, care acoperă maxilarul inferior.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Mușcătură în foarfece; incisivi perpendiculari. Obraji uscați.
anatomy.eyes: Ovali, maro-închis, foarte expresivi și vioi.
anatomy.ears: Moi, răsucite în interior fără exces, puțin ascuțite. Ajung la începutul trufei fără a o depăși. Inserate chiar sub linia ochiului.
anatomy.neck: Mai degrabă subțire, cu puțină salbă.
anatomy.body: Spate foarte susținut, scurt. Șale musculoase, ușor arcuite. Crupă foarte ușor oblică. Torace bine dezvoltat; coaste arcuite fără exces. Flancuri pline; linia inferioară ușor ridicată spre posterior.
anatomy.tail: Destul de acoperită cu păr. Ajunge la vârful jaretului; inserție puternică; purtată vesel în sabie.
anatomy.forequarters: Puternice și în aplomb, fără greutate. Omoplat destul de oblic și musculos. Cot aderent. Antebraț puternic.
anatomy.hindquarters: Aplomburi regulate. Posterior bine dezvoltat. Coapse foarte musculoase. Jaret bine coborât.
anatomy.feet: Ovali, cu degete uscate și strânse. Unghii și perinițe negre.
anatomy.movement: Elastică și vioaie.
anatomy.coat: Dur, aspru și zbârlit. Ceva mai scurt pe cap, unde sprâncenele (destul de dese) nu acoperă ochii. Mult mai scurt și plat pe urechi.
anatomy.color: Integral moscat (negru și alb), dând reflexe albastru-ardezie, cu sau fără pete negre. De obicei două pete negre pe fiecare parte a capului, acoperind urechile și încercuind ochii; nu se ating pe creștet, lăsând un interval alb în mijlocul căruia se află o mică pată ovală, tipică rasei. Două focuri deasupra sprâncenelor („patru ochi”); focuri și pe obraji, buze, interiorul urechilor, membre și sub coadă.
anatomy.size: Masculi 50–57 cm; femele 48–55 cm.
anatomy.skin: Destul de groasă, elastică. Neagră ori mult marmorată cu negru, niciodată complet albă. Mucoase negre.

temperament.behavior: Cu miros fin, voce frumoasă, diligent la vânătoare, dar plin de ardoare și inițiativă. Treaz, ba chiar expeditiv, dar totuși afectuos.
temperament.temperament_notes: Masculii trebuie să aibă doi testiculi de aspect normal, complet coborâți în scrot.

identity.historical_function: Copoi folosit la iepure, vulpe, căprior și mistreț.
identity.general_impression: Câine osos, musculos, foarte rezistent și tenace. Activ, potrivit terenurilor dificile. Miros fin și voce de gonaci susținută (strigăt scurt și repetat).
identity.ideal_type_summary: Câine osos, musculos, foarte rezistent și tenace.
identity.historical_summary: Una dintre cele mai vechi rase franceze de copoi (în secolul XIV, Huet des Ventes avea deja o haită). Folosit până în secolul XIX la vânatul de lupi în Bretania, a intrat în declin când aceștia au dispărut. Clubul rasei a fost fondat în 1949 de Marcel Pambrun; din anii 1980, sub Bernard Vallée, rasa și-a regăsit locul.

anatomy.skull: Destul de alungit, cu creastă occipitală marcată. Din față, ca un arc turtit care se îngustează spre arcadele sprâncenare, nu foarte marcate.
anatomy.muzzle: Mai degrabă ascuțit decât pătrat. Trufă neagră sau maro-închis, cu nări deschise. Buze care acoperă bine maxilarul inferior, fără exces; mustăți nu foarte abundente.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Fălci și dinți puternici, cu mușcătură în foarfece. Lipsa PM1 nu se penalizează.
anatomy.eyes: Nici ieșiți, nici prea înfundați, maro-închis; conjunctiva nevizibilă. Privire vie.
anatomy.ears: Inserate fin la nivelul liniei ochiului, ajung abia la vârful trufei. Ascuțite, răsucite în interior, cu păr mai ras și fin.
anatomy.neck: Destul de scurt și musculos.
anatomy.body: Spate scurt și lat, niciodată înșeuat. Șale late și bine musculate. Torace adânc și lat; coaste destul de arcuite. Linia inferioară puțin ridicată spre posterior.
anatomy.tail: Purtată ușor în seceră, de lungime medie, groasă la bază, adesea spicată, se subțiază bine. În mișcare purtată peste linia spatelui, cu mișcări laterale regulate.
anatomy.forequarters: Osatură bună, în aplomb. Omoplat înclinat, aderent. Cot în axul corpului. Antebraț vertical. Metacarp ușor oblic din profil.
anatomy.hindquarters: Foarte musculoase, aplomburi regulate; din spate paralele. Coapse lungi și bine musculate. Jarete coborâte și mediu unghiate. Metatarsi verticali.
anatomy.feet: Compacți, cu degete strânse, arcuite, unghii solide. Perinițe dure.
anatomy.movement: Elastică și regulată, niciodată săltată.
anatomy.coat: Foarte dur, uscat, destul de scurt, niciodată lânos ori creț; fața nu prea stufoasă.
anatomy.color: Fulvo, de la grâu-auriu la roșu-cărămiziu. Câteva fire negre pe spate și urechi se tolerează. Uneori o mică stea albă pe piept (nedorită).
anatomy.size: 48–56 cm la ambele sexe (toleranță +2 cm la excepționali).
anatomy.skin: Destul de groasă, elastică. Fără salbă.

temperament.behavior: Iubitor de vânătoare dar foarte blând cu omul, sociabil, afectuos și echilibrat. Se adaptează oricărui teren și vânat. Curajos, iscusit, tenace și diligent, plin de inițiativă; bine condus, ascultător și revine prompt.
temperament.temperament_notes: Masculii trebuie să aibă doi testiculi de aspect normal, complet coborâți în scrot.

disqualifying: Depigmentare parțială sau totală la trufă, pleoape ori buze
Pinteni la posterior (nu apar la această rasă)

identity.historical_function: Copoi folosit mai ales la mistreț, de obicei în haită dar și individual.
identity.general_impression: „Zbârlit”, foarte tipic, robust, foarte rustic și hirsut. Uscat la membre și mușchi, destinat unui lucru de rezistență mai mult decât de viteză; cu aspect puțin trist, dar nu fricos.
identity.important_proportions: Lungimea corpului (umăr–ischion) ceva peste înălțimea la greabăn. Craniu și bot de aceeași lungime.
identity.ideal_type_summary: „Zbârlit”, foarte tipic, robust, foarte rustic și hirsut.
identity.historical_summary: Ar descinde din câinii de goană ai galilor și din câinii gri ai Sf. Ludovic. A avut mare succes 200 de ani, până sub Ludovic al XI-lea; apoi Francisc I i-a preferat câinii albi. Aproape dispărut la Revoluția Franceză, a fost recreat un secol mai târziu, cu aport de Vandeean, Foxhound și Otterhound. Clubul a fost creat în 1925.

anatomy.head: Foarte uscat, ușor fără a fi mic, ceva lung dar nu excesiv. Linii cranio-faciale paralele.
anatomy.skull: Aproape plat, de lățime medie, delimitat de arcade zigomatice puțin pronunțate. Protuberanță occipitală perceptibilă doar la atingere.
anatomy.stop: Puțin marcat (pare mai accentuat când părul se ridică).
anatomy.muzzle: De lungimea craniului; nu prea lat la vârf, fețele laterale converg ușor fără a-l face ascuțit. Puțină barbă la bărbie. Trufă neagră, foarte vizibilă. Buze puțin dezvoltate, care abia acoperă maxilarul inferior; ascunse de mustăți bune, bine pigmentate.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Fălci robuste, normal dezvoltate. Mușcătură în foarfece, uneori în clește; incisivi perpendiculari; dentiție completă (PM1 nu se iau în calcul).
anatomy.eyes: De preferat închiși. Privire vie și pătrunzătoare. Sprâncene abundente dar care nu acoperă ochii. Conjunctiva nevizibilă; pleoape bine pigmentate.
anatomy.ears: Inserate mediu (cca 3 cm lățime) la nivelul liniei superioare a ochiului, pendulante, moi, mai degrabă fine, de lățime medie, ușor răsucite în interior la vârf, destul de acoperite cu păr, semi-lungi, ajung la începutul trufei.
anatomy.neck: Mai degrabă ușor, uscat și fără salbă.
anatomy.topline: Dreaptă, de la greabăn la șale.
anatomy.body: Greabăn abia ieșit din linia spatelui, îngust (vârfurile omoplaților apropiate), se contopește armonios în gât. Spate solid și destul de lung, mai degrabă îngust și susținut, cu musculatură bună dar puțin aparentă. Șale susținute, doar ușor arcuite. Crupă osoasă, puțin oblică, cu mușchi uscați. Torace coboară cât mai jos, spre coți; piept puțin dezvoltat în lățime, cutie lungă care se lărgește spre ultimele coaste. Flanc plin fără exces. Linia inferioară ușor retrasă, dar nu levretată.
anatomy.tail: Inserată puțin sus, nu prea lungă, mai stufoasă la mijloc. În repaus purtată ușor sub orizontală; în mișcare în sabie spre sus, se poate îndoi pe spate la vârf.
anatomy.forequarters: Aplomburi bune; în repaus, din lateral, membrele par puțin în spatele verticalei. Omoplați ușor înclinați, uscați și aderenți. Coți aderenți. Antebraț pare gros din cauza părului, dar e uscat și drept. Metacarp mai degrabă scurt și ușor înclinat.
anatomy.hindquarters: Din profil, ușor sub sine. Din spate, verticala de la fesă trece prin vârful jaretului. Coapse mai degrabă plate. Jarete coborâte, cu unghi mai degrabă închis. Metatars puțin îndreptat înainte.
anatomy.feet: Ovali, ușor alungiți, cu degete solide și strânse; amintesc de piciorul de iepure, cu pigment bun.
anatomy.movement: Moale și elastică (fără salturi). Acoperă mult teren.
anatomy.coat: Lung, hirsut și stufos, destul de puternic și dur (nici lânos, nici creț). Abdomenul și interiorul coapselor nu golașe. Sprâncene evidente, care nu acoperă ochiul. Puțină barbă la bărbie și urechi bine acoperite cu păr.
anatomy.color: Mereu cărbonat: firele au vârful mai închis decât baza. Fulvo mai mult sau mai puțin închis, niciodată portocaliu; vârful cărbonat poate fi albăstrui. Se tolerează fire albe risipite, dând nuanțe de la gri-deschis la gri-închis (trecând prin gri-mistreț). Adesea pete fulvo la sprâncene, obraji, piept, extremitățile membrelor și sub coadă (evident la pui, se atenuează cu vârsta). Exemple: „fulvo ușor cărbonat” (păr de iepure), „nisip cărbonat” (gri-lup), „fulvo cărbonat de albastru” (gri-albastru). Se tolerează o pată albă pe piept.
anatomy.size: Masculi 55–62 cm; femele 53–60 cm.
anatomy.skin: Moale și destul de întinsă, bine aderentă, destul de groasă și pigmentată. Pete negre pe corp, buze bine pigmentate. Fără salbă.

temperament.behavior: Cu miros foarte fin, ager, iubește terenurile dificile și mărăcinișul. Excelent scotocitor, bun vânător, curajos când blochează vânatul, fără a fi temerar. Poate fi folosit, în puține exemplare, la mistreț. Uneori încăpățânat și independent; stăpânul trebuie să știe să se facă ascultat de timpuriu.
temperament.temperament_notes: Masculii trebuie să aibă doi testiculi de aspect normal, complet coborâți în scrot.

minor: Orice abatere de la standard, penalizată după gravitate
disqualifying: Manta: negru absolut (fără fulvo cărbonat); grâu-auriu ori portocaliu; tricolor cu culori vii net delimitate; extremități albe
Depigmentare importantă (trufă, pleoape, buze, contur anal/vulvar, testicule)
Pinteni (în afara țărilor unde legea interzice ablația)

anatomy.head: Clean, of medium size and well balanced.
anatomy.skull: Slightly domed seen from the front and from the side, the occipital protuberance scarcely perceptible.
anatomy.muzzle: Not too short, bridge of nose straight. Nose: Black with open nostrils. Lips: Not too pendulous.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Scissor bite. Complete dentition.
anatomy.eyes: Dark brown, medium-sized, tranquil expression.
anatomy.ears: Leathers Set neither too high nor too low; should reach to the middle of the muzzle when pulled forward.
anatomy.neck: Rather long, strong, clean and without any dewlap.
anatomy.topline: Straight.
anatomy.body: Topline: Straight. Back: Strong. Loin: Broad and muscular. Croup: Slightly sloping. Chest: Deep, with well-sprung ribs, but not barrel-shaped. The back ribs should be particularly well developed. Underline and belly: Very slightly tucked up.
anatomy.chest: Deep, with well-sprung ribs, but not barrel-shaped. The back ribs should be particularly well developed.
anatomy.tail: Set-on neither too high nor too low, rather thick, reaching approximately to the hocks. Carried rather low.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: Legs straight and lean with strong bone. Shoulder: Shoulder blade long and oblique, muscular. Tips not protruding over topline. Forearm: Straight and lean. Pasterns: Slightly sloping. Forefeet: Oval in shape, well arched, preferably well-knit, well covered with hair between the toes.
anatomy.hindquarters: Upper thigh: Broad and muscular. Stifles: Well angulated. Lower thigh: Long. Hocks: Lean and broad, turned neither in nor out. Well angulated. Hind feet: Oval in shape, well arched, preferably close together, well covered with hair between the toes. Dewclaws acceptable, but not desirable.
anatomy.feet: Oval in shape, well arched, preferably well-knit, well covered with hair between the toes. Oval in shape, well arched, preferably close together, well covered with hair between the toes. Dewclaws acceptable, but not desirable.
anatomy.movement: Light, covering ground, parallel.
anatomy.coat: Harsh, very dense and straight with dense undercoat. Colour: White with black patches, tan shadings on head and legs and sometimes between the white and the black patches. Black must not predominate, small black or tan spots are regarded as mismarked.
anatomy.color: White with black patches, tan shadings on head and legs and sometimes between the white and the black patches. Black must not predominate, small black or tan spots are regarded as mismarked.

identity.historical_function: Copoi.
identity.general_impression: Bine proporționat, dă impresie de mare forță și vigoare. Niciodată greu. Tricolor. Diferențele mascul/femelă bine evidente.
identity.important_proportions: Corp în dreptunghi.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Bine proporționat, dă impresie de mare forță și vigoare.
identity.historical_summary: Copoii erau cunoscuți în Suedia din secolul XVI, dar până în 1789 vânătoarea cu copoi era privilegiul regilor și nobilimii. Rasa provine probabil dintr-un amestec de copoi din sudul Germaniei și Elveția cu Foxhound și Harrier. Perechea Pang și Stella, a contelui Adolf Patrik Hamilton, e considerată originea rasei, numită la început „copoiul suedez”. A primit numele Hamiltonstövare în 1921, în onoarea creatorului ei, fondatorul Kennel Club-ului suedez.

anatomy.head: Mai degrabă lung.
anatomy.skull: Ușor bombat, de lățime moderată.
anatomy.stop: Bine definit, dar nu prea pronunțat.
anatomy.muzzle: Lung, puternic și aproape dreptunghiular; nas drept, paralel cu axul craniului. Occiput–stop egal cu stop–trufă. Trufă mereu neagră, bine dezvoltată, cu nări mari. Buze superioare destul de fine, întinse, bine rotunjite (masculii cu buze mai pronunțate). Obraji uscați.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Mușcătură în foarfece; dinți puternici.
anatomy.eyes: Maro-închis, cu expresie calmă.
anatomy.ears: Inserate destul de sus; trase înainte nu ajung la mijlocul botului, abia ridicate când câinele e atent. Moi, lipite plat de obraji.
anatomy.neck: Lung, puternic, bine plasat între umeri; piele elastică. Masculii au linia superioară a gâtului net arcuită.
anatomy.body: Greabăn bine distinct. Spate orizontal și puternic. Șale musculoase și ușor arcuite. Crupă ușor oblică, lungă și lată. Torace bine coborât, lung, ajunge la cot; coaste moderat arcuite. Abdomen doar puțin retras.
anatomy.tail: Inserată pe linia dorsală. Dreaptă ori ușor în sabie; destul de lată la rădăcină, se subțiază; ajunge la jaret. În mișcare, de preferat să nu se ridice peste linia spatelui.
anatomy.forequarters: Osatură robustă. Din față drepte și paralele. Omoplat lung, musculos, spre spate. Braț lung, în unghi drept cu omoplatul. Cot aderent. Metacarp elastic. Picioare ovale, cu degete strânse și arcuite.
anatomy.hindquarters: Din spate paralele. Coapsă cu mușchi bine dezvoltați, lată din profil. Genunchi bine unghiat. Jaret bine unghiat. Metatars scurt, uscat și drept. Picioare ca cele anterioare. Pintenii nedoriți.
anatomy.movement: Pași paraleli, energici și alungiți.
anatomy.coat: Aspru, nu prea scurt, bine culcat. Pe cap, urechi și fața anterioară a membrelor, neted și foarte scurt. Pe partea inferioară a cozii și spatele coapselor mai lung, dar fără franjuri.
anatomy.color: Tricolor. Negru pe partea superioară a gâtului, spate, laturile trunchiului și partea superioară a cozii. Capul, urechile, membrele, laturile gâtului, trunchiul și coada fulvo (de la auriu la brun-roșcat intens). Listă albă pe bot; alb pe partea superioară și inferioară a gâtului, piept, vârful cozii și extremitățile inferioare ale membrelor și pe picioare.
anatomy.size: Masculi 53–61 cm (ideal 57); femele 49–57 cm (ideal 53).

temperament.behavior: Prietenos, fără schimbări de dispoziție.
temperament.temperament_notes: Masculii trebuie să aibă doi testiculi de aspect normal, complet coborâți în scrot.

minor: Bot scurt ori ascuțit; nas concav
Enognatism sau prognatism; mușcătură în clește
Pete de negru intens care acoperă laturile trunchiului, umerii și coapsele
Pete albe altele decât cele din standard
Manta bicoloră ori predominanța oricărei culori

identity.historical_function: Tracking hound for wounded game, Scenthound. In accordance with his hunting requirements as a highly specialised huntingdog for the tracking of wounded game, the Hannoverscher Schweißhund has to display all recognized Breed Club’s required hunting abilities, endurance, potential the working trials and be useful for the more difficult tracking of game.
identity.general_impression: In general appearance the highly efficient Hannoverscher Schweißhund is of medium size, well proportioned and powerful. Well set strongly muscled fore and hind limbs qualify him for tireless work. Too long legs, specially overbuilt forequarters, affect his work with nose to ground and are foreign to his type. The broad, deep chest provides ample room for the lungs and enables long, strenuous chases. The slightly wrinkled forehead and the clear dark eyes produce the serious expression typical of the Hannoverscher Schweißhund. Also typical for the breed is the red primary colour of the coat, which can vary from a pale fawn colour to a dark brindle, almost black appearing colouring.
identity.important_proportions: Length of body to height at withers: 1.4 to 1 Depth of chest to height at withers: 0.5 to 1 Length of bridge of nose to length of head: 0.5 to 1
identity.ideal_type_summary: In general appearance the highly efficient Hannoverscher Schweißhund is of medium size, well proportioned and powerful.
identity.historical_summary: The Hannoverscher Schweißhund has developed almost unchanged from the so called «liam hound» (leash hound) of the early Middle Ages. The Liam hound, from the breed section of the «Bracke», already played an extraordinary part at the time of the establishment of clan rights of the Germanic tribes (in about 500AD). With the invention of firearms, the methods of hunting big game altered. Dogs were needed to search for wounded game. The liam hound offered the best conditions for this and so he became a « Liam-Scenthound ». This breed description stayed in place until the hunting estate of the Kingdom of Hannover got more involved with this breed The Hanoverian hunting estate in the kingdom of Hannover developed this breed further and preserved the proven methods of handling these hounds. The Deutsche Schweißhund developed into the Hannoversche Schweißhund. Since 1894 the registered «Verein Hirschmann e.V.» has been taking care of the breed, Since then the breeding of these dogs has continued strictly with regard of their working ability and the dogs are used exclusively in hunting grounds for big game as specialists in tracking cloven-hoof game. The dissertation of Dr. Wolf-Eberhardt Barth of the “Forstlichen Fakultät of the Georg-August University in Gőttingen” about the subject “Der Hannoversche Schweißhund as an example of the development of the German Gundogs” (Magazines of the Landesjagdverbands Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg e.V., Landesjägerschaft, Magazine 2, Hamburg 1970, 96 S) is the scientific base for the insight into the history of this old gundog breed, which is correctly named German culture asset (Deutscher Schweißhund).
identity.classification: Section 2 Scenthounds/Leash Hounds. With working trial.

anatomy.head: Forehead slightly wrinkled.
anatomy.skull: Broad, increasing in width towards the rear, flatly rounded. Occiput barely pronounced. Seen from the side, superciliary ridges clearly defined.
anatomy.stop: Mostly strongly pronounced, more so in males.
anatomy.muzzle: Strong, deep and broad. Well developed for being used (about 50% of length of head). Mandible strong. Nose: Broad, mostly black, rarely dark brown. Nose large, broad, nostrils well opened. Bridge of nose slightly arched or almost straight; more arched in males. Gradually narrowing towards forehead. Lips: Broad and pendulous, well rounded.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Jaws normally developed, very strong, straight, providing all teeth with sufficient room. 42 teeth. Scissor or pincer bite.
anatomy.eyes: Neither prominent nor deep-set, well fitting lids, darkbrown iris. Free of ectropion or entropion.
anatomy.ears: Of medium length. Set on high and broad, smooth, hanging close to the head without twist. Bluntly rounded at the tips.
anatomy.neck: Long and strong, gradually widening towards chest. Skin on throat full and loose, slight dewlap permissible.
anatomy.topline: Long, often slightly overbuilt.
anatomy.body: Topline: Long, often slightly overbuilt. Withers: With normal rise. Base of neck strong. Back: Strong. Loins: Broad and pliable with slight arch. Croup: Broad and long, sloping slightly towards the tail. Chest: Deep and spacious, deep rather than broad. Underline and belly: In a gradually rising line slightly tucked up.
anatomy.chest: Deep and spacious, deep rather than broad.
anatomy.tail: High set-on, long and barely curved. Strong at set-on, gradually tapering towards the tip.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: Seen from the side, vertically set under the body and straight. Seen from the front, straight, often standing close. Well in proportion to the body. Shoulder: Shoulder blade flat and close to the body, strongly muscled, well laid back. Upper arm: Long. Elbow: Well set backwards, close to the body. Forearm: Straight, well muscled. Carpus (Wrist): Broad, almost straight. Metacarpus (Pastern): Never totally steep. Forefeet: Strong, round; toes well arched, well knit; pads large and tough; strong nails.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: Seen from the side, set under the body or slightly standing back. Well angulated. Seen from behind, straight. For a medium-sized dog which is longer than high, normal in proportion to the body. Pelvis broad and capacious. Thigh: Strongly muscled. Stifle (Knee): With an angle of more than 120°. Lower thigh: Straight and lean. Hock joint: Broad and strong. Metatarsus (Rear pastern): Almost vertical to the ground. Hind feet: Rounded, well-knit toes.
anatomy.feet: Strong, round; toes well arched, well knit; pads large and tough; strong nails. Rounded, well-knit toes.
anatomy.movement: Able to move in all gaits, full of drive, flexible, ground covering when galloping. Preferred gaits at work are the walk or the gallop.
anatomy.coat: Short, thick, coarse to harsh; somewhat longer and coarser on the rear edges of the upper thighs only. Coat on tail is dense and coarse, a little longer and coarser on the underside. Colour: Light to dark deer-red, more or less intensely brindled, with or without mask. Small white patches on forechest to be tolerated.
anatomy.color: Light to dark deer-red, more or less intensely brindled, with or without mask. Small white patches on forechest to be tolerated.
anatomy.size: Height at the withers: Males: 50–55 cm. Females: 48–53 cm. Weight: Males: 30–40 kg. Females: 25–35 kg.
anatomy.skin: Thick, rather loose, mostly wrinkled on the head, and occasionally at the throat, too.

temperament.behavior: Calm and assured temperament, at the same time sensitive with his handler, choosy and discerning with strangers. High capabilities of concentration in any tracking work with strong loyalty to the hunter in charge.

minor: Lack of the first premolar (PM1) or of other teeth
disqualifying: Any dog clearly showing physical of behavioural abnormalities

identity.historical_function: Hound with a fine sense of smell and of great resistance; he is an active hunter either alone or in a pack and responds completely in all terrains of lowland or mountains and even in the more rocky and unworkable terrains; his voice is resonant and harmonious.
identity.general_impression: Medium-sized dog, short-haired, black and tan, strong, vigorous, lively, keen.
identity.ideal_type_summary: Medium-sized dog, short-haired, black and tan, strong, vigorous, lively, keen.
identity.classification: Section 1.2 Medium sized Hounds. With working trial.

anatomy.head: Long, its total length corresponds to the height at the withers as 4.35 : 10. The width of the skull must not be more than the half of the total length of the head, i.e. the total cephalic index must be less than 50. The upper lines of the skull and of the muzzle are divergent.
anatomy.skull: Its length is equal or little less than the length of the muzzle; of fairly flat shape. The occipital protuberance is only slightly protruding. Forehead quite broad. Medial furrow not very marked. Superciliary arches high.
anatomy.muzzle: Its length is equal or a little more than that of the skull. Nasal bridge straight or, in males, slightly arched. Nose: On the muzzle line, overhanging the forward vertical lip line, humid, mobile, black. Nostrils open. Lips: Rather developed.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Strong jaws meeting perfectly either in scissor or pincer bite. Strong, white teeth.
anatomy.eyes: Normal size, neither deep set nor prominent, brown colour with lively and intelligent expression.
anatomy.ears: Of medium length (almost half the length of the head), set on high, i.e. above the zygomatic arches, flat, rounded at the lower extremity and hanging vertically.
anatomy.neck: Powerful, muscled, without dewlap, descending harmoniously towards the shoulders. Its length corresponds to the total length of the head nearly as 6.5: 10.
anatomy.topline: Straight, slightly convex at the loins.
anatomy.body: The length of the body is 10% more than the height at the withers. Topline: Straight, slightly convex at the loins. Withers: Slightly raised above the backline. Back: Long, straight. Loin: Slightly arched, short, strong, well muscled. Croup: Long, broad, well muscled, slightly sloping. Chest: Well developed, deep, let down at elbow level. Ribs slightly sprung. Underline and belly: Lean, slightly tucked up.
anatomy.chest: Well developed, deep, let down at elbow level. Ribs slightly sprung.
anatomy.tail: Not long, reaching at maximum the point of the hock; set rather high, thick at the root and tapering slightly towards its tip; in movement carried sabre-fashion.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: Good straight legs seen from the front and in profile, well muscled and robust. Shoulder: Sloping, well muscled and close to the thorax. Arm: Oblique, muscular, robust. Forearm: Straight, long, well boned. Pastern joint: Lean, not prominent. Metacarpus (Pastern): Of sufficient length, strong, rather straight, never hollow. Forefeet: Rounded, compact; strong toes, close, arched; strong nails, curvec, black; pads large, hard, tough.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: Well straight and vertical seen from behind and in profile; well muscled and robust. Thigh: Long, strong, well muscled. Leg: Slanted, long, strong. Hock joint: Lean, strong, medium height, bent. Hock: Strong, lean, quite long, almost straight, without dewclaws. Hind feet: Same as the forefeet.
anatomy.feet: Rounded, compact; strong toes, close, arched; strong nails, curvec, black; pads large, hard, tough. Same as the forefeet.
anatomy.movement: Swift and light.
anatomy.coat: Short, dense, a little hard, close fitting. Colour: Black and tan. A small white patch on the chest is tolerated. The visible mucous membranes, the nose and the nails black.
anatomy.color: Black and tan. A small white patch on the chest is tolerated. The visible mucous membranes, the nose and the nails black.
anatomy.size: Height at the withers: For males: 47-55 cm. For females: 45-53 cm. Tolerance of more or less 2 cm. Weight: 17-20 kg.

identity.historical_function: Copoi.
identity.general_impression: De talie medie, solid și compact, în dreptunghi, cu linie dorsală fermă.
identity.ideal_type_summary: De talie medie, solid și compact, în dreptunghi, cu linie dorsală fermă.

anatomy.head: De mărime medie și moderat de amplu, dar nu greu; de formă ușor conică, nu ascuțită.
anatomy.skull: Ușor bombat din față și din lateral. Occiput abia vizibil.
anatomy.muzzle: Curat, amplu și adânc, mai degrabă scurt. Nas drept; din profil, linia botului rotunjită, nu pătrată. Trufă neagră. Buze curate, nependulante.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: Mușcătură în foarfece. Obraji curați și plați.
anatomy.eyes: Maro-închis, de mărime medie, neieșiți. Expresie calmă și serioasă. Conjunctiva nevizibilă.
anatomy.ears: Inserate la înălțime medie, nici late, nici lungi, se îngustează rotunjit la vârf. Subțiri și moi, atârnă nu prea lipite de obraji. Trase înainte, ajung greu la mijlocul botului.
anatomy.neck: De lungime medie, puternic, fără piele abundentă la gât.
anatomy.body: Spate drept și puternic. Șale ample și musculoase. Crupă lungă, amplă și ușor rotunjită. Torace de lățime medie, lung, adânc și spațios; ultimele coaste deosebit de dezvoltate. Adâncimea toracelui cca jumătate din înălțime. Abdomen doar ușor ridicat.
anatomy.tail: Inserată la nivelul liniei dorsale. Puternică la rădăcină, se subțiază. Dreaptă ori cu o ușoară curbă în sus; ajunge la jaret.
anatomy.forequarters: Curate, solide și nervoase, dar nu grele. Omoplați oblici, bine unghiate. Coți bine unghiați. Metacarpi ampli, mai degrabă scurți, ușor înclinați. Picioare bine arcuite și compacte, îndreptate înainte, cu perinițe ferme și păr între degete.
anatomy.hindquarters: Coapsă amplă și musculoasă. Genunchi bine unghiat. Gambă lungă. Jaret bine unghiat, amplu și curat. Metatars scurt, amplu, ușor înclinat. Picioare ca cele anterioare. La posterior se admit pinteni, dar cei dubli sunt nedoriți.
anatomy.movement: Suplu, care acoperă mult teren. Paralel din față și din spate.
anatomy.coat: Drept și de preferat ușor aspru, des, lucios și nu prea scurt. Spatele coapselor și coada pot fi ceva mai acoperite cu păr.
anatomy.color: Maro-roșcat ori roșu-gălbui, adesea cu nuanță neagră pe cap, spate și inserția cozii, cu sau fără pete albe; negru cu focuri, de obicei cu pete albe; alb cu pete și puncte maro-roșcat ori roșu-gălbui, ori cu focuri negru-și-foc. Culorile net distincte.
anatomy.size: Masculi 50–58 cm (ideal 54); femele 47–55 cm (ideal 51).

identity.historical_function: A hound with lots of stamina particularly fitted for hare, fox and boar hunting but can also be used as a tracking leash hound.
identity.general_impression: A dog of noble appearance with a hound-like strong body, of medium size. Slender, elegant body without any coarseness, with harmonic movements and short, fine hair of snow-white colour with orange markings on the head and body. The difference between male and female has to be distinctive.
identity.important_proportions: Rectangular body; length to exceed height at the withers. Height to the elbow: about 50% of the height at the withers. The length of skull to slightly exceed the length of muzzle.
identity.ideal_type_summary: A dog of noble appearance with a hound-like strong body, of medium size.
identity.historical_summary: The breed descents from an old type of the “East Adriatic white hound with markings”. The earliest proof of this can be seen in the Franciscan monastery in Dubrovnik, which originates from the time between 1327 and 1348. The Capital column of four dogs shows the old type of this hound. The Istrian Short Haired Hound can be found on a painting from the year 1474 “The bow of the three kings” in the cemetery chapel next to the village of Beram (Istrien). The altar painting from the year 1476 “The mother of Mercifulness” in the church of the holy Francis in Zadar, where in the left bottom corner an ancestor of today’s Istrian Hound is shown. He was shown then with a three-coloured coat. The description of this hound can be found in the manuscript of the Dakovoe Bishop Petar Bakic from the year 1719, where it says that the breeding of the Istrian Hound was already known before the 14th century. The first Standard for the Short-haired Istrian Hound was published on the 2nd of April 1955.
identity.classification: Section 1.2 Medium sized scenthounds With working trial.

anatomy.head: The head is in good proportion to the body of the dog and of an elegant and longish form. The head shows slight divergent lines.
anatomy.skull: Slightly longer than the muzzle, it is broadest between the ears. The temporal area is rounded. The occipital protuberance is slightly marked and the frontal furrow is moderately developed.
anatomy.muzzle: Strong, slightly shorter than the skull, tapering gradually from the stop towards the nose. Neither too narrow nor too pointed. The nose bridge is straight. Nose: Must not be higher or lower set than the nose bridge, the nostrils are well open. The whole nose leather and the inside of the nostrils have to be black or brown pigmented. Partially non-pigmented nose leather (partially pink coloured) can be tolerated but is not desirable. Lips: Thin, tight, well fitting to the jaw. The labial commissure is not visible. Fully pigmented in correspondence with the colour of the nose leather. Partially non-pigmented lips (partially pink coloured) can be tolerated but are not desirable.
anatomy.jaws_teeth: The jaws are strong and well developed. The teeth are white and well placed in the jaw. Scissors bite. The incisors are vertically placed into the jaw. A complete dentition is desirable (42 teeth in accordance with the dental formula). Missing premolars PM1 and molars M3 are not taken into account. The missing of other teeth is not desirable.
anatomy.eyes: Medium size, set moderately wide apart and placed semi frontal in an angle of 10–15 degrees to the horizontal line. Oval shaped, colour is dark brown and the expression intelligent. The eyelids must not be limp or show signs of Entropion or Ectropion. The eyelids to be pigmented in accordance with the colour of the nose leather. Partially non-pigmented eyelids (partially pink coloured) can be tolerated but are not desirable.
anatomy.ears: Dropped, lying close to the head, the front edge of ears (earlobe) touches the skull; set at eye level. The ear has the shape of an isosceles with a rounded tip, medium length and when drawn towards the nose has to reach the labial commissure. The ears are thin and must not show any wrinkles, be bent in or carried sticking out. They are covered with short hair.
anatomy.neck: Strong and well muscled placed at an angle of 45 degrees to the horizontal line. It tapers slightly towards the head. The skin on the neck is taut without dewlap or very pronounced folds.
anatomy.topline: Strong, well muscled, level.
anatomy.body: Body has to be strong but harmoniously developed. Withers: Well developed. Back: Strong, well muscled, level. Loin: Of medium length, broad, well muscled, firm and well attached to the croup. Croup: Well muscled, strong, broad, sloping at a 25–30 degrees angle to the horizontal line. Placed a little lower than the withers. Chest: Deep, broad, capacious but not too broad or barrelled. The rib cage has to reach to the elbows. The ribs are well sprung. Underline and belly: The underline rises gently from the sternum to the flanks to show a slight tuck up.
anatomy.chest: Deep, broad, capacious but not too broad or barrelled. The rib cage has to reach to the elbows. The ribs are well sprung.
anatomy.tail: Set as a continuation of the line of the croup. Strong at the root, gradually tapering towards the tip of the tail. Stretched downwards it reaches the hock or even below. Sabre shaped tail carried below the topline. Carried higher when the dog is excited (in affect) is tolerated, however tail must not be carried above back or bent in under the body. Tail to be well covered with short hair. Sometimes the underside of the tail has slightly longer hair (brush), which is not recommended.
anatomy.forequarters: General appearance: The forequarters must be in good proportion to the body and show even angles. Shoulder: Of medium length, muscular. The shoulder angle is 115– 120 degrees. Elbow: Close to the body. Forearm: Bone strong and rounded but never massive, muscle tone strong. Parallel seen from front. Carpus (Wrist): Short and elastic. Metacarpus (Pastern): Elastic, slightly sloping. Forefeet: Oval shaped with tight toes and strong nails and pads.
anatomy.hindquarters: General appearance: Strong and elastic in action. Thigh: Strong and well muscled. Lower thigh: Forming an angle of about 40 degrees to the horizontal line. Hock joint: Strong and firm. The hock angle is about 130 degrees. Metatarsus (Rear pastern): Nearly vertical to the ground, solid and elastic. Hind feet: Oval shaped with tight toes and strong nails and pads.
anatomy.feet: Oval shaped with tight toes and strong nails and pads. Oval shaped with tight toes and strong nails and pads.
anatomy.movement: The reach is substantial with a strong drive. The movement has to be harmonious; there must be no twitching. Preferably the back has to be steady during action and the limbs must not cross over.
anatomy.coat: The hair has to be hard, dense, shiny and lying close to the body. Its length is around 1–2 cm. Sometimes the hair is a little longer on the back of the thighs and on the underside of the tail, which is tolerated but it is not desirable. Colour: The basic colour is snow-white with orange coloured markings on the body and on the head. The orange coloured markings can be found in all shades, but shades must be even. The total amount of orange coloured markings must not exceed one third of the whole body. On the head the markings can be found on the ears, on the skull and on the foreface but the head must not be completely orange coloured. A symmetrical spread of the markings on the head is desirable. The markings on the body can be anywhere, mostly on the back, on the ribcage and around the tail set. Markings have the shape of spots, which have to be clearly separated. They must not get uneven or paler towards the edges of the markings. Small spots, if visible through white basic colour, can usually be found on ears.
anatomy.color: The basic colour is snow-white with orange coloured markings on the body and on the head. The orange coloured markings can be found in all shades, but shades must be even. The total amount of orange coloured markings must not exceed one third of the whole body. On the head the markings can be found on the ears, on the skull and on the foreface but the head must not be completely orange coloured. A symmetrical spread of the markings on the head is desirable. The markings on the body can be anywhere, mostly on the back, on the ribcage and around the tail set. Markings have the shape of spots, which have to be clearly separated. They must not get uneven or paler towards the edges of the markings. Small spots, if visible through white basic colour, can usually be found on ears.
anatomy.size: Height at the withers: Males: 49–53 cm. Females: 47–51 cm. Height differences of +/- 3 cm in males and females of excellent type and conformation will be tolerated.
anatomy.skin: Elastic, thin, without wrinkles and of pink colour. The head does not show any wrinkles either. Often the pigment shows on the skin in a form of greyish-black (sometimes brownish) mottles, which is visible through the white coat. This is permitted.

temperament.behavior: The breed is easy to train for hunting and is very popular with the huntsmen due to its excellent hunting abilities. This hound is particularly suited for hunting in rough, stony areas (Karst-areas) but also in all other hunting areas. The voice is strong and melodic. Of lively temperament, gentle, docile, obedient, neither nervous nor aggressive. Devoted to his owner. Wary of strangers.
temperament.temperament_notes: • Male animals should have two apparently normal testicles fully descended into the scrotum. • Only functionally and clinically healthy dogs, with breed typical conformation should be used for breeding.

disqualifying: Dogs, which clearly show physical or behavioural abnormalities
Totally unpigmented nose, eyelids or liprims
Body length shorter than the height at the withers
Tail carried in a ring or a laterally curved tail
Coat on the body longer than 2.5 cm
Red, chestnut brown, lemon yellow markings or any other coat colour not in the standard
Presence of a third coat colour
Height above or below the tolerated measures in the standard

identity.general_impression: A dog of rustic appearance and strong hound-like body, of medium size with characteristic longer coarse hair of snow-white colour with orange coloured markings on the head and on the body. These are mountain areas at the east Adriatic coast, where temperatures are low. anatomy.feet: Oval shaped with tight toes and strong nails and pads. Oval shaped with tight toes and strong nails and pads.
anatomy.movement: The reach is substantial with a strong drive. The movement has to be harmonious; there must be no twitching. Preferably the back has to be firm during action and the limbs must not cross over.
anatomy.coat: The topcoat is wiry, harsh and slightly wavy, without shine but dull, about 5–8 cms long. It should not lay flat on the body. The hair must not be curly or form locks. On the muzzle it forms moustaches and a beard and above the eyes well pronounced eyebrows, where it is a little softer than on the body. On the ears the hair is shorter and straighter. Under the topcoat is a shorter more dense undercoat, which lies close to the body and is more evident during the wintertime.
anatomy.color: The basic colour is snow-white with orange coloured markings on the body and the head. The orange coloured markings can be found in all shades, but shades must be even. The total amount of orange coloured markings must not exceed one third of the whole body. On the head the markings can be found on the ears, on the skull and on the foreface but the head must not be completely orange coloured. A symmetrical spread of the markings on the head is desirable. The markings on the body can be anywhere, mostly on the back, on the ribcage and around the tail set. Markings have the shape of spots, which have to be clearly separated. They must not get uneven or paler towards the edge of the markings. Small spots, if visible through white basic colour, can usually be found on ears.
anatomy.size: Height at the withers: Males: 50–54 cm. Females: 48–52 cm. Height differences of +/- 3 cm in males and females of excellent type and conformation will be tolerated.
anatomy.skin: Elastic, of medium thickness, well fitting to the body, without wrinkles and of pink colour. Often the pigment shows on the skin in a form of greyish-black (sometimes brownish) mottles, which is visible through the white coat. This is permitted.

temperament.behavior: The breed is easy to train for hunting and its constitution makes it possible to use him for hunting in any weather condition and also in rough, stony or hilly terrain. His voice is of medium tone but it also has deeper sounds. Gentle, even temperament, with a stern expression. Devoted to his owner.
temperament.temperament_notes: • Male animals should have two apparently normal testicles fully descended into the scrotum. • Only functionally and clinically healthy dogs, with breed typical conformation should be used for breeding.

disqualifying: Dogs, which clearly show physical or behavioural abnormalities
Totally non-pigmented nose, eyelids or liprims
Body length shorter than the height at the withers
Short legged dogs of achondroplastic type
Tail carried in a ring or a laterally curved tail
Coat on the body longer than 12 cm
Coat on the body shorter than 3 cm
Soft, pronounced wavy, curly or tangled coat
Red, chestnut brown, lemon yellow markings or any other coat colour not in the standard
Presence of a third coat colour
Height above or below the tolerated measures in the standard
